https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 国家安全主管机构负责人阐述对非军事区地雷爆炸、乌克兰政策及可能扩大清海部队等问题的应对方案。韩国国家安全顾问 Wi Sung-lac 周五表示，首尔预计将在明年初与华盛顿举行的防务会谈中，就战时作战指挥权移交取得进展。Wi 在青瓦台举行的新闻发布会上说，两国计划于12月在华盛顿再次举行国防部长会议，随后于2027年初举行年度安全战略磋商会议（SCM）。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Security chief outlines response to DMZ mine blast, Ukraine policy, possible expansion of Cheonghae Unit National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac said Friday that Seoul expects to make progress on the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) at defense talks with Washington early next year. Speaking at a press briefing at Cheong Wa Dae, Wi said the two countries plan to hold another defense ministers’ meeting in Washington in December, followed by the annual Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) in early 2027. “We expect to make substantive progress on the OPCON transfer,” Wi said. He said U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reaffirmed Washington’s commitment to the transfer during Wednesday’s meeting with Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul in Cebu, Philippines. A senior presidential official said Washington was not opposed to the transfer itself, although the allies still needed to meet the agreed conditions. Wi also said the allies completed an assessment for full operational capability (FOC) verification during this year’s Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise, as part of the conditions-based transfer process. The SCM, traditionally held in the fall, had been expected to take place later this year but was postponed until early 2027. The allies have yet to announce when FOC verification will be completed or agree on a target year for the transfer. The postponement was due to scheduling issues, while the December talks are expected to cover North Korea’s nuclear and missile capabilities and broader alliance cooperation, according to the official. Regarding the land mine explosion in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), Wi said the government would continue taking necessary measures following the incident that injured South Korean soldiers south of the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) in September. “The government will continue to take necessary measures in response to the DMZ land mine explosion, guided by clear principles,” he said. Wi said Seoul conducted a joint investigation with the United Nations Command, demanded an apology and responsible measures from North Korea and destroyed the North Korean minefield at the site. The government also sent a letter to the U.N. Security Council and explained its position to other countries, he said. Wi added that the military was responding to North Korean crossings of the MDL under its operational guidelines, while Seoul had repeatedly proposed military talks to resolve differences in how the two sides identify the MDL. A senior presidential official said North Korea had rejected Seoul’s proposal for military talks, but the government had renewed its offer and was awaiting a response. Seoul would not recognize fences or other structures unilaterally erected by North Korea as an international border, the official added. On Ukraine, Wi said Seoul would maintain its support despite a diplomatic dispute with Kyiv over an alleged breach of a confidential agreement concerning the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea. “We will continue to participate in international efforts to support Ukraine as a responsible member of the international community, separately from this issue,” he said. He said Seoul was continuing consultations with Kyiv to establish the facts and restore bilateral trust. Seoul would also maintain its sanctions against Russia and export controls, he added. Wi also said the government was considering expanding and strengthening the Cheonghae Unit, a naval contingent deployed to protect shipping in waters near the Strait of Hormuz. “We are considering options, including expanding and strengthening the Cheonghae Unit, but the review has not yet been completed,” he said. He stressed that Korea would not become involved in the war under any circumstances, while considering limited measures to protect Korean commercial vessels, secure oil shipping routes and safeguard its citizens. Wi said the government would explain its plans to the public and the National Assembly once a decision is made. Any relocation of the Cheonghae Unit or expansion of its operational area would require parliamentary approval, but the government has not yet developed a proposal for submission to the National Assembly, according to the official
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔预计，2027年初与美国举行的防务会谈将在移交作战指挥权方面取得实质性进展
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国国家安全顾问 Wi Sung-lac 说明政府针对非军事区地雷爆炸、乌克兰政策及扩大清海部队的应对方案。Wi Sung-lac 周五表示，首尔预计明年初将与华盛顿举行防务会谈，在战时作战指挥权移交方面取得进展。Wi 在青瓦台举行的新闻发布会上说，两国计划于12月在华盛顿再次举行防务部长会议，随后于2027年初举行年度安全战略磋商会议。他说：“我们预计将在战时作战指挥权移交方面取得实质性进展。”他表示，美国国防部长 Pete Hegseth 周三在菲律宾宿务与国防部长 Kang Shin-chul 会晤时，重申了华盛顿对移交战时作战指挥权的承诺。一名总统府高级官员说，华盛顿本身并不反对移交，但双方盟友仍需满足既定条件。Wi 还说，在以条件为基础的移交程序中，双方盟友已于今年“乙巳自由护盾”军演期间完成全面作战能力核查。安全战略磋商会议通常于秋季举行，原本预计今年稍晚举行，但已推迟至2027年初。双方盟友尚未宣布何时完成全面作战能力核查，也未就移交目标年份达成一致。该名官员表示，推迟是由于日程安排问题，而12月的会谈预计将讨论朝鲜的核与导弹能力以及更广泛的联盟合作。关于非军事区地雷爆炸事件，Wi 说，政府将继续采取必要措施，以应对今年9月军事分界线以南发生地雷爆炸并造成韩国士兵受伤的事件。他说：“政府将在明确原则的指导下，继续采取必要措施，应对非军事区地雷爆炸事件。”Wi 说，首尔与联合国司令部进行了联合调查，要求朝鲜道歉并采取负责任的措施，还摧毁了事发地点的朝鲜雷区。他说，政府还向联合国安理会提交了信函，并向其他国家说明了韩方立场。Wi 补充说，军方正依据行动准则应对朝鲜越过军事分界线的行为，而首尔已多次提议举行军事会谈，以解决双方对军事分界线认定方式存在的分歧。一名总统府高级官员说，朝鲜拒绝了首尔举行军事会谈的提议，但政府已再次提出，正在等待回应。该官员补充说，首尔不会承认朝鲜单方面设置的围栏或其他设施为国际边界。在乌克兰问题上，Wi 说，尽管首尔与基辅因据称违反一项有关将朝鲜战俘移交韩国的保密协议而发生外交争端，但首尔仍会维持对乌支持。他说：“我们将继续参与国际社会支持乌克兰的国际行动，并独立处理这一问题。”他说，首尔正继续与基辅磋商，以查明事实并恢复双边信任。他补充说，首尔还将维持对俄罗斯的制裁和出口管制。Wi 还说，政府正在考虑扩大并加强清海部队；这是一支部署在霍尔木兹海峡附近水域、用于保护航运的海军部队。他说：“我们正在考虑包括扩大和加强清海部队在内的各种方案，但相关评估尚未完成。”他强调，韩国无论如何都不会卷入战争，同时正考虑采取有限措施保护韩国商船、保障石油运输线路安全并保护韩国公民。Wi 说，一旦作出决定，政府将向公众和国会说明有关计划。该名官员表示，调动清海部队或扩大其行动区域均须获得国会批准，但政府尚未制定提交国会的方案。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: WASHINGTON — Korean Ambassador to the United States Kang Kyung-wha has pledged to strengthen cooperation with U.S. authorities to support bilateral investment, describing Hyundai Motor Group's latest investment in Alabama as an example of the expanding economic partnership between the two countries. Kang made the remarks Wednesday while attending a ceremony announcing Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama's plan to invest about $450 million in its Montgomery plant, according to the Korean Embassy in Washington. The ambassador highlighted Hyundai's presence in the U.S. as an "outstanding example" of how the Korea-U.S. alliance has evolved over more than seven decades, expanding beyond its security foundations into cooperation in economic security and advanced technology. Kang also said the investment would combine Korea's advanced manufacturing capabilities with America's innovation and market competitiveness, allowing the two countries to "shape the future of the automotive industry together," according to the embassy. She added that the Korean government would work closely with U.S. federal, state and local governments to continue supporting "mutually beneficial investments and economic cooperation."

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 华盛顿——韩国驻美国大使姜京华承诺加强与美国当局的合作，以支持两国双边投资，并将现代汽车集团最新在阿拉巴马州的投资称为两国经济伙伴关系不断扩大的实例。据韩国驻华盛顿大使馆消息，姜京华周三出席了一场宣布现代汽车制造阿拉巴马州公司计划向其蒙哥马利工厂投资约4.5亿美元的仪式，并发表了上述言论。大使强调，现代汽车在美国的发展是韩美同盟在70多年间不断演进的“杰出例证”，这一同盟已从安全基础扩展至经济安全和先进技术合作。大使馆称，姜京华还表示，这项投资将把韩国的先进制造能力与美国的创新能力和市场竞争力相结合，使两国能够“共同塑造汽车行业的未来”。她补充说，韩国政府将与美国联邦、州及地方政府密切合作，继续支持“互利投资和经济合作”。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — The top diplomats of South Korea, the United States and Japan on Friday reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea during trilateral talks, the U.S. State Department said. South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun met with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio met and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi on the sidelines of a Group of 20 (G20) meeting in Atlanta, according to a State Department readout. "The Secretary and Foreign Ministers reaffirmed their resolute commitment to the complete denuclearization" of North Korea and the full implementation of U.N. Security Council resolutions, the department said. The three ministers also underscored the need to enforce U.N. sanctions prohibiting activities that generate revenue for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs, while commending the work of the Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team in exposing North Korea's sanctions violations and evasion. They emphasized the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. Rubio also raised concerns about China's actions in the South China Sea, East China Sea and Yellow Sea, as well as cooperation between Russia and China that Washington says undermines peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific. During the meeting, the three ministers signed a memorandum of cooperation establishing a Trilateral Arctic Pacific Partnership to explore maritime cooperation and economic partnerships in the Pacific Arctic
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国、美国和日本外长重申对实现朝鲜无核化作出“坚定承诺”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国国务院表示，韩国、美国和日本的外交部长于周五在三边会谈中重申，将继续致力于朝鲜完全无核化。美国国务院发布的会议纪要称，在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团（G20）会议期间，韩国外交部长赵显与美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥、日本外务大臣茂木敏充举行了会晤。国务院称：“国务卿和三位外长重申坚决致力于朝鲜‘完全无核化’，并全面执行联合国安全理事会决议。”三位部长还强调，必须执行联合国制裁，禁止为平壤的核计划和弹道导弹计划创造收入的活动，同时肯定多边制裁监测小组在揭露朝鲜违反制裁及规避制裁行为方面所做的工作。他们强调 Maintaining 台海地区的和平与稳定至关重要。鲁比奥还对中国在南海、东海和黄海的行为，以及华盛顿所称破坏印太和平与稳定的俄中合作表示关切。会议期间，三位部长签署了一份合作备忘录，成立“三边北极太平洋伙伴关系”，以探索太平洋北极地区的海洋合作和经济伙伴关系

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: WASHINGTON — Hanwha Defense USA (HDUSA), a subsidiary of South Korea's Hanwha Aerospace Co., has secured a $269 million contract to build a medium landing ship (LSM) for the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps, marking its first U.S. Navy shipbuilding contract, according to the company. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——韩国韩华航空航天株式会社旗下子公司Hanwha Defense USA（HDUSA）获得了为美国海军和海军陆战队建造一艘中型登陆舰（LSM）的2.69亿美元合同。据该公司称，这是其首次获得美国海军造船合同。此次选标通过Tote Services的船舶建造管理项目竞争性招标程序完成，该项目管理美国海军和海军陆战队的造船合同。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — Hanwha Defense USA (HDUSA), a subsidiary of South Korea's Hanwha Aerospace Co., has secured a $269 million contract to build a medium landing ship (LSM) for the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps, marking its first U.S. Navy shipbuilding contract, according to the company. The company said Thursday it was selected by U.S. maritime services firm Tote Services to build one LSM at Hanwha Philly Shipyard in Philadelphia, with options to construct three additional vessels. The selection was made through a competitive bidding process under Tote Services' vessel construction management program, which oversees shipbuilding contracts for the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps. "Since acquiring Philly Shipyard in 2024, Hanwha has made significant investments in its workforce and technology to pave the way to build ships for the U.S. Navy and other federal customers," HDUSA President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Michael Coulter said. Construction is scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter of 2027. Tote Services' $2.2 billion vessel construction manager contract supports the Navy and Marine Corps' planned 35-ship LSM fleet. The program's first vessel is expected to be delivered in 2030. The announcement comes as HDUSA is moving to acquire a controlling stake in Hanwha Philly Shipyard, which Hanwha purchased in 2024, as the South Korean defense group seeks to expand its presence in the U.S. shipbuilding industry
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: Hanwha Defense USA赢得美国海军2.69亿美元造船合同
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——据韩华防务美国公司（HDUSA）消息，该公司是韩国韩华航空航天公司的子公司，已获得一份价值2.69亿美元的合同，为美国海军和海军陆战队建造一艘中型登陆舰（LSM）。这是该公司首次获得美国海军舰船建造合同。该公司周四表示，美国海事服务企业Tote Services已选定其在费城韩华费城造船厂建造一艘LSM，并可选择增建3艘舰船。此次遴选通过Tote Services舰船建造管理计划下的竞争性招标程序进行，该计划负责美国海军和海军陆战队的舰船建造合同。HDUSA总裁兼首席执行官（CEO）迈克尔·库尔特表示：“韩华于2024年收购费城造船厂以来，在员工队伍和技术方面投入了大量资金，为美国海军及其他联邦客户建造舰船铺平了道路。”建造工作计划于2027年第四季度开始。Tote Services价值22亿美元的舰船建造管理合同支持海军和海军陆战队计划组建的35艘LSM舰队。该计划的首艘舰船预计将于2030年交付。宣布此项消息之际，HDUSA正推进收购韩华费城造船厂的控股权。韩华于2024年买下该造船厂，这家韩国防务集团旨在扩大其在美国造船业的布局

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.summary_zh: 美声歌唱家林炯宙将在已故演员崔_bool_am的葬礼弥撒中演唱《圣母经》，向这位资深演员致以最后敬意。据崔氏家族 representatives 周六表示，林炯宙将于周一上午10时在首尔汝矣岛天主教堂举行的葬礼弥撒中献唱。弥撒将由枢机主教安德鲁·廉洙荣主持。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: Popera tenor Lim Hyung-joo will pay his final respects to veteran actor Choi Bool-am by performing “Ave Maria” at the late actor’s funeral Mass. According to a representative for Choi’s family on Saturday, Lim will sing during the funeral Mass scheduled for 10 a.m. on Monday at Yeouido Catholic Church in Seoul. The Mass will be presided over by Cardinal Andrew Yeom Soo-jung. Following news of Choi’s death on Friday, Lim paid tribute to the late actor in a social media post. “I never imagined that my visit to see him in the hospital a few months ago would turn out to be our final goodbye,” Lim wrote. “I am deeply grateful that he always cherished my singing, attended my solo concerts with Aunt Kim Min-ja and offered me words of encouragement and wisdom. I love you, Uncle.” “I still remember him telling me to smile and say my final goodbye when my time comes to leave this world,” he wrote. “I will try to honor those words.” Choi died at around 10 p.m. on Thursday while receiving inpatient treatment at a hospital in Gangseo District in western Seoul. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.title_zh: 林炯柱将在电视传奇人物Choi Bool-am的葬礼弥撒上演唱《圣母玛利亚》

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: President Lee Jae Myung renewed his call Saturday for a review of multicultural family support programs, saying any preferential policy that can create reverse discrimination cannot be justified. Lee posted the comments on social media amid criticism after he suggested the need to revise the support programs for multicultural families in South Korea, such as priority access to low-cost public postpartum care centers.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 李在明总统周六再次呼吁审查多文化家庭支持项目，称任何可能造成反向歧视的优惠政策都缺乏正当理由。李在社交媒体上发表上述言论之际，正受到批评。此前，他曾提出需要修订韩国多文化家庭支持项目，例如让这些家庭优先使用低收费公共产后护理中心。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung renewed his call Saturday for a review of multicultural family support programs, saying any preferential policy that can create reverse discrimination cannot be justified. Lee posted the comments on social media amid criticism after he suggested the need to revise the support programs for multicultural families in South Korea, such as priority access to low-cost public postpartum care centers. In an earlier posting on his X account, Lee questioned whether mothers from multicultural families and mothers recognized as persons of national merit deserve to be placed in the same category for reservations at government-funded postpartum care centers. The issue, which the liberal president brought forward after citing a post from a conservative online community site, has drawn backlash from the liberal bloc voicing concern that such a move amounts to inciting hatred in society. "While it is true that support for multicultural families is necessary, that cannot justify specific policies that are unreasonable or may result in reverse discrimination," Lee wrote on X. "Just because a general assertion is righteous does not mean that every detail of that assertion is correct," he said. Lee also called to attention why some people often show resentment toward statements about political correctness or double standards, saying that the necessary support for all will further gain ground when "faulty parts" are acknowledged and rectified. "The more sensitive an issue is, the less we should avoid it out of fear that it will spark controversy or let leaders decide everything behind closed doors, but get the entire public to engage, bring up the issue and debate it seriously," he said. "Defending the issue only because I advocate that will not help solve the problem, but will only worsen it," he added
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 李表示，多元文化家庭支持政策所导致的“反向歧视”无法成为正当理由
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 李在明总统周六再次呼吁审查支持多元文化家庭的政策，称任何可能造成反向歧视的优惠政策都缺乏正当性。李在社交媒体上发表评论，此前他提出需要修订韩国支持多元文化家庭的政策，例如优先使用低价公共产后护理中心，因此遭到批评。此前，李在他的 X 账号发帖质疑，多元文化家庭的母亲与被认定为国家功臣的母亲，是否应当被归为同一类，以获得政府资助产后护理中心的名额预留。这项议题由这位自由派总统在引用一个保守派网络社区网站的帖子后提出，遭到自由派阵营的反弹；该阵营担心此举无异于煽动社会仇恨。李在 X 上写道：“确实有必要支持多元文化家庭，但这不能成为实施不合理政策或可能导致反向歧视的特定政策的理由。”“仅仅因为一项笼统主张是正当的，并不意味着这项主张的每个细节都是正确的。”他还要求人们关注为何有些人经常对有关政治正确或双重标准的言论表现出不满，称当“有缺陷的部分”得到承认和纠正时，对所有人的必要支持才会进一步得到巩固。他说：“一个问题越敏感，我们就越不应因为害怕引发争议，或担心让领导者躲在幕后决定一切而回避它，而应让全体公众参与进来，提出问题并进行认真讨论。”“仅仅因为是我在倡导，就为这一问题辩护无助于解决问题，只会使问题更加严重。”他补充道。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: A spokesperson from the North's foreign ministry issued the criticism in a statement, after 11 countries and the European Union (EU) released the joint statement earlier this week reaffirming their commitment to monitoring the North's activities in violation of U.N. Security Council (UNSC) sanctions resolutions.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 北方外交部发言人在一份声明中提出批评。此前，11个国家和欧洲联盟（EU）于本周早些时候发表联合声明，再次承诺监督北方违反联合国安全理事会（UNSC）制裁决议的活动。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A spokesperson from the North's foreign ministry issued the criticism in a statement, after 11 countries and the European Union (EU) released the joint statement earlier this week reaffirming their commitment to monitoring the North's activities in violation of U.N. Security Council (UNSC) sanctions resolutions. The joint statement also highlighted the findings of the Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team (MSMT) on the North's illicit activities and welcomed fresh independent sanctions imposed by the U.S., Australia and the EU over the North's cyberactivities and dispatch of its workers overseas to finance its nuclear weapons and missile programs. "This is another case that reminds us that the hostile forces' bad habit of denying the constitutional status of our state," the spokesperson said in the statement carried by the North's Korean Central News Agency. "The isolated are not us but the U.S. and the Western camp which have lost judgment and courage to admit their strategic failure despite the lack of their means and ability to prove the effectiveness of their sanctions," the official said. The official went on to stress that "futile" sanctions and pressure will "never work" on North Korea, nor will they affect its position as a nuclear weapons state. "Time proves that the 'sanctions' on the DPRK are doomed to go bankrupt," the spokesperson said. DPRK is short for the North's official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. "(North Korea) vehemently denounces and rejects the U.S. and its vassal forces' ill-intended conspiratorial racket to justify their malicious and depraved hostile policy toward the DPRK under unjust and unreasonable pretexts," the spokesperson said. The MSMT was established after a U.N. expert panel, tasked with monitoring sanctions enforcement, was disbanded in April 2024 due to Russia's veto of a resolution to extend its mandate. It consists of 11 countries, including South Korea, the United States, Japan, Australia and Canada
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜谴责支持对平壤实施制裁的多国声明，称其为“战略失败”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
北方外交部发言人在一份声明中提出批评。此前，本周有11个国家和欧盟（EU）发表联合声明，重申将监测北方违反联合国安全理事会（UNSC）制裁决议的活动。联合声明还强调多边制裁监测小组（MSMT）就北方非法活动发布的调查结果，并对美国、澳大利亚和欧盟针对北方网络活动以及向海外派遣人员为核武和导弹计划筹资而新实施的独立制裁表示欢迎。

发言人在北方朝鲜中央通讯社刊发的声明中说：“这又是一个提醒我们敌对势力有否认我国宪政地位恶习的案例。”

该官员说：“被孤立的不是我们，而是美国和西方阵营；尽管他们缺乏手段和能力证明其制裁的有效性，却仍丧失理智和勇气承认自己的战略失败。”

这名官员接着强调，“徒劳”的制裁和压力“永远不会”对朝鲜奏效，也无法改变其作为核武器国家的地位。

发言人说：“时间会证明，针对朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（DPRK）的‘制裁’注定会破产。”

朝鲜民主主义人民共和国是朝鲜官方全称的简称。

发言人说：“（朝鲜）强烈谴责并拒绝美国及其附庸势力以不公正、不合理的借口，为其针对朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的恶意且卑劣的敌对政策寻找理由而策划的居心不良的阴谋勾当。”

2024年4月，负责监测制裁执行情况的联合国专家小组在俄罗斯否决延长其授权期限的决议后解散，多边制裁监测小组（MSMT）随后成立。该小组由11个国家组成，包括韩国、美国、日本、澳大利亚和加拿大。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Korea, the most haunted place on Earth
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: In the late 19th century, traveling at night in Korea — especially in lonely stretches of mountain roads — could challenge the courage of even the bravest man. They were “beside him, behind him, dancing in front of him, whirring over his head, crying out upon him from air, earth, and water.” They were relentless. Even by his own accounts, Korea was the most haunted place on earth — or at least it was in the 19th century.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 19世纪末，在韩国夜间出行——尤其是独自一人走在那段荒僻的山路上——即使是世界上最勇敢的人也会感到胆怯。它们“在他身旁、在他身后、在他面前舞动，在他头顶盘旋，从空中、地面和水面向他发出声响。”它们穷追不舍。即使按照他本人的叙述，韩国也是地球上最阴森的地点——至少在19世纪是这样。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: In the late 19th century, traveling at night in Korea — especially in lonely stretches of mountain roads — could challenge the courage of even the bravest man. Bandits roamed the countryside, preying upon lone travelers and often stealing not only their money and valuables, but also their lives. However, men, no matter how dark their hearts, were not the most dangerous creatures a traveler might encounter. The earthly monarchs of the night were the tigers. According to one early Western visitor, when traveling with a group of Koreans, the unsuspecting foreigner was placed in the rear of the party — ostensibly as an act of protection for their valued guest. This privileged position, however, was actually the most dangerous. Korean tigers were prone to stalk parties of travelers from behind, suddenly attacking and making a meal of the last person in line. Our Western expert playfully noted that he “generally took pretty good care to retain a middle position in the procession, when out on a country prowl, greatly to the distress and uneasiness of my white-robed guardian angels.” In the 1890s, wolves were also a dire threat in the darkness, but usually not to adults. Wolves often lay in wait near outhouses, awaiting an unwary child or small woman caught up in the urgent need to answer Mother Nature. The attacks were sudden and deadly. Sometimes a pool of blood testified as to the prey’s fate; other times, there was no trace. The victim simply disappeared, as if they were a ghost. There were ghosts in the darkness — and, even more alarmingly, in the bright sunlight. According to George Heber Jones, an American missionary, many Koreans believed that demons and spirits populated every space, whether empty or occupied. “They haunt every umbrageous tree, shady ravine, spring and mountain crest. On green hill slopes, in peaceful agricultural valleys, in grassy dells, on wooded uplands, by lake and stream, by road and river, in north, south, east, and west they abound, making malignant sport out of human destinies.” When a traveler left the perceived safety of his home, he was tormented by hordes of malevolent spirits. They were “beside him, behind him, dancing in front of him, whirring over his head, crying out upon him from air, earth, and water.” They were relentless. Ancient trees were frequently encountered, sometimes near the entrances of villages, at other times near treacherous spots along the road. The branches of these sacred trees were cluttered with small offerings — pieces of paper, rags, clothing, coins, locks of hair and human effigies. Hanging from straw ropes were small bags filled with rotting morsels of food, the reek contributing to the almost mystical gloominess of the location. Each gift represented a different bribe: a plea for safe passage, the desperate want of a child, protection from the feral creatures of the wilderness or a distraction from unwanted attention. Whether these requests were granted depended upon the whimsical nature of the trees’ resident spirits. It is unsurprising that some people chose not to leave their homes — especially on certain inauspicious days. The 16th day of the first lunar month was known as Magpie Day. According to folk tales, if people left their homes to work, these brash, fearless birds would peck at and spoil their valuable cotton — a reasonable excuse to make it a day of rest. However, the day was also known as the Day of Ghosts. Some people believed that if they left the sanctuary of their homes, ghosts would follow and rain misfortune upon them. The protection offered by staying home was dubious. “Every Korean home is subject to demons, here, there and everywhere,” explained Jones. They were present in every room — even within the foulness of the outhouse. Perched upon every shelf and peering out from every jar, they observed everything, night and day — often finding fault. Yet, despite the pervasiveness of these nefarious spirits, they had vulnerabilities — sometimes in the form of common items, such as sieves, whose holes could distract an evil being long enough for its victim to escape. Chickens, despite being small and weak, possessed the power to dispel these supernatural threats. Dogs provided not only protection from thieves — and, to a lesser degree, tigers — but some also protected the house from evil spirits. A shaggy Korean dog breed was renowned for its supernatural abilities. Its name, “sapsal,” combines the Chinese characters for “drive away” and “bad luck or misfortune,” and it gained a reputation for its role as a protector. Cats, on the other hand, were viewed in a negative light. They were often associated with evil and misfortune. In 1887, an American religious magazine published a list of superstitions gleaned through Korean interviews. Among them was an abhorrent fear of a cat approaching a dead person. According to the interviewer, “If such an accident happens the corpse will stand upright and the body has to be knocked down with a broom.” It seems somewhat ironic, as cats were also used as protection against cholera — whose fearful symptoms were likened to rats eating their way up through a person’s legs. Even by his own accounts, Korea was the most haunted place on earth — or at least it was in the 19th century. My appreciation to Diane Nars for her invaluable assistance
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 韩国：地球上闹鬼最厉害的地方
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 19世纪末，在韩国夜间出行，尤其是在荒僻险峻的山路上，对最勇敢的人来说也可能是一项勇气考验。土匪横行乡间，袭击落单的行人，不仅抢夺钱财和贵重物品，还经常夺人性命。然而，无论内心多么阴暗，人类都不是旅途中可能遭遇的最危险生物。夜间的尘世君王是老虎。据一位早期到访的西方人士说，他与一群朝鲜人同行时，这位不知危险的外国人被安排在队伍最后——表面上是为了保护这位尊贵的客人。然而，这个看似特权的位置实际上最为危险。朝鲜虎往往从背后尾随旅行队伍，突然发动袭击，把队伍中最后一人吃掉。那位西方专家诙谐地写道，他“在乡间游荡时，通常很注意保持自己处于队伍中间的位置，这让我那身穿白袍的守护天使们十分担忧和不安。”19世纪90年代，狼在黑暗中也是致命威胁，不过通常不会袭击成年人。狼经常埋伏在户外厕所附近，等待毫无戒备的孩子或身材瘦小的女性，她们往往因内急而来到这里。袭击突然且致命。有时，一摊血迹见证了猎物的下场；有时则毫无踪迹。受害者 Simply disappeared，仿佛变成了幽灵。黑暗中有鬼魂存在——更令人不安的是，在明亮的阳光照射下也有鬼魂。据美国传教士乔治·希伯·琼斯说，许多朝鲜人相信恶魔和精灵遍布每个空间，无论那里是空无一人还是有人居住。“它们出没于每一棵枝叶繁茂的树、每道阴森的山谷、每处泉水和山脊。在翠绿的山坡上，在宁静的农耕山谷中，在长满青草的幽谷里，在树木茂密的高地上，在湖边溪畔，在路旁河边，在南、北、东、西各处，它们无处不在，拿人的命运作恶作剧。”旅行者一旦离开被认为安全的家，便会受到成群恶毒精灵的折磨。它们“在他身旁，在他身后，在他面前起舞，在他头顶嗡嗡作响，从空中、地面和水面向他哭叫。”它们穷追不舍。人们经常遇到古树，有时在村庄入口附近，有时在路边危险的地方。这些神圣树木的枝头挂满了小小的供品——纸片、破布、衣物、硬币、发绺和人形偶像。草绳上挂着装有腐烂食物残渣的小袋，腥臭味使这个地方笼罩在近乎神秘的阴森气氛中。每份礼物都代表一种不同的贿赂：祈求平安通行、孩子发出的绝望愿望、免受荒野猛兽伤害，或避开不受欢迎的关注。这些请求能否得到满足，取决于栖居树中的精灵是否心情莫测。因此，有些人选择足不出户并不令人意外，尤其是在某些不吉利的日子。农历正月十六被称为“喜鹊日”。据民间传说，人们若在这一天出门干活，这些鲁莽而无畏的鸟就会啄坏并毁掉他们珍贵的棉布——这为人们把这天当作休息日提供了合理借口。不过，这一天也被称为“鬼魂日”。有些人相信，如果他们离开家这个避难所，鬼魂便会尾随而来，把灾祸降临到他们身上。留在家中所提供的保护是否可靠，则很难说。琼斯解释道：“每一户朝鲜人的家都受恶魔困扰，此处、彼处、无处不在。”它们存在于每一个房间——甚至也存在于肮脏的户外厕所里。它们栖身于每个搁架，从每个罐子里探出目光，日夜观察一切——而且往往还会挑出毛病。尽管这些邪恶精灵无处不在，它们也有弱点，有时就以日常物品的形式出现，例如筛子；筛孔可以让邪恶存在分心足够长的时间，让受害者得以逃脱。鸡虽然弱小，却有驱逐这些超自然威胁的力量。狗不仅能保护人们免遭盗贼袭击——在较小程度上也能防虎——有些狗还保护房屋，使其免受恶灵侵扰。一种毛茸茸的朝鲜犬种因其超自然能力而闻名。它的名字“sapsal”由表示“驱赶”和“厄运或不幸”的汉字组合而成，并因充当保护者而声名远扬。另一方面，猫则受到负面看待。它们常被与邪恶和不幸联系在一起。1887年，一份美国宗教杂志刊登了一份通过采访朝鲜人收集到的迷信清单。其中包括一种令人憎恶的恐惧：害怕猫靠近死者。据采访者说：“如果发生这种情况，尸体就会直立起来，必须用扫帚把尸体打倒。”这似乎多少有些讽刺，因为猫也被用来抵御霍乱——这种疾病令人恐惧的症状被比作老鼠从人的腿部一路啃噬上去。即使按照琼斯自己的说法，朝鲜也是地球上最闹鬼的地方——至少在19世纪时如此。感谢Diane Nars提供的宝贵协助

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korea reports on Swiss FM's visit following opening of diplomatic office
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui met one-on-one with her Swiss counterpart visiting Pyongyang earlier this week and discussed promoting dialogue and cooperation, the North's state media reported Saturday. Choe held the talks with Swiss Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis, who was on a two-day trip since Friday following Switzerland's recent opening of its first diplomatic office in Pyongyang.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 据朝鲜官方媒体报道，朝鲜外务相崔善惠本周早些时候在平壤与到访的瑞士外长一对一会谈，讨论推动对话与合作。崔善惠与瑞士外长伊尼亚齐奥·卡西斯举行会谈。卡西斯自星期五起对朝鲜进行为期两天的访问，此前瑞士刚刚在平壤设立其首个外交办事处。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui met one-on-one with her Swiss counterpart visiting Pyongyang earlier this week and discussed promoting dialogue and cooperation, the North's state media reported Saturday. Choe held the talks with Swiss Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis, who was on a two-day trip since Friday following Switzerland's recent opening of its first diplomatic office in Pyongyang. The two sides discussed "the issue of promoting dialogue and cooperation between the diplomatic fields of the two countries and exchanged the appraisal and views of the international situation of common concern," the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported. "The talks proceeded in a friendly atmosphere," the news outlet said, without elaborating. Also attending the talks from the North's side were Jong Tong-hak, the North's vice foreign minister, and Jo Chol-su, North Korea's top envoy to Switzerland, among other officials. In a separate dispatch, the KCNA reported that Cassis paid a courtesy call on Jo Yong-won, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on the same day. Jo is considered a close aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. Cassis's trip to Pyongyang was followed by his visit to Seoul on Friday. Seoul's foreign ministry said Cassis met with National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac and separately with Jeong Yeon-doo, vice foreign minister responsible for North Korea affairs, to share details of his discussions in North Korea. Switzerland is a member of the Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission, an independent body established to oversee the enforcement of the Armistice Agreement that ended the 1950-53 Korean War. Switzerland established diplomatic ties with North Korea in 1974, but rather than a formal mission, it operated a humanitarian cooperation office in Pyongyang from 1997 until shutting it down in 2020 amid the COVID-19 pandemic. The opening of the diplomatic office in Pyongyang marks Switzerland's first political and diplomatic presence in North Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜在外交办事处开设后报道瑞士外长访问
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜外务相崔善姬本周早些时候在平壤与到访的瑞士外长一对一会晤，并讨论了推动对话与合作。朝鲜国家媒体报道说，崔善姬与瑞士外长伊尼亚齐奥·卡西斯举行了会谈。卡西斯自星期五起对朝鲜进行为期两天的访问，此行是在瑞士近期开设其设在平壤的首个外交办事处之后进行的。朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道称，双方讨论了“推动两国外交领域对话与合作的问题，并交流了对双方共同关注的国际形势的评估和意见”。该新闻机构说，“会谈在友好的气氛中进行”，但未作进一步说明。朝鲜方面出席会谈的还有朝鲜副外相 Jong Tong-hak、朝鲜常驻瑞士特使 Jo Chol-su以及其他官员。在另一篇报道中，朝鲜中央通讯社称，卡西斯于同一天礼节性拜会了朝鲜劳动党中央秘书 Jo Yong-won。Jo Yong-won被认为是朝鲜领导人金正恩的密切助手。卡西斯访问平壤后，于星期五访问了首尔。韩国外交部表示，卡西斯会见国家安全顾问 Wi Sung-lac，并另行会见负责朝鲜事务的副外长 Jeong Yeon-doo shares details of his discussions in North Korea. Switzerland is a member of the Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission, an independent body established to oversee the enforcement of the Armistice Agreement that ended the 1950-53 Korean War. Switzerland established diplomatic ties with North Korea in 1974, but rather than a formal mission, it operated a humanitarian cooperation office in Pyongyang from 1997 until shutting it down in 2020 amid the COVID-19 pandemic. The opening of the diplomatic office in Pyongyang marks Switzerland's first political and diplomatic presence in North Korea

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Korea expands benefits for retired working dogs to help them find forever homes
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Korea is stepping up its efforts to help retired working dogs find forever homes by building a comprehensive, state-funded safety net designed to ease the steep financial burden on adoptive families. For years, private adoption for retired working dogs faced steep hurdles. Furthermore, plans are underway to build a dedicated state retirement center to rehabilitate retired working dogs for adoption, while providing lifelong, state-funded care for senior or ill dogs that cannot be placed in private homes.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国正加大力度，帮助退役工作犬找到永久归宿。为此，韩国正在建立一套全面的国家资助安全网，以减轻收养家庭面临的经济负担。多年来，私人收养退役工作犬面临重重困难。此外，相关计划正在推进，将建设一座专门的国家退役犬中心，对退役工作犬进行康复治疗并为收养做准备，同时为无法安置在私人家庭中的老年或患病犬提供终身国家资助照护。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea is stepping up its efforts to help retired working dogs find forever homes by building a comprehensive, state-funded safety net designed to ease the steep financial burden on adoptive families. Under an expanded initiative led by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the government is introducing direct medical subsidies, discounted veterinary care, and dedicated hospice facilities to ensure these canine public servants are cared for after their service ends. Roughly 1,100 working dogs currently serve across six government bodies, including the military, police, fire services, customs and quarantine inspection. Among them, the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency alone operates approximately 70 specialized detector dogs at key international travel hubs. For years, private adoption for retired working dogs faced steep hurdles. Specialized breeds like beagles, Labradors, and Malinois typically retire around age 8 after six to eight years of active duty. Upon retirement, adoptive owners are left with high medical costs for joint issues, dental problems and chronic ailments accrued during their demanding working lives. To make adoption more accessible, the ministry partnered with private veterinary groups, pet food manufacturers and insurers to slash maintenance costs. Participating clinics, which have expanded from 56 locations in 2024 to 73 in 2026, offer 30 percent discounts on treatments, while feed suppliers provide up to 50 percent off specialized nutrition. In April, the government introduced a direct subsidy program reimbursing up to 60 percent of out-of-pocket medical bills and insurance premiums, capped at 1 million won ($725) annually per dog for up to 100 retirees each year. Officials are also establishing a network of public anchor veterinary hospitals, partnering with animal hospitals at four flagship national universities — Kangwon National University, Chungbuk National University, Chungnam National University and Chonnam National University — to provide subsidized care. Furthermore, plans are underway to build a dedicated state retirement center to rehabilitate retired working dogs for adoption, while providing lifelong, state-funded care for senior or ill dogs that cannot be placed in private homes. "We want to ensure the government honors their service with proper care and dignity," said Kim Jeong-wook, head of the ministry’s Agricultural Industry Innovation Policy Bureau. Organized by the ministry and the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, the event brought together former sniffer dogs, their handlers and their adoptive families for autumn sports and veterinary health seminars, serving as an operational review of Korea's evolving animal welfare policy. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国扩大退役工作犬福利待遇，帮助它们找到永久归宿
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国正加大力度，为退役工作犬寻找永久安身之所，通过建立全面、由国家出资的安全网，减轻收养家庭承受的高昂经济负担。在农业、食品和农村事务部主导的扩展计划下，政府将推出直接医疗补贴、优惠兽医服务和专门临终关怀设施，确保这些犬类公共服务犬在退役后仍能得到照护。目前约有1,100只工作犬服务于6个政府机构，包括军队、警察、消防、海关和检疫检验部门。其中，仅动植物检疫局就在主要国际旅行枢纽运营约70只专用侦测犬。多年来，退役工作犬的私人收养面临重重障碍。猎兔犬、拉布拉多犬和马里犬等专用犬种通常在8岁左右退役，此前已执行6至8年的现役任务。退役后，收养者还需承担高昂的医疗费用，用于治疗关节问题、牙科疾病以及它们在高强度工作生活中积累的慢性病。为降低收养门槛，该部与私人兽医团体、宠物食品制造商和保险公司合作，压减饲养成本。参与诊所的数量将从2024年的56家增至2026年的73家，并提供30%的治疗折扣；饲料供应商则对专用营养食品提供最高50%的折扣。今年4月，政府推出直接补贴计划，报销退役工作犬自付医疗账单和保险费的比例最高达60%，每只犬每年的补贴上限为100万韩元（725美元），每年最多覆盖100只退役犬。官员们还计划建立公共骨干兽医医院网络，并与4所重点国立大学的动物医院合作，提供补贴医疗服务。这些大学包括江原国立大学、忠北国立大学、忠南国立大学和全南国立大学。此外，相关计划正在推进，将建设专门的国家退役犬中心，为退役工作犬进行康复并寻找收养家庭，同时为无法安置到私人家庭的高龄或患病犬提供终身国家资助照护。该部农业产业创新政策局局长金正旭表示：“我们希望确保政府以适当的照护和尊严回报它们所作的贡献。”活动由该部与动植物检疫局组织， former 嗅探犬、训导员及其收养家庭参加秋季运动和兽医健康研讨会，作为对韩国不断完善的动物福利政策的一次实践检视。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: [WEEKENDER] Unknown at home, big abroad
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: These outliers have bypassed the process of building a reputation at home and instead ventured directly into overseas markets as they search for larger consumer bases than Korea.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 这些后来居上的企业绕过了在国内建立声誉的环节，直接进军海外市场，以寻找比韩国更大的消费者群体。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: This is the third in a four-part series on people and companies that connect Korea and the world, as special coverage marking The Korea Times' 76th anniversary. It is generally considered less risky for companies to first establish a robust consumer base in the country where they are based, giving them a comfort zone for operations like marketing, administration and customer service. Expanding into overseas markets would be a logical next step. Major Korean firms almost always follow this approach, building operational know-how and a strong domestic following before venturing into uncharted territories. Global expansion has become increasingly encouraging for Korean beauty and food firms thanks to their growing presence on the global stage. According to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, Korean beauty exports hit a record $11.4 billion in 2025, up 24.5 percent from 2021. Korean food exports also reached a record in 2025 at $10.4 billion, up 21.9 percent over the same period, according to the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. The booming global trade in these industries has encouraged some small and medium-sized Korean companies to aim high from the outset, targeting international consumers rather than the domestic market. These outliers have bypassed the process of building a reputation at home and instead ventured directly into overseas markets as they search for larger consumer bases than Korea. These bold ventures have paid off for some companies, driving sales growth in recent years and highlighting the need for more diverse product portfolios. Building on this success, these companies are now setting their sights on broader global markets, with the domestic market taking a back seat. Boosters, a Korean brand commerce company, acquired Eqqualberry in 2023, when the Korean skin care brand had a negligible market share. Recognizing its potential, Boosters began expanding the brand into global markets. Eqqualberry entered the U.S. market through e-commerce giant Amazon in 2024. It has since expanded its reach to Ulta Beauty's online store, Target Beauty Studio and Olive Young's U.S. platform. In the United Kingdom, the brand has also found room on the shelves at Boots, a major health, beauty and pharmacy chain. The brand’s products will start appearing at Ulta Beauty’s offline outlets starting in November. It has secured local distributors in 90 countries across the globe, and is now being sold in 130 nations. Boosters reported sales of 153 billion won ($116 million) last year, up from 72.8 billion won a year earlier. Operating profit more than doubled to 25.5 billion won from 9.1 billion won. In the first half of this year, sales surged 1,000 percent from a year earlier. Eqqualberry adopted a “global-first” strategy from the beginning, quickly gaining traction in overseas markets. Shortly after launching on Amazon's U.S. site, three of its products ranked among the platform’s top 10 serums. The brand’s serum-led product portfolio continues to drive sales growth. During Amazon Prime Day in October, its NAD+ Peptide Boosting lineup recorded sales nearly 20 times higher than during the same promotional event last year, helping lift Eqqualberry’s overall sales during the event to five times their earlier level. “We have localized marketing teams and in-house influencer analysis technology for each language and global region. We will continue to drive the expansion of Eqqualberry’s distribution channels across major global regions, including the Americas, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. Plans are underway also for expansion into the Asian market, including Korea," said Ko Ji-hoon, chief strategy officer at Boosters. The brand’s name is a portmanteau of “equally” to represent giving everyone time, “question” to represent the science of healthier skin, and the antioxidant effect of “berry” in the formulas for every product in the brand’s five lines. “We keep our products’ quality and consumer trust in check through Eqqualberry Check, an online platform dedicated to certifying our official products. We have also acquired approval from Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) in the U.S. and Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP) in Europe,” Ko said. “‘Good question. Eqqualberry has an answer.’ That is our motto.” The pasta and beverage brand, jointly launched this year by major Korean food company Paldo and probiotic beverage maker HY, first hit Walmart shelves in the U.S. in April. Consumer interest has been fueled by the involvement of K-pop group BTS, whose members reportedly took part in planning and launching the products. The brand is currently managed and operated by HY’s U.S. subsidiary, HYH. The company declined to disclose sales figures, citing the products having had a relatively short time on the market. However, it said customer reviews of ARIH’s Modern Noodle, Dual Biotic Soda and Postbiotic Energy Drinks on Walmart’s online channels gave the products an average rating of 4.5 out of 5. "Consumers are raving about Modern Noodle’s wide noodles, chewy texture and rich sauce, and the fruity flavors and smooth fizz of the drinks,” said Kim Eung-joon, head of HY’s public relation division. Positive reception in the U.S. has prompted HY and Paldo to expand ARIH into Japan and Canada. Launched at 7-Eleven stores across Japan in August, the brand logged more than 3.61 million sales by early September, with products selling out at some locations. In Canada, supermarket chains Loblaws and Real Canadian Superstore have introduced ARIH through their online channels. HYH has also organized a pop-up event in Toronto and a tasting booth at a Korean community festival in the city. “ARIH was designed as a global-first brand from its inception, with international market expansion serving as a core growth driver. The brand will implement localized marketing strategies tailored to each country’s distribution networks and consumer behavior, aiming to become a staple in the daily lives of consumers worldwide,” Kim said. He added that the brand’s partnership with BTS would continue. “Rather than a conventional artist-endorsed collaboration, ARIH was jointly developed with BTS from the initial conceptual stage, incorporating the group’s insights into the brand name, flavor profiles and packaging design," he said. "Leveraging this partnership and solid product quality, ARIH aims to sustain long-term growth in the global market.” Goodai Global’s makeup brand TIRTIR is among the pioneers of K-beauty’s global expansion. In June 2024, it became the first Korean beauty brand to top Amazon’s overall beauty category in the U.S. with its flagship product, Mask Fit Red Cushion. Since then, TIRTIR has expanded into Ulta Beauty in the U.S., Costco in Canada, Marionnaud and Rossmann in Europe, Nykaa in India and major retail outlets in Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, the Middle East and the Commonwealth of Independent States. Goodai Global has pursued a two-track strategy for TIRTIR by working with local content creators to showcase its products’ features and usability and communicating the brand’s philosophy and vision through global campaigns. “We identified distinct consumer profiles and retail environments in each global market before implementing localized marketing strategies. We will continue to drive sustainable global expansion through market-specific approaches,” a Goodai Global official said. Under the slogan “Be You, Be Confident,” TIRTIR has targeted global consumers with products designed to help them express their individuality. “TIRTIR is built on celebrating individuality and diversity, empowering everyone to confidently express their unique beauty through a versatile range of choices. Our Mask Fit Red Cushion began with just three shades and has now expanded to an impressive 45 shades, offering an inclusive lineup to match a wide array of skin tones and undertones,” the official said. Korean companies are increasingly looking overseas for growth. Craver Corp., which operates skin care brand SKIN1004, reported sales of more than 678 billion won last year, more than double the previous year's figure. In a January 2025 disclosure, the company said exports to the U.S., China, Japan and Southeast Asia accounted for 98 percent of the brand's total sales. Skin care company Torriden generated 113 billion won in overseas sales in the first half of this year, accounting for 62 percent of its total. According to a company disclosure in August, sales in Australia surged 254.8 percent from a year earlier, while sales in the U.S. and Canada rose 212.3 percent and 144.7 percent, respectively. The company recorded average annual growth of 135 percent over the past three years. Mixsoon, a skin care brand operated by Parket, has expanded into more than 100 countries, with overseas markets accounting for 95 percent of its sales. Pet food company Wooriwa, which operates research centers in western Seoul and Eumseong, North Chungcheong Province, exports to seven Asian countries. Through its U.S. subsidiary, the company is also targeting markets in the U.S., the Philippines, India, Australia, Russia and Mexico
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 【周末话题】在国内默默无闻，在海外声名显赫

这是《韩国时报》创刊76周年特别报道四部曲的第三篇，重点介绍连接韩国与世界的人物和公司。通常认为，企业先在总部所在国建立稳固的消费者基础风险较低，这能为其营销、行政管理和客户服务等运营提供熟悉的缓冲区。随后拓展海外市场将是合乎逻辑的下一步。韩国大型企业几乎都采取这种路线，在开拓未知市场前先积累运营经验并培育强大的本土追随者。随着韩国美妆和食品企业在全球舞台上的存在感不断增强，全球化扩张日益受到鼓舞。据韩国食品药品安全部称，2025年韩国化妆品出口额达到创纪录的114亿美元，较2021年增长24.5%。据韩国农林畜产食品部称，韩国食品出口额也在2025年创下新高，达到104亿美元，同期增长21.9%。这些行业全球贸易的蓬勃发展促使一些韩国中小企业从一开始就志在高远，将国际消费者而非国内市场作为目标。这些企业跳过了在本国建立声誉的阶段，直接进入海外市场，以寻找比韩国更大的消费群体。这些大胆尝试已为部分企业带来回报，推动其近年来销售额增长，并凸显出打造更多元产品组合的必要性。凭借这一成功，这些企业如今正把目光投向更广阔的全球市场，国内市场则退居次要位置。

韩国品牌电商公司Boosters于2023年收购了Eqqualberry，当时这家韩国护肤品牌的市场份额微不足道。Boosters看中其潜力，开始将品牌拓展至全球市场。2024年，Eqqualberry通过电商巨头Amazon进入美国市场。此后，其业务范围扩大至Ulta Beauty网店、Target Beauty Studio以及Olive Young美国平台。在英国，该品牌也进入了大型健康、美容和药房连锁店Boots的货架。该品牌产品将于11月起开始出现在Ulta Beauty的线下门店。该品牌已在全球90个国家 확보当地经销商，目前在130个国家销售。Boosters去年销售额为1530亿韩元（1.16亿美元），高于上年的728亿韩元。营业利润从91亿韩元增至255亿韩元，增幅超过一倍。今年上半年，销售额较上年同期激增1,000%。Eqqualberry从一开始就采取“全球优先”战略，迅速在海外市场获得认可。在Amazon美国网站上线后不久，其三款产品便跻身该平台精华液销量前10名。以精华液为主的产品组合继续推动销售额增长。10月Amazon Prime Day期间，其NAD+ Peptide Boosting系列销售额接近去年同期的20倍，帮助Eqqualberry在活动期间的总体销售额达到此前水平的5倍。Boosters首席战略官Ko Ji-hoon表示：“我们在各语言和各全球地区都设有本地化营销团队和内部网红分析技术。我们将继续推动Eqqualberry在美洲、欧洲、亚洲和中东等主要全球地区拓展分销渠道。我们也已制定计划，进一步进入包括韩国在内的亚洲市场。”该品牌名称是几个词的合成词：“equally”代表给予每个人时间，“question”代表更健康肌肤的科学，而“berry”则代表品牌旗下五条产品线每款配方所具有的抗氧化功效。Ko说：“我们通过Eqqualberry Check这一专门认证官方产品的在线平台，随时把控产品质量和消费者信任。我们还获得了美国《化妆品监管现代化法案》（MoCRA）和欧洲化妆品产品通报门户（CPNP）的批准。‘好问题，Eqqualberry有答案。’这是我们的口号。”

韩国大型食品公司Paldo与益生菌饮料制造商HY今年共同推出意大利面和饮料品牌ARIH，该品牌4月首次登陆美国Walmart的货架。由于韩流组合BTS成员据报参与了产品策划和推出，消费者兴趣得到进一步提升。该品牌目前由HY美国子公司HYH管理和运营。公司拒绝披露销售额，称产品上市时间相对较短。不过，公司表示，Walmart线上渠道消费者对ARIH的Modern Noodle、Dual Biotic Soda和Postbiotic Energy Drinks的平均评分为五星中的4.5分。HY公共关系部门负责人Kim Eung-joon表示：“消费者盛赞Modern Noodle面条宽、口感有嚼劲、酱汁浓郁，也称赞饮品的水果风味和顺滑气泡。”该品牌在美国的良好反响促使HY和Paldo将ARIH拓展至日本和加拿大。8月，该品牌在日本各地7-Eleven门店上市，截至9月初累计销量超过361万份，部分门店的产品已经售罄。在加拿大，超市连锁店Loblaws和Real Canadian Superstore已通过线上渠道引入ARIH。HYH还在多伦多举办快闪活动，并在该市的韩国社区节设置品鉴摊位。Kim表示：“ARIH从创立之初就按照全球优先品牌进行设计，拓展国际市场是核心增长驱动力。该品牌将实施本地化营销策略，适应各国分销网络和消费者行为，力争成为全球消费者日常生活中的常备选择。”他还表示，该品牌与BTS的合作将继续。“ARIH并非采用传统的艺人代言合作模式，而是从最初的概念构思阶段便与BTS共同开发，将该组合的见解融入品牌名称、风味定位和包装设计。我们将借助这一合作关系和扎实的产品质量，推动ARIH在全球市场实现长期增长。”

Goodai Global旗下化妆品牌TIRTIR是K-beauty全球扩张的先驱之一。2024年6月，TIRTIR凭借旗舰产品Mask Fit Red Cushion成为首个登顶Amazon美国站美容总类目的韩国美妆品牌。此后，TIRTIR进入美国Ulta Beauty、加拿大Costco、欧洲Marionnaud和Rossmann、印度Nykaa，以及日本、台湾、香港、中东和独联体的大型零售网点。Goodai Global对TIRTIR采取双轨战略：一方面与当地内容创作者合作，展示产品特点和使用体验；另一方面通过全球宣传活动传达品牌理念和愿景。Goodai Global一名负责人表示：“我们在实施本地化营销策略前，识别了每个全球市场不同的消费者画像和零售环境。我们将通过针对各市场的方法，继续推动可持续的全球扩张。”TIRTIR以“Be You, Be Confident”为口号，通过旨在帮助全球消费者展现个性的产品锁定全球消费者。该负责人表示：“TIRTIR以歌颂个性和多样性为核心理念，让每个人都能通过丰富多样的选择，自信展现自己的独特之美。我们的Mask Fit Red Cushion最初只有3个色号，如今已扩展到令人瞩目的45个色号，提供更具包容性的产品线，以匹配多种肤色和底色。”

韩国企业正越来越多地到海外寻找增长空间。运营护肤品牌SKIN1004的Craver Corp.去年销售额超过6780亿韩元，较上年翻了一倍以上。公司在2025年1月披露的信息显示，对美国、中国、日本和东南亚的出口占该品牌总销售额的98%。护肤公司Torriden今年上半年海外销售额达到1130亿韩元，占总销售额的62%。据公司8月披露的信息，其在澳大利亚的销售额同比增长254.8%，在美国的销售额增长212.3%，在加拿大的销售额增长144.7%。过去3年，该公司的年均增长率达到135%。由Parket运营的护肤品牌Mixsoon已拓展至100多个国家，海外市场贡献其95%的销售额。宠物食品公司Wooriwa在首尔西部和忠清北岛恩城设有研究中心，向7个亚洲国家出口产品。公司还通过美国子公司瞄准美国、菲律宾、印度、澳大利亚、俄罗斯和墨西哥市场

Unlock these with Subscription Over the past two decades, Indian consumers have become more selective in their choice of paints. Computerised tinting, textures, designer finishes and application-specific products have made colour and aesthetics more personalised than ever. According to industry experts, the next phase is bringing performance into the same decision-making process. Colour retention, washability, moisture behaviour, volatile organic compound (VOC) levels, fire performance and repainting intervals are becoming measurable attributes rather than technical details hidden in product literature. Though silicate mineral paints currently account for only about 1% of the industry, developers and asset owners are showing interest in them as India’s skyscrapers continue to grow taller. A high-rise residential tower, hospital, university, hotel or commercial development is built to last for decades, but its surfaces face continuous exposure to the elements and everyday wear from the day the building becomes operational. Façades withstand sunlight, heavy rain, humidity, dust, pollution and temperature changes. Interior walls face stains, repeated cleaning, physical contact and everyday wear. In dense urban environments, the condition of these surfaces influences not only maintenance budgets but also how buildings and neighbourhoods age visually. Frequent repainting of high-rise structures is impractical and expensive, particularly because of the challenges of working at height. Paint flakes can fall onto parked cars and streets or damage the windowpanes of neighbouring buildings. Paint companies are therefore developing durable coatings designed to last for several decades. Repainting an occupied tower also requires scaffolding or specialised access systems, safety arrangements, contractor coordination, resident permissions and measures to minimise disruption. Architects and developers are increasingly evaluating coatings for washability, weather resistance, lower emissions, fire performance, moisture management and service life. Raja Naidu, managing director of Bengaluru-based real estate developer Urban Excellence, says, “When surfaces demand frequent access, repairs and repainting, the cost is not just financial. It impacts the experience and confidence of everyone who lives in or uses the building. Choosing materials that continue to perform over the long term is, therefore, not just about durability; it is about building lasting value, trust and reputation.” Zydex, a Gujarat-based paint company, has partnered with German firm KEIM to manufacture and market its silicate mineral paints in India. The range comes with a 20-year performance assurance against colour fading and film failure, subject to specified conditions. For developers managing possession deadlines and resident welfare associations dealing with occupied buildings, the specification-to-execution chain can also influence turnaround time, reducing the duration of scaffolding, site disruption and maintenance activity. Amrendra Mishra, COO of Zydex Paints, says, “Specification and application must move together. Architects define the performance expected from a building, while trained applicators translate that expectation onto the actual surface.” “Our experience across large residential repainting projects, educational institutions such as Symbiosis, and commercial properties such as West End Mall has reinforced the value of this approach,” he adds. India’s paints market, currently valued at approximately ₹93,000 crore, according to the India Brand Equity Foundation (IBEF), is approaching the ₹1 lakh crore mark. As it grows, performance is emerging as a third axis of competition alongside aesthetics and price, particularly as urban buildings get taller, denser and more expensive to maintain, industry executives says. Premium acrylic paints cost ₹6-10 per sq.ft, while silicate mineral paints cost around ₹40-50 per sq.ft, even with 95% local production, according to industry inputs. That makes them seven to eight times more expensive than conventional acrylic paints. Silicate mineral paints bond with the wall instead of simply forming a film over it. They allow moisture vapour to escape while protecting the façade from the weather. They can also last longer than conventional paints, reducing the need for frequent repainting. The longevity of such coatings is illustrated by buildings that have used them for more than a century. KEIM’s silicate mineral paints have been used on buildings dating back to the 19th century. The Town Hall in Schwyz, Switzerland, was coated with KEIM mineral paint in 1891. According to the company, the original coating remains, although the façade has undergone retouching. India’s paint industry is also seeing growing interest in performance-led coatings, with durability, functionality and lifecycle costs becoming important considerations alongside aesthetics. Mark Titus, president of the decorative coatings business at Nippon Paint India, says its Weatherbond PRO with Quartz Technology, backed by a 16-year warranty, offers exterior protection through UV resistance, dirt pick-up resistance and protection against algae and fungi when used with the recommended base coat system. Its Heat Ban Technology can reduce exterior surface temperatures by up to 10 degrees Celsius under specified conditions. For interiors, Nippon Paint Spotless NXT combines anti-scuff and stain-repellent properties with washability and an ultra-low VOC formulation. Its Walltron Advance Thermal Comfort Solutions uses a multilayer coating system designed to reduce heat absorption and cooling requirements. The company cites potential reductions of 5-7 degrees Celsius in indoor temperatures and 20–25% in energy consumption, depending on building conditions and application coverage. According to Titus, developers are increasingly considering lifecycle costs, energy efficiency and sustainability when selecting coatings. While silicate mineral paints offer one approach to durability, multifunctional coatings represent another, with products designed to address maintenance, thermal comfort and surface protection. The performance figures cited by the company depend on application and site conditions. The suitability of coatings also depends on local climatic conditions. Coastal cities face humidity, salt-laden air and heavy rainfall, while northern cities experience intense summers, dust, pollution and sharp seasonal temperature changes. This makes the selection of coatings dependent on the substrate, climate and overall protection strategy rather than paint choice in isolation. When used alongside waterproofing, façade engineering and moisture management, mineral coatings can form part of a broader building-envelope strategy designed to maintain performance over time. “There is also a push to make everything more efficient and reduce friction overall, with the advent of quick-commerce and many at-home service platforms. For the paint industry, advances in computerised tinting, quick turnaround time, innovations like quick makeover services ,longer product warranties, and designer finishes have further expanded these possibilities,” he adds. As the industry evolves, the conversation around paints is also expanding to multi-sensorial aesthetics at the same time encompassing performance and longevity. Consumers and design professionals are increasingly looking at attributes such as tactility , hygiene , colour retention, washability, dirt & moisture resistance, VOC levels and ease of maintenance when making their choices. The opportunity for the industry lies in bringing these functional considerations together with design. Our Nilaya Arc range for interiors reflects this approach by combining the heritage of lime-based finishes which performs like a modern-day emulsion, and displays contemporary design sensibilities through artisanal matt and pearlescent finishes, over 200 heritage-inspired shades and features like stain cleanability with a low-VOC formulation. The changing landscape of Indian cities presents another important consideration for the paints industry. As urban development becomes increasingly vertical, developers and asset owners are placing greater emphasis on the durability and long-term maintenance of buildings. Repainting tall structures can be complex, making the selection of appropriate coatings an important part of long-term asset planning. This calls for technologically advanced solutions in waterproofing , repair , construction chemicals and aesthetically pleasing finishes that are suited to the building’s design, environmental exposure and performance requirements. As the built environment continues to evolve, we believe the industry must look beyond the immediate visual impact of a coating and focus on delivering lasting value through the right balance of aesthetics, durability and functionality.” For developers and asset owners, the choice of coatings increasingly involves balancing upfront costs and aesthetics against maintenance requirements and long-term performance. https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/.title_zh: 耐久涂料为何在印度房地产市场日益受青睐
https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/.body_zh: 订阅还可享有多项权益，包括独家报道、社论、观点文章等。订阅即可解锁。过去20年里，印度消费者在选择涂料时变得更加挑剔。电脑调色、纹理效果、设计师饰面以及针对特定用途的产品，使色彩和美观度比以往任何时候都更加个性化。据行业专家介绍，下一个阶段将把性能纳入同一套决策流程。保色性、可洗性、防潮表现、挥发性有机化合物（VOC）含量、耐火性能和重涂周期，正逐渐成为可量化的属性，而不再只是隐藏在产品资料中的技术细节。尽管硅酸盐矿物涂料目前仅占行业约1%，但随着印度的摩天大楼越建越高，开发商和资产所有者正对这类涂料表现出兴趣。高层住宅楼、医院、大学、酒店或商业开发项目的使用寿命可达数十年，但自建筑投入使用之日起，其表面便持续承受自然因素和日常磨损。外立面要经受阳光、暴雨、湿气、灰尘、污染和温度变化的考验。室内墙面则要面对污渍、反复清洁、人体接触和日常磨损。在人口密集的城市环境中，这些表面的状况不仅影响维护预算，也会影响建筑和社区在视觉上的老化程度。频繁重涂高层建筑既不现实又成本高昂，尤其是高空作业带来的种种挑战。漆片可能落到停放的汽车和街道上，也可能损坏邻近建筑的窗玻璃。因此，涂料企业正在开发可使用数十年的耐久涂层。对有人居住的高层建筑进行重涂，还需要搭设脚手架或使用专业高空作业系统、采取安全措施、协调承包商、取得住户许可，并尽量减少对正常生活的影响。建筑师和开发商正越来越重视评估涂层的可洗性、耐候性、较低排放、耐火性能、防潮管理和服务寿命。位于班加罗尔的房地产开发企业Urban Excellence董事总经理Raja Naidu表示：“当建筑表面需要频繁检修、维修和重涂时，付出的代价不只是金钱，还会影响所有居住或使用该建筑人士的体验和信心。因此，选择能够长期保持性能的材料，不仅关乎耐久性，更关乎为建筑积累持久价值、信任和声誉。”位于古吉拉特邦的涂料企业Zydex已与德国企业KEIM合作，在印度生产并销售硅酸盐矿物涂料。该系列在规定条件下提供20年性能保障，覆盖抗褪色和漆膜失效。对于需要把握交付期限的开发商，以及负责有人居住楼宇的住户福利协会而言，从规格确定到施工落地的整条链条也会影响周转时间，缩短脚手架搭设、工地扰动和维护作业的持续时间。Zydex Paints首席运营官Amrendra Mishra表示：“规格制定与施工应用必须同步推进。建筑师界定建筑所需的性能，由经过培训的施工人员将这一要求落实到实际表面上。”他补充道：“我们在大型住宅重涂项目、Symbiosis等教育机构，以及West End Mall等商业物业中的经验，进一步印证了这一做法的价值。”据India Brand Equity Foundation（IBEF）数据，印度涂料市场目前估值约为₹93,000 crore，正朝着₹1 lakh crore的规模逼近。行业人士表示，随着市场增长，在建筑越来越高、越来越密集、维护成本也越来越高的情况下，性能正与美观和价格并列，成为竞争的第三条轴线。据行业人士提供的信息，高级丙烯酸涂料每平方英尺售价为₹6-10，而硅酸盐矿物涂料即使实现95%的本地生产，每平方英尺售价也在₹40-50左右。这使其价格达到传统丙烯酸涂料的7至8倍。硅酸盐矿物涂料并非仅在墙面上形成一层漆膜，而是会与墙面结合。它们既能让水蒸气排出，又能保护外立面免受天气影响。这类涂料的使用寿命也可长于传统涂料，从而减少频繁重涂的需要。使用过这类涂层的建筑便能说明其持久性，有些建筑采用此类涂料已有百余年历史。KEIM的硅酸盐矿物涂料曾用于可追溯至19世纪的多座建筑。瑞士施维茨市政厅于1891年涂覆了KEIM矿物涂料。据该公司介绍，尽管外立面后来经过修饰处理，原有涂层仍然保留。印度涂料行业对性能导向型涂层的兴趣也日益增长，耐久性、功能性和全生命周期成本正与美观度一道成为重要考量。Nippon Paint India装饰涂料业务总裁Mark Titus表示，该公司的Weatherbond PRO采用Quartz技术，并提供16年保修；与推荐的配套底漆系统搭配使用时，可凭借抗紫外线、抗污垢附着以及防藻和防菌性能为外墙提供保护。其Heat Ban Technology在规定条件下最多可降低外墙表面温度10摄氏度。在室内产品方面，Nippon Paint Spotless NXT将防刮擦和防污性能与可洗性及超低VOC配方结合起来。其Walltron Advance Thermal Comfort Solutions采用多层涂装系统，旨在减少热量吸收和制冷需求。该公司表示，根据建筑条件和施工覆盖率，室内温度最多可降低5-7摄氏度，能源消耗最多可减少20–25%。Titus表示，开发商在选择涂层时，正越来越重视全生命周期成本、能源效率和可持续性。硅酸盐矿物涂料为提升耐久性提供了一种路径，多功能涂层则代表另一种选择，相关产品旨在同时应对维护、热舒适度和表面保护需求。该公司引用的性能数据取决于施工方法和现场条件。涂层是否适用还取决于当地气候条件。沿海城市面临湿气、含盐空气和强降雨，北方城市则要应对酷暑、灰尘、污染和剧烈的季节性气温变化。因此，涂层选择必须结合基层、气候和整体防护策略，不能仅凭涂料类别来决定。与防水、外立面工程和防潮管理结合使用时，矿物涂层可成为整体建筑围护策略的一部分，帮助建筑长期保持性能。他补充道：“随着即时零售和众多上门服务平台的出现，各行各业都在推动提高效率、减少摩擦。对涂料行业而言，电脑调色技术进步、快速交付周期、快速改造服务等创新、更长的产品保修期以及设计师饰面，进一步拓展了这些可能性。”随着行业发展，围绕涂料的讨论也在扩展，在涵盖性能和寿命的同时 increasingly 关注多感官美学。消费者和设计专业人士在作出选择时，越来越重视触感、卫生性能、保色性、可洗性、抗污垢和防潮能力、VOC含量以及维护便利性等属性。行业的机会在于把这些功能性考量与设计结合起来。我们面向室内市场的Nilaya Arc系列正体现这一思路，将石灰基饰面的传统优势与现代乳胶漆般的表现相结合，并通过手工哑光和珠光饰面、200多种源自传统风格的色调，以及易于清除污渍和低VOC配方，展现当代设计理念。印度城市格局的变化，也是涂料行业需要考虑的重要方面。随着城市开发日益向高空发展，开发商和资产所有者更加重视建筑的耐久性和长期维护。高层建筑的重涂作业可能十分复杂，因此，选择合适的涂层已成为长期资产规划的重要组成部分。这需要防水、维修、建筑化学品和美观饰面方面的先进技术，并使其适应建筑设计、环境暴露条件和性能要求。随着建成环境不断演变，我们认为，涂料行业必须超越涂层带来的即时视觉影响，通过在美观、耐久性和功能性之间实现适当平衡来创造持久价值。”对开发商和资产所有者而言，选择涂层时日益需要在前期成本和美观度之间，与维护要求和长期性能之间进行权衡。《The https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/31/karc.title: Kärcher boss: Less regulation, more action to get Europe and Germany fit again
https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/31/karc.summary: Its CEO warns of a 'perfect storm' and calls for a fitness plan for Germany and Europe. If other countries are already moving toward eliminating reporting obligations overall, this must send a clear signal to Germany and all Europe.
https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/31/karc.summary_zh: 其首席执行官警告称，一场“完美风暴”即将到来，并呼吁德国和欧洲制定健身计划。如果其他国家已经在全面朝着取消报告义务的方向迈进，这就必须向德国乃至整个欧洲发出明确信号。
https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/31/karc.body: Share Comments Add Euronews on Google Share Facebook Twitter Flipboard Send Reddit Linkedin Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads Whatsapp The opinions expressed in this article are those of the author and do not represent in any way the editorial position of Euronews. Kärcher, best known for its pressure washers, recorded €3.5 billion in sales in 2025 and employs 17,000 people worldwide. Its CEO warns of a 'perfect storm' and calls for a fitness plan for Germany and Europe. For some time now, we in Europe are facing a perfect storm. Geopolitical crises are casting a shadow over the European economy. The unpredictable trade policy of the U.S. keeps threatening, without warning, to raise tariffs and erect trade barriers – a toxic scenario for free global trade and export-oriented companies. Meanwhile, China is no longer merely a low-cost manufacturer but has become a highly aggressive technological competitor that, with its tremendous speed, threatens to outpace key European industries in future-oriented fields. What is often perceived as pure technological supremacy or even innovative strength is, however, largely the result of a well-targeted governmental industrial policy. Massive subsidies in key strategic industries, along with a currency policy artificially focused on competitiveness, are leading to noticeable market distortions and overcapacity. For private companies operating on a market-based basis, this creates an imbalance that makes fair global competition almost impossible. The consequences for the industrial heart of Europe are alarming. The loss of tens of thousands of industrial jobs and the decline in production volume show that deindustrialization is not an abstract threat – it is happening right now. When plant closures and production relocations are being negotiated in key German industries such as the automotive and manufacturing sectors, it must be clear even to the most optimistic observer: We are at a critical turning point. As a family-owned company with 170 subsidiaries in 87 countries, Kärcher has weathered these turbulent times robustly thanks to its balanced business model – combining B2B ( editor's note: Business to Business, i.e. corporate customers ) and B2C ( editor's note: Business to Consumer, i.e. private customers ) – and its unconditional focus on customers. We are investing significantly in research and development, setting new standards in autonomous cleaning robots and battery technologies, and driving digitalization across all areas of the company. However, even innovation leaders cannot withstand increasingly challenging operating conditions and unfair competition in the long term. Considering the massive rise in structural and employee costs, expanding capacity or increasing headcount in domestic production is no longer economically feasible. While the latest economic forecasts – which expect Germany’s growth to return to 1.3 percent this year – seem cautiously optimistic at first glance, we must not be misled by this modest increase. What we are seeing here is largely “borrowed growth,” artificially driven by special government funds, defense contracts, and subsidies. A short-term boost fueled by debt is no substitute for a real, self-sustaining recovery in private investments. And the causes of the ongoing weakness are largely homegrown: a creeping reform fatigue and a regulatory frenzy on the part of government institutions that hinders rather than facilitates investment. Instead of promoting entrepreneurship, regulations from Brussels to Berlin are suffocating the courage to embrace change. The ongoing uncertainty among people in Germany is also having an impact on society. The rise of political extremism is a clear sign that many people are calling for greater reliability and noticeable reforms. To regain confidence in our country’s economic strength and future viability, we now need clear direction and bold action. For me personally, the attitude towards “working hard” has been ingrained in me since childhood on my parents’ family farm. Success doesn’t just fall from the sky; for me, it consists of 97 percent hard work and dedication, 2 percent talent, and 1 percent luck. If we want to secure our prosperity and our social standards, we must once again recognize that value creation is the precondition for prosperity – and not the other way around. If you rest, you rust – that applies to people just as much as it does to economies. That is why we need a real fitness program for Germany. Rigid rules, excessive bureaucracy, high energy costs, and steadily rising non-wage labor costs are poison for our business environment. If the total amount of social security contributions consistently far exceeds the historically critical threshold of 40 percent, then tax breaks, selective government subsidies, and special funds will amount to nothing more than ineffective paper measures as long as the business environment itself remains entrenched in its current state. While the federal government’s political reform efforts are heading in the right direction, they fall far short of what is needed. Instead of tackling the root of the problem, authorities are allowing a flood of regulations to continue – regulations that tie up valuable employee time and cost our companies millions. Money and personnel that are needed for core business operations and innovation are being wasted on documentation requirements alone. This cannot be solved with cosmetic fixes. We need the courage to provide real relief. A key lever for this would be, for example, a cultural shift within the administrative system: In the future, government departments must see themselves as digital enablers and service-oriented partners to the economy – pragmatic, fast, and AI-supported. If other countries are already moving toward eliminating reporting obligations overall, this must send a clear signal to Germany and all Europe. Furthermore, we should not avoid necessary debates on the labor market. Demographic trends require an increase in the overall volume of work in the economy. Incentives for overtime, flexible working hours, practical rules regarding continued pay during medical leave, and a noticeable reduction in bureaucracy when employing skilled workers are essential. Those who reflexively condemn such debates as an attack on workers’ rights are turning a blind eye to reality and putting precisely those jobs at risk that they claim to be protecting. At the same time, we need a resolute trade policy at the European level that guarantees fair competition and consistently punishes rule-breakers – because free trade only works when everyone follows the same rules. If we truly want to secure our competitiveness in the long term, we don’t need a bureaucratic approach – we need a return to a can-do mentality: less regulation, more personal responsibility, ambitious investment incentives, reliable framework conditions, and, above all, the courage to tackle issues properly and comprehensively once again. Real change begins in the mind – it’s time to act. Alfred Kärcher SE & Co. KG was founded in 1935 and generated almost 3.5 billion euros in revenue in 2025. The family-owned company based in Winnenden, Germany, earns 86 percent of this abroad. The Kärcher Group operates 170 companies in 87 countries and employs 17,000 people worldwide. Kärcher's portfolio comprises more than 3,000 products for cleaning and care, with Kärcher high-pressure cleaners being particularly well known
https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/31/karc.title_zh: Kärcher老板：减少监管、采取更多行动，让欧洲和德国重焕活力
https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/31/karc.body_zh: 分享 评论 在 Google 上添加 Euronews 分享至 Facebook Twitter Flipboard 发送至 Reddit Linkedin Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads WhatsApp 本文表达的观点仅代表作者本人，不代表 Euronews 的任何编辑立场。Kärcher 以高压清洗机最为人所知，2025年实现销售额35亿欧元，在全球拥有17,000名员工。其首席执行官警告称，一场“完美风暴”已然来袭，并呼吁为德国和欧洲制定一份健身计划。一段时间以来，我们欧洲正面临一场完美风暴。地缘政治危机给欧洲经济蒙上阴影。美国难以预测的贸易政策不断毫无预警地威胁提高关税、设置贸易壁垒，这对全球自由贸易和出口导向型企业而言是一个有毒局面。与此同时，中国已不再只是低成本制造国，而已成为极具进攻性的技术竞争对手；凭借惊人的发展速度，中国未来有望在未来导向型领域超越欧洲的关键产业。然而，人们往往视为纯粹技术优势、甚至创新实力的东西，在很大程度上是政府精准制定产业政策的结果。对关键战略行业提供巨额补贴，再加上人为聚焦竞争力的货币政策，正导致明显的市场扭曲和产能过剩。这给以市场为基础运营的私营企业造成失衡，使公平的全球竞争几乎无法实现。这对欧洲工业心脏地带造成的后果令人警惕。数以万计的工业岗位流失以及产量下滑表明，去工业化并非抽象威胁——它正在当下发生。当德国汽车业和制造业等关键行业正在协商关闭工厂、转移生产时，即使最乐观的观察者也必须明白：我们正处在一个关键的转折点。Kärcher 是一家家族企业，在87个国家拥有170家子公司。凭借均衡的商业模式——结合企业对企业业务（编者注：Business to Business，即企业客户）和企业对消费者业务（编者注：Business to Consumer，即私人客户）——以及始终以客户为重，公司稳健地挺过了这些动荡时期。我们正在大力投资研发，在自主清洁机器人和电池技术方面树立新标准，并推动公司各领域的数字化。然而，即便是创新领导者，也无法长期承受日益严峻的经营环境和不公平竞争。鉴于结构性成本和员工成本大幅上涨，扩大国内产能或增加国内生产人员人数已不再具备经济可行性。最新经济预测认为德国今年增长率将回升至1.3%，乍看之下似乎较为乐观，但我们不能被这一温和增长所蒙蔽。我们在这里看到的增长很大程度上属于“借来的增长”，靠特殊政府资金、国防合同和补贴人为推动。依靠债务煽动的短期提振，无法替代私人投资真正实现自我 sustaining 的复苏。持续疲软的根源也很大程度上来自国内：改革疲劳逐渐滋生，政府机构监管狂热，阻碍而非促进投资。布鲁塞尔到柏林出台的法规并未促进创业精神，反而扼杀了拥抱变革的勇气。德国民众持续弥漫的不确定性也对社会造成影响。政治极端主义抬头是一个明确信号，表明许多人要求更高的可靠性和显著的改革。为了重塑对国家经济实力和未来生存能力的信心，我们如今需要明确方向和大胆行动。就我个人而言，“辛勤工作”的态度从我在父母家庭农场度过的童年时代便已深入人心。成功不会从天而降；对我而言，它由97%的辛勤工作与奉献、2%的天赋和1%的运气构成。如果我们想守护繁荣和社会生活水平，就必须再次认识到，创造价值是繁荣的前提，而非结果。休息就会生锈——这句话既适用于个人，也适用于经济。因此，我们需要为德国制定真正的健身计划。僵化的规则、过度官僚化、高昂能源成本以及持续上涨的非工资劳动成本，都是我们商业环境的毒药。如果社会保障缴费总额持续远高于历史上40%的关键临界线，那么，只要商业环境本身仍深陷现状，税收减免、选择性政府补贴和专项资金就不过是无效的纸面措施。尽管联邦政府的政治改革努力方向正确，但远未达到实际所需。有关部门没有解决根本问题，反而任由大量法规继续出台——这些法规耗费宝贵员工时间，令企业损失数百万欧元。核心业务运营和创新所需的资金与人员，仅因文件归档要求就被浪费。这种问题无法靠表面修补解决。我们需要拿出勇气提供真正的减负。一个关键杠杆，例如，是推动行政系统内部的文化转变：今后，政府部门必须把自己视为数字赋能者和服务导向的经济伙伴——务实、高效，并由人工智能提供支持。如果其他国家已经在全面取消报告义务方面取得进展，这必须向德国和整个欧洲发出明确信号。此外，我们不应回避围绕劳动力市场展开的必要讨论。人口结构变化要求经济中的总体工作量增加。鼓励加班、推行弹性工时、制定病假期间照常发薪的务实规则，以及在雇用技术工人时明显减少官僚程序，都至关重要。那些本能地谴责此类讨论是 attacks on workers’ rights 的人，正对现实视而不见，恰恰危及他们声称要保护的岗位。与此同时，我们还需要在欧洲层面实行坚决的贸易政策，确保公平竞争，并持续惩治违规者——因为自由贸易只有在所有人遵守同一套规则时才有效。如果我们真想长期确保竞争力，就不需要官僚主义做法，而是需要重振敢作敢为的心态：减少监管、强化个人责任、提供雄心勃勃的投资激励、营造可靠的框架条件，最重要的是，再次拿出勇气妥善、全面地解决问题。真正的改变始于观念——是时候行动了。Alfred https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026103015.title_zh: “韩国大祭典”安东站在安东西侧正式开幕……促进消费
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026103015.body_zh:
（首尔=韩联社）记者 구정모 报道：中小企业和初创企业部于31日在庆尚北道安东举行全国性消费庆典“第2届韩国大庆典”正式开幕式，全面启动促进消费活动。“韩国大庆典”是政府整合各部门消费活动、以激活内需和促进地区消费为目的的国家级消费庆典，将从上月29日至下月15日在全国举行，持续18天。在旧安东站附近的安东区市场，开幕式当天举行了蒸鸡庆典；中央新市场、龙上市场等地也举办夜市、美食与体验活动及赠品活动。中小企业和初创企业部表示，还运行了与开幕式及安东主要旅游景点联动的八道旅游列车，引导游客到访当地并消费商圈。当天的开幕式上，总理韩成淑、中小企业和初创企业部长李昭英、国家报勋部长权奥乙、国民力量党议员金炯东、庆尚北道经济副知事杨金熙、安东市副市长李志宪等主要嘉宾及约2000名当地居民和游客出席。包括韩总理在内的主要嘉宾在开幕式前探访附近商铺，品尝安东代表性美食蒸鸡、购买商品，并鼓励小商贩。随后举行的“共生演唱会”上， trot歌手宋佳仁、李灿元、比特弗拉豪斯、希克斯、Candy Shop等进行了表演。

本届活动期间，全国线上线下流通渠道将推出优惠活动，并提供地区爱商品券追加优惠、数字온누리商品券折扣率上调、共生消费彩票等多项消费优惠。国务委员们表示，为扩散全国促进消费的氛围，将持续走访各地现场，直至活动结束。

Unlock these with Subscription If you are looking for an adventure this winter, skip the usual spots and head to the 14th-Century fort complex on Bahadur Shah Zafar Road known as Kotla Firoz Shah. Sultan Firoz Shah, the third emperor of the Tughlaq dynasty, built it after reluctantly inheriting the throne from his mad cousin, Muhammad Bin Tughlaq. The citadel became part of the fifth city of Delhi, known as Firozabad, which, according to 14th-Century historian Afif, extended to kush-e-shikar, near Delhi’s North campus. But the citadel of Firoz Shah is famous not just for its history, but for the unseen residents within it. Every Thursday, hundreds of believers come to the ASI monument to appeal to the fort’s djinns. Djinns, jinns, genies, and jinn mamu are some of the names given to these supernatural beings intrinsic to Islamic belief. They occupy the space between popular imagination, religious beliefs, and folklore. For many believers, djinns are not just legends or creatures of folklore. They live in a world alongside ours, invisible to most. Many believe the population of djinns outnumbers that of humans. The Arabic root word ‘j-n-n’ means concealment or ‘unseen ’, which lies at the heart of belief in djinn. The mythological legends of djinns predate the Quran . According to tradition, djinns were created from smokeless fire, humans from clay and angels from light. Djinns, like humans, have finite lives, but they are stronger, can shapeshift, and live longer. They can choose between good and evil, and are accountable for their actions. It is an imagined parallel society with its own moral choices. Offering sugar and milk is common in the abode of djinns, in hopes of protection and relief. Kotla Firoz Shah is not a monument often visited by travellers or tourists. Only on Thursday is the monument abuzz with activity. From two in the afternoon, when entry is free, devotees arrive in the hundreds, drawn not by the medieval fort but by the djinns that inhabit it. The citadel’s entrance is a battered, broken bastion with arrow slits still visible. Upon entering, guard rooms with broken quartz sit alongside the entrance. Walk further into the complex and the heavy scent of incense and rose petals begins to overpower everything else. Devotees move around with petitions, prayers and offerings, hoping to have their complaints heard by the djinns. The fort stood on the banks of the River Yamuna, whose course has since shifted East of the city. The complex included halls of public audience, residential quarters, a hall of private audience, women’s quarters, a grape vineyard, circular baoli, mosque, and Hawa Mahal. Much of the fort has since fallen into disrepair, with stone quarried to build later forts and cities in Delhi, including Shahjahanabad. The most striking life of the citadel is not its architectural ambitions but the religious significance it holds amongst the believers. Inside the complex, one striking, unusual structure is the Hawa Mahal, or the pyramid of cells. The building was once connected to the Jama Masjid mosque inside the complex by a bridge. The pyramid of cells is probably the most well-known and significant structure in the complex, topped by an Ashokan pillar. The Hawa Mahal has small vaulted chambers surrounded by a terrace. As you enter the fenced structure, a winding staircase takes you to each level, with dark chambers lit only by light from the entrance. The three-tiered structure, with diminishing floors, offered a commanding view of the Yamuna from its roof. For devotees, the pyramid is more than a medieval monument; it is considered to be the house of djinns. Inside the chambers lie offerings of sugar candies, incense, and rose petals along with handwritten letters to the unseen djinns. These letters of complaint or ‘shikwah’ speaks troubles of the devotees which they may find harder to share elsewhere. These complaints can be about anything: lovers’ quarrels, a cruel mother-in-law, an indifferent husband, financial or health problems. No grievance is considered too trivial that it cannot be brought to the djinns. For many women who visit Kotla, the Hawa Mahal is affectionately called ‘babul’ or ‘mayika’, the parental home where a woman can take refuge. The djinns are considered as protective brothers who will listen and solve problems without judgment. This relationship is reflected in how children call the unseen beings as ‘djinn mamu’, or maternal uncle. The letters themselves look like formal petitions. The believers also attach a passport size photo and address almost filing an official complaint. It is believed that the king of djinns Iblees holds a court every evening in Kotla Firoz Shah and decides which complaints require immediate action. The process has its own rhythm, devotees return every Thursday, week after week, to get their complaint heard. When a wish is fulfilled the devotees express their gratitude by offering prayer at the Jama Masjid and offering biryani to everyone. When did djinns arrive at Kotla Firoz Shah? In his book Jinneology , anthropologist Anand Vivek Taneja traces the practice to the period 1975-1977, during India’s Emergency and the political unrest it caused in the city. The forced sterlisation campaign caused widespread distress within the city’s poor. People from areas such as Turkman Gate, Pahadganj, and Seelampur started coming to Kotla Firoz Shah. Over time, the citadel’s reputation as the house of djinns firmly took shape in popular imagination. According to the urban legend, a bootlegger named Naseen came to the citadel and sat under the Ashokan Pillar. He started playing the flute and enchanted the djinn of Kotla Firoz Shah, who fell madly in love with him. His son Chand claims that his father, since then, had the blessings of the djinn. Another popular legend is that of Ladoo Shah, who was displaced from Turkman Gate, started living in the fort and was blessed with extraordinary powers by the djinns. Soon, the rumour spread that Ladoo Shah could perform miracles, and people began flocking there. For Taneja, such places of worship and belief grew where the government failed to address people’s grievances. Where official institutions offered little relief, people sought another avenue of justice and protection. Visiting the abode of djinns comes with its own set of unwritten rules. Devotees are advised not to keep their hair open, or wear perfume and to treat animals with kindness, they can be forms of djinns. According to belief, even the taq or the alcoves of the walls needs to be kept open to let djinns pass through. As evening falls over Kotla Firoz Shah, the djinn’s nightly court takes over. This is the insaaf ki jagah, the court of justice where all decisions are weighed. In Delhi, the supernatural needs no festival or costume.
