Make VnExpress a preferred source to prioritise our updates in your Google search results Vietnam and China should expand cooperation in manufacturing, technology and logistics to strengthen their roles in global supply chains, officials and business leaders said. At a seminar titled "Vietnam-China Businesses: Connecting Manufacturing, Logistics, and Global Value Chains" on Oct. 29, speakers called for closer economic integration beyond traditional trade. The event was part of the 2026 Autumn Economic Forum in Ho Chi Minh City. Xu Shou, acting consul general of China in HCMC, said the two economies had complementary industrial structures and supply chains. "Cooperation between Chinese and Vietnamese businesses has moved beyond traditional trade in goods into a new phase of supply chain coordination, technology exchange, and knowledge sharing," he said. Chinese companies have experience in smart manufacturing, modern logistics and innovation and are ready to deepen cooperation with Vietnamese partners, Xu said. He called for stronger links between suppliers and downstream businesses, as well as collaboration in technology transfer, process management, quality control and workforce training. China is Vietnam's largest trading partner, with bilateral trade exceeding US$256 billion in 2025. Trade reached more than $253 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up 37.6% year-on-year. During the same period, investors from China, including Hong Kong, received licenses for 1,104 new projects in Vietnam, with registered capital of $4.5 billion, up 31.35%. China ranked fourth among Vietnam's investment partners, with manufacturing accounting for about 80.61% of registered capital. Yang Wen Bin, acting chairman of the HCMC Chapter of the Chinese Business Association in Vietnam, said the figures reflected Vietnam's investment appeal and the potential for greater cooperation in manufacturing, logistics and supply chains. Yang Wen Bin, Acting Chairman of the HCMC Chapter of the Chinese Business Association in Vietnam, speaks at the 2026 Autumn Economic Forum in HCMC on Oct. 29, 2026. Photo courtesy of AEF 2026 Yang urged businesses to expand cooperation in advanced manufacturing, electronics, information technology, green energy and supporting industries, alongside technology exchanges, workforce training and investment partnerships. He said deeper integration could help Vietnamese businesses participate more extensively in regional and global production networks. Jesse Choi, CEO of Sunwah Group in Southeast Asia and Sunwah Innovations, and chairman of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Entrepreneurs Alliance in Vietnam, said closer manufacturing and supply chain ties could support cooperation in technology, logistics, finance and human resource development. Sunwah established Sunwah Innovations in 2020. Its innovation spaces in HCMC, Hanoi and Da Nang connect businesses, startups, universities and investors with partners in China and other markets. Through exchange programs, business networking and technology partnerships, the initiative helps commercialize research, connect technology solutions with domestic demand and give Vietnamese businesses access to international opportunities, Choi said. Speakers also called for stronger road, waterway and railway connections, smart border gates, digital supply chains, information sharing and harmonized technical standards. Xu urged both countries to pursue joint ventures in areas including urban railways, innovative trade platforms and cross-border finance to deepen their participation in global value chains. At a meeting with a delegation from the Research Office of China's State Council on Oct. 27, Vietnamese Deputy Minister of Finance Nguyen Thi Bich Ngoc outlined five pillars for bilateral cooperation. She called for stronger manufacturing supply chain links, technology cooperation and research and development, as well as strategic infrastructure development, particularly the Lao Cai-Hanoi-Hai Phong railway. Ngoc also proposed closer logistics links, smart border gates and customs cooperation to reduce trade costs, and encouraged Chinese financial institutions to participate in Vietnam's international financial center

https://e.vnexpress.net/news/business/vi.body_zh: 香港机场成为首家获得国际数字身份认证的机场；亚洲第二大富豪在创纪录首次公开募股后跻身全球富豪财富损失榜前列；亚洲最受欢迎岛屿10个月接待210万外国游客，超过2026年目标；亚洲第二大最佳机场值机中断，13家航空公司受到影响；中国辍学生打造“绿 goblin”式飞行滑板并骑行穿越亚洲最长河流；新加坡男子因两年前购买的音箱在马来西亚边境被征税；新加坡国立大学科学家开发出全球首款可水洗并织入服装的触摸屏；新加坡裁缝成为首位赢得意大利高级定制奖的非意大利人；与新加坡富豪郭庆荣旗下Hong Leong有关的合资企业出价1.42亿美元竞购优质住宅地块；新加坡最大贷款机构否认与印度尼西亚首富旗下银行合并。--> 越南新闻VnExpress 2026年10月30日 | 太平洋时间下午6时33分 在Google搜索中查看VnExpress优先显示，查看更多你信赖的新闻。让VnExpress成为首选来源，在Google搜索结果中优先获取我们的更新。官员和商界领袖表示，越南和中国应扩大制造业、技术和物流合作，以加强两国在全球供应链中的作用。在10月29日举行的“越南—中国企业：连接制造业、物流与全球价值链”研讨会上，与会者呼吁在传统贸易之外加强经济一体化。此次活动是2026年秋季经济论坛的一部分，论坛在胡志明市举行。中国驻胡志明市总领事徐爽表示，两国经济结构和供应链具有互补性。他说：“中越企业之间的合作已经超越传统货物贸易，进入供应链协调、技术交流和知识共享的新阶段。”徐爽表示，中国企业在智能制造、现代物流和创新方面拥有经验，并准备与越南伙伴深化合作。他呼吁加强供应商与下游企业之间的联系，并在技术转移、流程管理、质量控制和劳动力培训方面开展合作。中国是越南最大的贸易伙伴，2025年双边贸易额超过2560亿美元。2026年前九个月，双边贸易额超过2530亿美元，同比增长37.6%。同期，来自中国及香港的投资者获准在越南投资1104个新项目，注册资本45亿美元，同比增长31.35%。中国在越南投资伙伴中排名第四，制造业约占注册资本的80.61%。中国企业在越南协会胡志明市分会代理主席杨文彬表示，这些数据反映了越南对投资的吸引力，以及双方在制造业、物流和供应链领域扩大合作的潜力。杨文彬于2026年10月29日在胡志明市举行的2026年秋季经济论坛上发言。照片由AEF 2026提供。杨文彬呼吁企业在先进制造、电子、信息技术、绿色能源和配套产业扩大合作，同时加强技术交流、劳动力培训和投资伙伴关系。他说，更深层次的一体化能够帮助越南企业更广泛地参与区域和全球生产网络。Sunwah集团东南亚及Sunwah Innovations首席执行官、在越南粤港澳大湾区企业家联盟主席Jesse Choi表示，加强制造业和供应链联系能够支持双方在技术、物流、金融和人力资源开发方面的合作。Sunwah于2020年成立Sunwah Innovations。其位于胡志明市、河内和岘港的创新空间，将企业、初创企业、大学和投资者同中国及其他市场的伙伴连接起来。Choi表示，该项目通过交流计划、商业联谊和技术合作，推动研究成果商业化，将技术解决方案与国内需求对接，并为越南企业提供接触国际机遇的平台。与会者还呼吁加强公路、水路和铁路连接，建设智能边境口岸，发展数字供应链，推动信息共享和技术标准协调一致。徐爽敦促两国在城市轨道、创新贸易平台和跨境金融等领域成立合资企业，以加深两国对全球价值链的参与。在10月27日会见中国国务院研究室代表团时，越南财政部副部长阮氏碧玉提出双方合作的五大支柱。她呼吁加强制造业供应链联系、技术合作与研发，以及战略基础设施建设，尤其是老街—河内—海防铁路项目。阮氏碧玉还提议加强物流联系、建设智能边境口岸并开展海关合作，以降低贸易成本，同时鼓励中国金融机构参与越南国际金融中心建设。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/31/w.summary: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has said that he rejected the prospect of moving to the National Assembly after completing his eight-year tenure as governor of Rivers State. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/31/w.body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has said that he rejected the prospect of moving to the National Assembly after completing his eight-year tenure as governor of Rivers State. Wike, who gave this insight yesterday during the inauguration of a pedestrian bridge constructed by Dunamis International Gospel Centre in Abuja, where he also delivered a strong message on leadership, accountability and service to humanity, said he was unwilling to surrender his freedom to speak his mind for the privilege of becoming a senator. Wike said he deliberately chose not to pursue a Senate seat because he believed the position could limit his ability to express his opinions freely, particularly on issues concerning the state of the nation. The minister took a swipe at the growing tendency among former governors to seek legislative positions after leaving office, declaring he was never attracted to the National Assembly because of the restrictions he believed would come with the position. “Many governors today, when they are done, they want to go to the National Assembly, but I said that I won’t go. They asked me why, and I said I would be prevented from speaking my mind. Since I won’t be able to speak my mind, there is no need for me to go there,” he said. The former Rivers governor insisted that he preferred to occupy positions where he could freely express his views, adding that he had consistently spoken about national issues wherever he found himself. “That is true. Everybody has forgotten what this country was before now,” he added. Wike used the occasion to commend the Senior Pastor of the church, Dr. Paul Enenche, and his wife, Becky, for demonstrating what he described as practical leadership through an investment that benefits people beyond the congregation. “Watching the documentary and seeing what you have done, touching lives, not only with your soul, but talking about the welfare of other people, that is leadership,” the minister said. He argued that leadership should not be measured by titles, political positions or public declarations but by concrete achievements and the willingness to deploy available resources to improve people’s lives. According to him, individuals entrusted with authority must be prepared to account for their stewardship, insisting that public office holders should be able to point to tangible contributions made during their time in office. Wike also urged Nigerians to look beyond social media narratives when assessing leaders, stressing the need to evaluate their performance through verifiable accomplishments. He encouraged religious institutions, corporate organisations and individuals to complement government efforts by investing in projects that address pressing community needs. Earlier, Enenche said the church’s commitment to humanity required practical demonstrations of love through giving, sacrifice and service to society. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/31/w.title_zh: 维凯：担任 Rivers 州长两届后为何拒绝进入参议院
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/31/w.body_zh: 联邦首都领地（FCT）部长Nyesom Wike表示，在完成担任Rivers州州长的8年任期后，他拒绝考虑进入国民议会。Wike昨天在阿布贾举行的Dunamis International Gospel Centre所建人行桥启用仪式上透露了这一点，并在仪式上就领导力、问责制和服务人类发表了有力信息。他说，不愿为了成为参议员的殊荣而放弃畅所欲言的自由。Wike表示，他有意不竞选参议院席位，因为他认为该职位可能限制他自由表达意见的能力，尤其是在涉及国家状况的问题上。这位部长批评了前州长卸任后寻求立法职务的趋势日益明显，并宣称自己从未被吸引进入国民议会，因为他认为担任该职位会伴随种种限制。他说：“如今许多州长任期结束后，都想进入国民议会，但我说了，我不会去。他们问我为什么，我说我会无法畅所欲言。既然无法畅所欲言，我就没有必要去那里。”这位Rivers州前州长坚持认为，他更愿意担任能够自由表达观点的职务，并补充说，无论身在何处，他都一贯就国家问题发表评论。他补充道：“确实如此。所有人都忘了这个国家从前是什么样子。”Wike借此机会赞扬了该教会的高级牧师Dr. Paul Enenche及其妻子Becky，称他们通过一项惠及会众之外民众的投资，展示了何为他所称的务实领导力。这位部长说：“观看纪录片，看到你们所做的事，不仅触及人们的心灵，还关注他人的福祉，这就是领导力。”他认为，领导力不应以头衔、政治职位或公开声明来衡量，而应以实际成就以及调动现有资源改善人们生活的意愿来衡量。据他所说，受托掌权的人必须准备为自己的施政表现承担责任，并坚持公职人员应能指出任职期间作出的切实贡献。Wike还敦促尼日利亚人在评价领导人时超越社交媒体上的叙事，强调需要通过可核实的成就来评估其表现。他鼓励宗教机构、企业组织和个人通过投资解决社区迫切需求的项目，补充政府的工作。Enenche早些时候表示，教会对人类的奉献需要通过给予、牺牲和服务社会来切实体现爱的精神。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，THISDAY通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层提供服务，同时成为有抱负者和千禧一代探索新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，触及人民与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102819.summary_zh: 路过附近后前来参观展馆的尹某说：“听说BYD销量很好，我很好奇，亲自看后觉得还不错。”不过他表示：“我担心中国汽车的安全和安保问题，也不好说3至4年后是否还会出问题。”展馆经理朴元均说：“因为是中国品牌，可能存在偏见，但我感觉消费者的认识比1年前积极了很多。大家都说产品好、价格也合适。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102819.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김윤구 기자 = 지난 28일 서울 용산의 BYD 전시장. 평일 오후에도 BYD 차량을 직접 살펴보려는 소비자들의 발길이 이어졌다. 근처에 왔다가 전시장을 찾았다는 윤모 씨는 "BYD가 잘 팔린다니 궁금했는데 직접 보니 괜찮아 보인다"고 말했다. 다만 "중국차는 보안이나 안전에 대한 걱정이 있다"며 "차가 3∼4년 뒤에도 문제없을지 모르겠다"고 했다. 전시장의 박원균 매니저는 "중국 브랜드라 편견이 있을 수 있지만 1년 전보다 소비자들의 인식이 많이 긍정적으로 바뀌었다고 느낀다"면서 "상품이 좋고 가격이 좋다고 한다"고 말했다. 가격 경쟁력을 앞세운 BYD는 지난해 한국 시장에 진출해 시장을 적극적으로 공략하고 있다. 올해 국내 판매 대수는 이미 2만대를 넘어섰다. 한국수입자동차협회에 따르면 BYD의 올해 1∼9월 국내 신규 등록 대수는 2만137대에 이른다. 지난 9월에는 수입차 브랜드 가운데 테슬라, BMW, 메르세데스-벤츠에 이어 4위를 차지했다. 전기 해치백 돌핀과 중형 전기 스포츠유틸리티차(SUV) 씨라이언7이 나란히 7천대 넘게 팔리며 판매를 이끌었다. 돌핀은 시작 가격이 2천450만원부터이며 씨라이언7 가격은 4천490만∼5천390만원이다. BYD는 플러그인하이브리드차량(PHEV) '씨라이언 6 DM-i'도 출시하고 TV 광고를 내보내며 공격적인 마케팅에 나섰다. 블룸버그도 최근 BYD가 가격과 기술력을 앞세워 한국 시장에서 빠르게 성장하면서 현대차·기아를 위협하고 있다고 지적했다. 같은 기간 국가별 수입차 신규 등록 점유율에서는 중국이 7.22%로 일본(7.21%)을 근소하게 앞서 독일과 미국에 이어 3위에 올랐다. 중국 지리자동차의 프리미엄 전기차 브랜드 지커는 이달 중형 전기 SUV '7X'로 국내 소비자를 처음 만났다. 샤오펑과 체리자동차도 한국 시장 진출을 준비하고 있다. 두 업체는 국내 법인을 설립했으며, 샤오펑은 한국 사업을 담당할 인력 채용에도 나섰다. 중국승용차시장정보연석회(CPCA) 통계에 따르면 지난 9월 중국 승용차 소매판매량은 161만8천대로 전년 동월보다 28% 감소했다. 중국차는 저렴한 가격뿐 아니라 개선된 품질과 기술력으로 한국을 포함한 해외 소비자들의 인식을 바꾸고 있다는 분석이 나온다. 유럽 시장에서도 중국 업체들의 점유율은 두자릿수를 기록하고 있다. 이항구 남서울대 특임교수는 중국차의 품질이 개선되고 가격 경쟁력까지 갖추면서 국내 소비자들이 중국차를 찾고 있다고 말했다. 그는 "과거에는 중국산이라고 하면 하찮은 제품이라는 인식이 있었지만 최근에는 전기차에서 우리를 월등히 앞섰고 자율주행차도 그렇다"고 말했다. 이 교수는 중국차의 국내 점유율 확대 가능성에 대해 "중국이 지리적으로 가까워 물류비도 별로 안 들고 가격이 싸니 관세로 막기 어렵고 비관세 장벽도 오히려 우리가 피해를 볼 수 있어 마땅치 않다"고 설명했다. 중국 자동차 업체가 한국 시장에서 빠르게 판매량을 늘리는 것과 달리 현대차[005380]와 기아[000270]는 세계 최대 자동차 시장인 중국에서 입지를 잃었다. 하나증권이 CPCA 통계를 분석한 보고서에 따르면 현대차와 기아의 지난 9월 중국 소매판매량은 각각 약 4천대와 5천대로 전년 동월보다 47%, 31% 감소했다. 두 회사의 합산 판매량은 약 9천대로 39% 줄면서 올해 처음으로 1만대 아래로 떨어졌다. 합산 시장 점유율도 0.6%에 그쳤다. 현대차·기아는 2010년대 중반 중국에서 합산 점유율이 10%를 넘어서기도 했지만, 중국 시장이 전기차 중심으로 빠르게 재편되는 가운데 현지 업체들과의 경쟁에서 밀리면서 존재감을 찾기 어렵다. 현대차가 지난해 출시한 중국 전략형 전기 SUV '일렉시오'는 지난해 10∼12월 1천216대가 판매됐으나 올해 1∼9월에는 251대에 그쳤다. 아이오닉 브랜드의 중국 전략형 모델인 아이오닉 V의 지난달 판매량도 558대로 집계됐다. 현대차는 향후 5년간 중국 시장에 신차 20종을 투입하고 연간 판매량을 50만대 수준으로 끌어올린다는 계획이지만 중국 업체들과의 경쟁이 치열해 반등이 쉽지 않은 상황이다. 이 교수는 "현대차·기아가 최선을 다했겠지만 먹혀들지 않는다"면서 "2∼3년 더 버텨봐야 할 것"이라고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/10/31 08:01 송고 2026년10월31일 08시01분 송고

（首尔=韩联社）记者金允九 = 28日，首尔龙山的比亚迪展厅。即便在工作日下午，仍有不少消费者专程前往现场查看比亚迪汽车。尹某来到附近后找到了展厅，她说：“听说比亚迪卖得很好，一直很好奇，亲自看过后感觉还不错。”不过她也表示：“我担心中国车的安防和安全性，不知道三四年后是否还会出问题。”展厅经理朴元均说：“作为中国品牌，顾客可能存在偏见，但我感觉消费者对它的认识与一年前相比，已经变得积极得多。”他补充说：“顾客认为产品好，价格也好。”比亚迪凭借价格竞争力，于去年进入韩国市场并积极开拓业务。今年其在韩国的销量已突破2万辆。韩国进口汽车协会数据显示，比亚迪今年1月至9月在韩国的全新注册量达到2万137辆。去年9月，其在进口车品牌中继特斯拉、BMW和梅赛德斯-奔驰之后 ranked 第4。电动掀背车海豚和中型电动运动型多用途车（SUV）宋PLUS PLUS? 这两款车销量均超过7000辆，成为销售主力。Dolphin起售价为2450万韩元，Sealion 7售价为4490万至5390万韩元。比亚迪还推出了插电式混合动力车（PHEV）“Sealion 6 DM-i”，并投放电视广告，展开积极营销。彭博社也指出，比亚迪凭借价格和技术实力在韩国市场快速增长，对现代汽车和起亚构成威胁。在同一时期，各国进口车新增注册份额中，中国以7.22%略微超过日本的7.21%，继德国和美国之后升至第3。中国吉利汽车的高端电动车品牌极氪于本月凭中型电动SUV“7X”首次与韩国消费者见面。小鹏和奇瑞汽车也在准备进入韩国市场。两家公司均已在韩国成立法人，小鹏还开始招聘负责韩国业务的人才。中国乘用车市场信息联席会（CPCA）统计显示，去年9月中国乘用车零售销量为161.8万辆，同比下降28%。有分析认为，中国汽车不仅凭借低廉价格，还通过提升产品质量和技术实力，正在改变包括韩国在内的海外消费者对国产车的看法。在欧洲市场，中国车企的市场份额也达到两位数。高丽大学特任教授李恒구表示，随着中国车的质量得到改善并具备价格竞争力，韩国消费者正在重新审视中国车。他说：“过去一听到中国制造，就会觉得是低档产品，但近来中国电动车已经远远领先于我们，自动驾驶汽车也是如此。”谈及中国车在韩国扩大市场份额的可能性，他解释道：“中国在地理上距离较近，物流成本也不高，价格又便宜，很难仅靠关税加以阻挡，而且设置非关税壁垒反而可能让我们受损，因此并不妥当。”与中国车企在韩国市场销量快速增长不同，现代汽车[005380]和起亚[000270]却在全球最大汽车市场中国失去立足点。Hana证券分析CPCA统计数据的报告称，现代汽车和起亚去年9月在中国市场的零售销量分别约为4000辆和5000辆，同比分别下降47%和31%。两家公司合计销量约为9000辆，减少39%，今年首次跌破1万辆。合计市场份额也仅为0.6%。2010年代中期，现代汽车和起亚在中国的合计市场份额曾超过10%，但随着中国市场迅速转向以电动车为中心，两家公司在与当地企业的竞争中处于下风，存在感日益减弱。现代汽车去年推出的中国市场战略型电动SUV“Ioniq”去年10月至12月售出1216辆，但今年1月至9月仅为251辆。Ioniq品牌的中国市场战略车型Ioniq V上月销量也仅为558辆。现代汽车计划未来5年向中国市场投放20款新车，并将年销量提升至50万辆左右，但鉴于与中国企业的竞争异常激烈，短期内难以翻身。该教授说：“现代汽车和起亚或许已经尽了最大努力，但在市场上却不被接受。”“还得再坚持两三年看看。”本报道可在KakaoTalk okjebo查阅。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026/10/31 08:01发稿 2026年10月31日08时01分发稿

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/fg-a.summary: The Federal Government has assured the Economic Community of West African States, ECOWAS, of its commitment to conducting peaceful, credible, transparent and inclusive general elections in 2027. In a statement on Friday, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu, gave the assurance during a meeting with the ECOWAS Pre-Election Fact-Finding Mission to Nigeria, led by former Vice-President of Sierra Leone, Victor Bockarie Foh, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Abuja.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/fg-a.summary_zh: 联邦政府已向西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）保证，致力于在2027年举行和平、可信、透明和包容的普选。外交部长、大使比安卡·奥杜梅格乌-奥朱库于星期五发表声明，在阿布贾外交部会见由塞拉利昂前副总统维克托·博卡里·福率领的ECOWAS赴尼日利亚选举前事实调查团时作出了这一保证。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/fg-a.body: The Federal Government has assured the Economic Community of West African States, ECOWAS, of its commitment to conducting peaceful, credible, transparent and inclusive general elections in 2027. In a statement on Friday, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu, gave the assurance during a meeting with the ECOWAS Pre-Election Fact-Finding Mission to Nigeria, led by former Vice-President of Sierra Leone, Victor Bockarie Foh, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Abuja. Odumegwu-Ojukwu said the Federal Government was committed to ensuring that the electoral process complied with the provisions of the Nigerian Constitution and relevant electoral laws. She described the 2027 general elections as a defining moment for Nigeria’s democracy, expressing optimism that the process would strengthen democratic governance in the country and the West African sub-region. The minister said institutional preparedness, transparent voter accreditation, effective management of election results and timely resolution of electoral disputes were important to building public confidence in the electoral system. She also stressed the need for effective coordination among security agencies to protect candidates, electoral officials, observers and voters before, during and after the elections. According to her, security personnel must perform their duties professionally and impartially while respecting the country’s human rights obligations. The minister further highlighted the importance of voter education and effective enforcement of electoral laws, noting that political parties, civil society organisations, traditional institutions and the media had important roles to play in ensuring peaceful elections. She expressed concern over the dangers of misinformation and disinformation, calling for accurate, accessible and timely information on the electoral process. Odumegwu-Ojukwu also identified the need to improve measures that would encourage the participation of persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups in the elections. Earlier, Foh said the mission was in Nigeria to assess the country’s preparedness for the 2027 general elections through consultations with relevant institutions and stakeholders. He said the mission had engaged the Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC, political parties, security agencies, civil society organisations and the media. Foh disclosed that its earlier engagements with stakeholders, including the Inter-Party Advisory Council, the Nigerian Civil Society Situation Room and the Nigerian Union of Journalists, had been constructive. He said the mission’s preliminary assessment suggested a favourable environment for the forthcoming elections, adding, however, that consultations were still ongoing. According to him, the mission would submit a report outlining its findings and recommendations at the end of the exercise. The former Sierra Leonean vice-president welcomed the assurances given by the minister and expressed optimism about Nigeria’s preparedness for the elections. He stressed the importance of sustained engagement with stakeholders and addressing identified concerns, noting that Nigeria’s ability to conduct credible elections in 2027 would have wider implications for democratic governance and stability across West Africa. The meeting ended with both sides reaffirming their commitment to promoting democracy, peace, stability and prosperity in the sub-region. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/fg-a.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府向西非国家经济共同体保证2027年选举将和平进行
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/fg-a.body_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府向西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）保证，决心在2027年举行和平、可信、透明和包容的全国大选。星期五发表的一份声明显示，外交部长、驻尼日利亚西非国家经济共同体选举前事实调查团团长、塞拉利昂前副总统维克托·博卡里·福赫一行在阿布贾外交部与外交部长会面。外交部长、白雅卡·奥杜梅格武-奥朱库在会面中作出上述保证。她表示，尼日利亚联邦政府致力于确保选举进程符合《尼日利亚宪法》和相关选举法的规定。她称，2027年大选是尼日利亚民主进程的重要时刻，并乐观认为，整个进程将加强该国及西非次区域的民主治理。部长表示，加强机构准备、实行透明的选民登记、有效管理选举结果以及及时解决选举争议，对于建立公众对选举制度的信心至关重要。她还强调，选举前、选举期间和选举后，各安全机构需要有效协调，保护候选人、选举工作人员、观察员和选民。外交部长指出，安全人员必须专业、公正地履行职责，同时尊重该国履行人权义务的责任。她进一步强调选民教育和有效执行选举法的重要性，并指出政党、民间社会组织、传统权威机构和媒体在确保选举和平方面都发挥着重要作用。她对错误信息和虚假信息带来的风险表示关切，呼吁及时提供准确、易于获取的选举进程信息。奥杜梅格武-奥朱库还指出，需要改进相关措施，鼓励残障人士和其他弱势群体参与选举。此前，福赫表示，该代表团此次访问尼日利亚，旨在通过与相关机构和利益攸关方磋商，评估该国对2027年全国大选的准备情况。他说，代表团已经与独立国家选举委员会（INEC）、政党、安全机构、民间社会组织和媒体开展沟通。福赫透露，代表团此前与包括跨党派咨询委员会、尼日利亚公民社会形势室和尼日利亚记者联合会在内的利益攸关方沟通时取得了富有成效的结果。他说，代表团的初步评估显示，即将举行的选举具备良好的环境，但磋商仍在继续。他表示，代表团将在工作结束时提交一份报告，列明调查结果和建议。这位塞拉利昂前副总统对部长所作的保证表示欢迎，并对尼日利亚做好大选准备表示乐观。他强调，持续与利益攸关方沟通以及处理已发现的问题十分重要，并指出，尼日利亚能否在2027年举行可信选举，将对整个西非的民主治理和稳定产生更广泛影响。会面结束时，双方重申致力于推动次区域的民主、和平、稳定与繁荣。本文所载评论仅代表《Vanguard报》署名评论作者或Vanguard报及其员工的个人观点，不代表尼日利亚联邦政府、ECOWAS、INEC或任何其他机构的官方立场。

https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6pv.body: Nigeria govment don launch monthly cash relief programme wey go help reduce di impact of di rising cost of living. For di relief programme wey di Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction announce for statement on Friday, 30 October, dem say govment go give each household 50,000 naira, about ($37.14) evri month. Di Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction, Bernard Doro, say di National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention (NERSI) na presidential initiative wey dey designed to provide immediate financial assistance to millions of vulnerable Nigerians. According to am, dem introduce di intervention programme to respond to di rising cost of food and oda essential goods. Dis rising costs around di world dey continue to put pressure on Nigerian households. Subsidy don return? Wetin govment tok, how Nigerians react and all you suppose know 9th October 2026 How minimum wage, 70,000 naira transport allowance and oda resolutions by govment go benefit Nigerians 28th October 2026 End of content You be Nigerian no mean say na evribodi or evri household go benefit from di programme to collect free ₦50,000 evri month. You need to dey vulnerable first. Oga Boro tok about di pipo wey go benefit from dis programme. "Under dis intervention, di pipo wey go qualify to benefit go receive ₦50,000 ($37.14) monthly, wey go provide direct assistance to help meet essential needs and reduce di burden of living costs," im tok for statement. According to di minister, dem go dey review di programme evritime so dat dem go fit respond to di changes for di cost of living. Im add say dem go notify di pipo wey dey benefit from di programme directly bifor dem go make any adjustment. Di Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction minister add say dem dey work wit licensed digital financial service providers. Dis na to make sure say di programme dey secure, fast witout delay and di delivery of di money to di beneficiaries go dey transparent. Na text messages di beneficiaries go receive from di providers. Dis text message go ask for dia consent bifor di providers go pay di money directly into dia bank accounts or mobile wallets. Di minister explain say di beneficiaries no need to apply, pay any fee, or register through any agents to access di programme. Oga Doro draw ear for Nigerians make dem shine dia eyes well-well against mago-mago pipo. E advise evribodi wey go benefit from di intervention programme make dem no give or tell anybodi dia personal identification numbers (PINs) or Bank Verification Numbers (BVNs). Di minister say NERSI dey add to di federal govment social protection and economic support programmes wey dey exist as dem go dey support household resilience and economic stability. Im add say di intervention dey in line wit President Bola Tinubu Renewed Hope Agenda. E also show dia commitment to deliver di programme wit dignity, transparency and accountability. Dis na di third intervention programme wey Nigeria govment dey do within one month sake of di cost of living. For October, Nigeria govment bin do discount for fuel for 90 days but na for only di Nigeria National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) retail station e go fit happun. Few days ago, Nigeria govement offer ₦70,000 transportation allowance to workers wey make di Nigeria Labour Congress and di Trade Union Congress put leg for one trouser. TUC say dem no go accept di offer make govment instead increase salary but NLC say TUC no get di power to reject wetin dem no be part of
https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6pv.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府启动每月5万奈拉现金援助，向脆弱民众发放；谁将受益，如何申领？
https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6pv.body_zh:
尼日利亚政府将启动每月现金救济计划，以帮助减轻生活成本上涨带来的影响。人道事务与减贫部在10月30日星期五发表的声明中宣布了这一救济计划，称政府将每月向每个家庭提供50,000奈拉，约合($37.14)。人道事务与减贫部长Bernard Doro表示，国家紧急救济与稳定干预计划（NERSI）是一项总统倡议，旨在为数百万处境困难的尼日利亚人提供即时经济援助。他说，政府推出这一干预计划，是为了应对食品和其他生活必需品价格上涨。全球各地不断上涨的成本持续给尼日利亚家庭造成压力。补贴要恢复了吗？政府说了什么、尼日利亚人如何反应，以及你应该知道的一切——2026年10月9日。最低工资、70,000奈拉交通补贴和政府通过的其他决议将如何让尼日利亚人受益——2026年10月28日。内容到此结束。你是尼日利亚人，并不意味着每个人或每个家庭都会从该计划中受益，每月领取免费的₦50,000。你必须首先属于处境困难群体。部长Doro谈到了将从该计划中受益的人群。

“在这一干预措施下，符合条件的受益人将每月获得₦50,000（$37.14），这笔钱将提供直接援助，以帮助满足基本生活需要并减轻生活成本负担。”他在声明中说道。

部长表示，政府将定期审查该计划，以便应对生活成本的变化。他补充说，在对计划作出任何调整之前，政府会直接通知受益人。人道事务与减贫部长还表示，政府正与持牌数字金融服务提供商合作，以确保计划安全、快速且不延迟，并使资金发放过程保持透明。受益人将收到服务商发来的短信。短信将征求他们的同意，随后服务商把钱直接汇入其银行账户或移动钱包。

部长解释说，受益人无需申请、缴纳任何费用，也无需通过代理人登记即可参与该计划。Doro部长提醒尼日利亚人务必警惕诈骗者。他建议所有将从该干预计划中受益的人，不要把个人识别码（PIN）或银行验证号码（BVN）交给或告知任何人。

部长表示，NERSI是尼日利亚联邦政府现有社会保护和经济支持计划的一项补充，旨在增强家庭韧性并促进经济稳定。他补充说，这一干预计划符合President Bola Tinubu的“ renewed hope ”议程，也体现了政府以尊严、透明度和问责制落实该计划的决心。鉴于生活成本上涨，这是尼日利亚政府在一个月内实施的第三项干预计划。10月，尼日利亚政府曾对燃油实施90天折扣，但这项优惠只适用于Nigeria National Petroleum Company Limited（NNPCL）的零售站。几天前，尼日利亚政府提出向工人提供₦70,000交通补贴，但Nigeria Labour Congress和Trade Union Congress坚决反对这一提议。TUC表示，不会接受政府的这一提议，而要求政府提高工资；但NLC表示，TUC无权拒绝其并未参与制定的事项……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 尼日利亚和俄罗斯已同意替换一项已有59年历史的航空协议，旨在更新航空运输关系，并为两国之间建立更紧密的互联互通创造机会。重新谈判这项可追溯至1967年的双边航空服务协议（BASA）的协议，是在莫斯科举行的第三届俄罗斯—非洲峰会期间，由尼日利亚航空与航天发展部长费斯图斯·凯亚莫与俄罗斯官员会晤时达成的。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: Nigeria and Russia have agreed to replace a 59-year-old aviation agreement, aiming to update air transport relations and create opportunities for stronger connectivity between the two countries. The agreement to renegotiate the Bilateral Air Services Agreement (BASA), which dates back to 1967, was reached during a meeting between Nigeria’s Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, and Russian officials on the sidelines of the Third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow. Mr Keyamo disclosed the development in a post on his X account on Friday, saying both countries had agreed to complete negotiations within six months and sign a new agreement in Saint Petersburg, Russia, in April 2027. He said the Nigerian delegation met with Dmitry Stanislavovich Zverev, the State Secretary and Deputy Minister of Transport of the Russian Federation. “We resolved to renegotiate our last Bilateral Air Service Agreement that was made in 1967. We set a timeline of six months to conclude the negotiations and sign a new one in Saint Petersburg in April 2027,” Mr Keyamo said. He added that both countries had formed negotiating teams to begin work toward an agreement within the agreed period. The proposed renegotiation is expected to update the framework governing air transport between Nigeria and Russia, reflecting changes in the international aviation industry over the past six decades. A Bilateral Air Services Agreement provides the legal framework for scheduled air services between two countries. It generally sets out the conditions under which airlines from both countries can operate international flights, including routes, traffic rights, designated airlines and other operational arrangements. Nigeria’s Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development says its Air Transport Management Department negotiates and reviews new and existing air services agreements and monitors their implementation. The ministry also works with the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority and other aviation agencies to facilitate international air links and regulate airline operations. The proposed replacement of the Nigeria-Russia agreement could therefore create opportunities for improved air connectivity and cooperation between their aviation sectors. However, neither Mr Keyamo nor the ministry disclosed proposed flight routes, designated airlines or the frequency of possible operations under the new agreement. Beyond the aviation agreement, Mr Keyamo said the meeting also examined other areas of cooperation between Nigeria and Russia. He said both sides had resolved to explore additional opportunities in the coming months. The Nigerian delegation included the Director-General of the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority, Capt: Chris Najomo, and the Registrar of the Nigerian College of Aviation Technology, Dr Danjuma Adamu Ismaila. Directors from the Federal Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development and the NCAA also participated in the discussions. Nigeria and Russia have maintained diplomatic relations since shortly after Nigeria gained independence in 1960. Their relationship has included cooperation in areas such as defence, trade, science and technology. According to the Nigerian Embassy in Russia, the Soviet Union provided political and military assistance to Nigeria during the 1967–1970 Civil War. Cooperation between the two countries has also extended to space technology, including the launch of Nigeria’s satellites aboard Russian rockets in 2011. The planned aviation agreement is expected to form part of broader efforts to deepen bilateral relations and identify further areas of cooperation. Both countries are expected to begin negotiations through their respective teams, aiming to conclude the process and sign the new agreement in Saint Petersburg in April 2027
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.title_zh: 尼日利亚与俄罗斯着手替换已延续59年的航空协议
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 尼日利亚和俄罗斯已同意替换一项已有59年历史的航空协议，以更新两国航空运输关系，并为加强两国之间的互联互通创造机会。重新谈判《双边航空服务协定》（BASA）的协议于莫斯科举行的第三届俄罗斯—非洲峰会期间达成，该协定可追溯至1967年。尼日利亚航空与航天发展部长Festus Keyamo与俄罗斯官员会面后披露了这一进展。Keyamo先生周五在其X账号上发帖称，两国已同意在6个月内完成谈判，并于2027年4月在俄罗斯圣彼得堡签署新协议。他说，尼日利亚代表团会见了俄罗斯联邦交通部国务秘书兼副部长Dmitry Stanislavovich Zverev。Keyamo先生表示：“我们决定重新谈判我们于1967年签订的上一份《双边航空服务协定》。我们设定了6个月的时间表，以完成谈判，并于2027年4月在圣彼得堡签署新协定。”他还补充说，两国已成立谈判团队，将在商定期限内着手推进协议达成。预计重新谈判将更新规范尼日利亚与俄罗斯航空运输的框架，反映国际航空业过去60年来的变化。《双边航空服务协定》为两国之间的定期航空服务提供法律框架，通常规定两国航空公司运营国际航班须遵守的条件，包括航线、交通权、指定航空公司及其他运营安排。尼日利亚航空与航天发展部表示，其航空运输管理司负责谈判和审查新的及现有航空服务协定，并监督其实施。该部还与尼日利亚民用航空管理局及其他航空机构合作，促进国际航空联系并监管航空公司运营。因此，拟以新协议取代尼日利亚与俄罗斯现有协议，可能为改善两国航空部门之间的航空互联互通和合作创造机会。然而，Keyamo先生和该部均未披露拟议中的航班航线、指定航空公司或新协议下可能运营的班次频率。除航空协议外，Keyamo先生表示，双方会议还研究了尼日利亚与俄罗斯合作的其他领域。他说，双方已决定在未来数月探索更多合作机会。尼日利亚代表团成员包括尼日利亚民用航空管理局局长Chris Najomo上校，以及尼日利亚航空技术学院登记官Danjuma Adamu Ismaila博士。尼日利亚联邦航空与航天发展部及尼日利亚民用航空管理局的官员也参加了讨论。自尼日利亚于1960年独立后不久起，两国便保持外交关系，双边关系涵盖国防、贸易、科学与技术等领域的合作。据尼日利亚驻俄罗斯大使馆称，苏联曾在1967年至1970年的内战期间向尼日利亚提供政治和军事援助。两国的合作还延伸至航天技术，包括2011年使用俄罗斯运载火箭发射尼日利亚卫星。拟议中的航空协议预计将成为深化双边关系、确定更多合作领域等更广泛努力的一部分。预计两国将通过各自的谈判团队启动谈判，目标是完成相关程序并于2027年4月在圣彼得堡签署新协议

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: The Centre on Friday announced a pause on construction and demolition activities across Delhi-NCR from November 5 to 20 in view of the pollution situation that begins in the national capital with the onset of winters. However, the government has exempted construction activities related to railways, metro services, airports, inter state bus terminals, hospitals, water supply and sanitation, national security and defence related activities and ‘projects of national importance’ from the pollution control measures.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 考虑到首都地区入冬后开始出现的污染状况，该中心周五宣布，11月5日至20日暂停德里—国家首都地区各地的施工和拆除活动。不过，政府豁免了与铁路、地铁服务、机场、城际客运总站、医院、供水与卫生、国家安全和国防相关的活动以及“具有 national importance 的项目”有关的施工活动，这些活动不受污染控制措施限制。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The Centre on Friday announced a pause on construction and demolition activities across Delhi-NCR from November 5 to 20 in view of the pollution situation that begins in the national capital with the onset of winters. The state government and private offices have also been directed to operate with upto 50% of the staff strength attending physically, while the remaining will work from home. Announcing the air pollution curbs, the government said that historical data indicates that pollution during mid-November peaks and Air Quality Index (AQI) levels reach 'Severe' and 'Severe+' categories on certain days. “This recurring pattern underscores the need for timely preventive interventions to minimize emissions before and during the onset of peak pollution episodes,” the order issued on Friday said. However, the government has exempted construction activities related to railways, metro services, airports, inter state bus terminals, hospitals, water supply and sanitation, national security and defence related activities and ‘projects of national importance’ from the pollution control measures. “This restriction shall also apply to linear public projects such as highways, roads, flyovers, overbridges, power transmission, pipelines, tele-communication etc,” the order said. While the Delhi air quality has started dipping, an overnight rainfall improved the Air Quality Index (AQI) to 133 in the ‘Moderate category’ on Friday. The AQI remained above 200 in the 'Poor' category on Wednesday and Thursday, according to the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB). The Air Quality Early Warning System for Delhi indicates that the city's air quality will likely remain in the moderate category until October 31, before deteriorating to the poor category from November 1 and further going down for the subsequent six days. In August, the Delhi government had called for a complete ban on construction and demolition activities from December 10 to January 20 under its winter action plan. The Delhi Traffic Police has also announced fresh restrictions under the revised Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) on vehicles entering the national capital from November 1, 2026. Stage-I of the GRAP is activated in Delhi-NCR when the AQI falls between 201 and 300, classified as ‘poor’. The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) brings these measures into force to tackle pollution from sources such as road dust, vehicle emissions and open waste burning. The first stage focuses on reducing pollution at its source, with steps aimed at controlling dust from construction and roads, limiting vehicle emissions and checking industrial pollution. Under the fresh curbs to control air pollution in Delhi, the traffic police said that vehicles meeting BS-VI emission standards, along with CNG and electric vehicles will be allowed to enter and operate in Delhi. It also said that vehicles covered under specific exemptions in the notification will also be permitted, subject to the applicable rules. Every year, Delhi tackles air pollution with Air Quality Index (AQI) touching record levels – often pushed by emissions caused by vehicular movement, stubble burning in the neighbouring states and firecrackers during Diwali time
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 德里—国家首都区11月5日至20日暂停施工和拆除活动，以遏制空气污染
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 该中心周五宣布，鉴于首都地区进入冬季后开始出现的污染状况，11月5日至20日暂停德里—国家首都地区各地的施工和拆除活动。邦政府和私营机构也被指示最多安排50%的员工到岗，其余员工居家办公。政府宣布空气污染限制措施时表示，历史数据显示，污染在11月中旬达到高峰，空气质量指数（AQI）在某些日子会升至“严重”和“严重+”类别。周五发布的命令称：“这一反复出现的模式凸显了及时采取预防性干预措施，以便在污染高峰来临前及期间减少排放的必要性。”不过，政府豁免了与铁路、地铁服务、机场、州际巴士总站、医院、供水与卫生、国家安全和国防相关的活动，以及“具有全国重要性的项目”所涉及的施工活动。命令称：“这一限制还将适用于高速公路、道路、天桥、立交桥、输电、管道、电信等线性公共项目。”德里空气质量已开始下降，周五夜间降雨使空气质量指数（AQI）改善至133，处于“中等”类别。据中央污染控制委员会（CPCB）数据，周三和周四AQI仍高于200，处于“差”类别。德里空气质量预警系统显示，该市空气质量可能维持中等类别至10月31日，随后从11月1日起恶化至“差”类别，并在此后六天进一步下降。今年8月，德里政府曾依据冬季行动计划，呼吁从12月10日至1月20日全面禁止施工和拆除活动。德里交警还宣布，根据修订后的分级响应行动计划（GRAP），自2026年11月1日起对驶入首都的车辆实施新限制。当AQI介于201至300、归类为“差”时，德里—国家首都地区将启动GRAP第一阶段。空气质量管理委员会（CAQM）负责实施这些措施，以应对道路扬尘、车辆排放和露天焚烧垃圾等污染源。第一阶段重点从源头减少污染，采取措施控制施工和道路扬尘、限制车辆排放并检查工业污染。在德里控制空气污染的新措施下，交警表示，符合BS-VI排放标准的车辆以及压缩天然气车和电动汽车将获准进入并在德里通行。公告还称，通知中明确豁免的车辆也将获准通行，但须遵守适用规则。每年，德里都要应对空气污染，空气质量指数（AQI）屡次达到创纪录水平——污染通常由车辆行驶、邻近邦焚烧秸秆以及排灯节期间燃放烟花所造成的排放推动

https://leadership.ng/ododo-affirms-fale.summary_zh: 科吉州州长Alhaji Ahmed Usman Ododo重申了他与尼日利亚众议院伊凯贾联邦选区代表Hon.之间的政治关系。州长于周四接待来自Faleke Political Vanguard的成员时作出这一表态。该组织是一个青年支持组织，在科吉州下辖的21个地方政府区域均设有代表。州长府位于洛科贾。
https://leadership.ng/ododo-affirms-fale.body: Governor of Kogi State, Alhaji Ahmed Usman Ododo, has reaffirmed his political relationship with the Member representing Ikeja Federal Constituency in the House of Representatives, Hon. James Abiodun Faleke, declaring that there is no disagreement between them. The Governor made the declaration on Thursday when he received members of the Faleke Political Vanguard, a youth support organisation with representation across the 21 Local Government Areas of Kogi State, during a courtesy visit to the Government House, Lokoja. According to a statement by the Coordinator of the Faleke Political Vanguard, Alamoh Kehinde Samuel, Ododo explained that his inability to meet with the group regularly was not an indication of neglect or disagreement but rather a consequence of his demanding responsibilities as the Chief Executive of the state. According to the Governor, Faleke had specifically directed the group to support his administration, a responsibility he said he had willingly embraced. “I want people to know that we are together; we don’t have differences. He is my leader and he is my partner. I have been saying it, and I owe nobody any apology,” the Governor declared. He also recalled the support he received from Faleke during his legal challenges, describing their relationship as one built on mutual understanding, loyalty and shared political interests. Beyond political affiliations, Ododo used the occasion to reiterate his administration’s commitment to inclusive governance, particularly the empowerment of youths and women. The Governor described himself as a product of collective support, insisting that his position should not make him feel superior to other stakeholders. “I am not better than anybody. I have no voice, I have no power without your support. But with your support, we are willing to defend the interests of our youths and women,” he said. Reflecting on the state’s political history, Ododo cautioned against using young people as instruments of violence and division, recalling past experiences in which political interests allegedly fuelled hostility among communities and supporters. Earlier, the Coordinator of the Faleke Political Vanguard, Alamoh Kehinde Samuel, said the organisation comprised carefully selected youth leaders and supporters drawn from the 21 local government areas, many of whom were followers of the late former Governor Abubakar Audu and Hon. James Abiodun Faleke. He expressed appreciation to Governor Ododo for his support for the organisation and its members, describing the administration’s attention to security, youth development and inclusive governance as key reasons for their continued engagement. Kehinde also highlighted some of the administration’s interventions in healthcare, education, infrastructure, workers’ welfare and investment promotion. He specifically cited the construction and renovation of 88 primary healthcare centres, the establishment of a psychiatric centre at the Prince Abubakar Audu University Teaching Hospital, educational support for students, improved payment of salaries and pensions, the expansion of the state health insurance scheme and ongoing road projects. He disclosed that the organisation had established a coordination structure across the state’s 21 local government areas and 239 wards, with a claimed membership strength of 100 persons per ward, bringing its projected membership to 23,900. He added that the organisation planned to hold inaugurations at the zonal, local government and ward levels to strengthen its grassroots structure. Kehinde said the group’s political mission included mobilising support for Governor Ododo and President Bola Ahmed Tinubu ahead of the next electoral cycle. Also speaking, the Kogi State Chairman of the Special Advisers’ Forum, Hon. Bode Adeyemi, commended the organisation for its growing mobilisation capacity, recalling that about 400 of its members had previously participated in an engagement with his team. He described the group’s participation in a solidarity walk organised in support of President Tinubu as a significant demonstration of youth mobilisation, adding that its recent activities had shown its commitment to the political objectives of the administration. Adeyemi noted that the organisation’s expanding membership across the 239 wards underscored the need for an inclusive structure capable of accommodating young people from different backgrounds. He expressed confidence in the group’s leadership and organisational capacity, urging members to remain focused on their objectives. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/ododo-affirms-fale.title_zh: 奥多多确认法莱克集团立场，称科吉州进步大会党内部没有分歧
https://leadership.ng/ododo-affirms-fale.body_zh: 科吉州州长阿尔哈吉·艾哈迈德·乌斯曼·奥多罗重申了他与众议院伊凯贾联邦选区议员詹姆斯·阿比奥敦·法莱克的政治关系，称双方之间不存在分歧。州长于周四接待法莱克政治先驱组织成员时作出上述表态。该组织是一个青年支持组织，在科吉州21个地方政府辖区均设有代表，此次到访政府大楼洛科贾进行礼节性拜访。法莱克政治先驱组织协调员阿拉莫·凯欣德·萨缪尔在一份声明中表示，奥多罗解释道，他无法定期与该组织会面，并非因为忽视或存在分歧，而是由于作为州行政长官肩负繁重职责。州长表示，法莱克曾特别指示该组织支持其政府，他欣然承担了这一责任。州长宣称：“我希望让大家知道，我们站在一起，彼此没有分歧。他是我的领导，也是我的伙伴。我一直这样说，不必向任何人道歉。”他还回顾了自己在法律诉讼期间得到法莱克支持的经历，称双方关系建立在相互理解、忠诚和共同政治利益之上。除政治立场外，奥多罗还借此重申其政府推动包容性治理的决心，尤其致力于赋权青年和女性。州长称自己是集体支持的成果，强调其职位不应使自己觉得高人一等。他说：“我并不比任何人更好。没有你们的支持，我没有话语权，也没有权力。但有了你们的支持，我们愿意捍卫青年和女性的利益。”回顾科吉州的政治历史，奥多罗告诫不要把年轻人当作暴力和分裂的工具，并提及过去的经历，其中政治利益据称煽动了各社区及其支持者之间的敌意。早些时候，法莱克政治先驱组织协调员阿拉莫·凯欣德·萨缪尔表示，该组织由从21个地方政府辖区精选的青年领袖和支持者组成，其中许多人是已故前州长阿布巴卡尔·奥杜和詹姆斯·阿比奥敦·法莱克阁下的追随者。他感谢奥多罗州长对该组织及其成员的支持，并称政府重视安全、青年发展和包容性治理，是他们继续与政府互动的关键原因。凯欣德还介绍了政府在医疗、教育、基础设施、劳动者福利和促进投资方面采取的一些措施。他具体提到新建和翻修了88所基层医疗中心，在阿布巴卡尔·奥杜王子大学教学医院设立精神卫生中心，为学生提供教育支持，改善工资和养老金支付，扩大州医疗保险计划，以及正在推进的道路项目。他透露，该组织已在全州21个地方政府辖区和239个行政分区建立了协调架构，声称每个分区拥有100名成员，预计总成员数达到23,900人。他补充说，该组织计划在分区、地方政府辖区和行政分区三级举行成立仪式，以加强基层组织建设。凯欣德称，该组织的政治使命包括在下一轮选举周期前动员支持奥多罗州长和博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努武总统。科吉州特别顾问论坛主席博德·阿德耶米阁下也在会上发言。他赞扬该组织不断增强的动员能力，并回顾约有400名成员此前曾与其团队举行会面。他称，该组织参加了为支持蒂努武总统而举行的声援游行，这是动员青年的重要体现，并补充说，该组织近期的活动表明其致力于实现政府的政治目标。阿德耶米指出，该组织在239个行政分区的成员数量不断增加，这凸显出建立包容性架构、接纳不同背景青年的必要性。他对该组织的领导力和组织能力表示有信心，敦促成员继续专注于目标。我们掌握先机。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独到视角，直接送达您的手机。拒绝陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，通过WhatsApp获取全天候最新动态 →

The United States cancelled a planned group photo of foreign ministers from the world's 20 largest economies (G20) on Friday after several European diplomats objected to being photographed alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and threatened to walk out. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio decided to cancel the photo to avoid further controversy, according to two US officials who spoke on condition of anonymity because of the sensitivity of the matter. Opening the talks, Rubio looked ahead, saying he hoped for “a productive meeting.” “We are in a critical moment — I would call it a moment of choosing, and I would say not just for my country, the United States of America, but frankly, for the world," he said. German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said “there is no normality with Russia” but “we must exchange the controversies at the table here,” the German news agency dpa reported. He added that “we also must not send falsely optimistic signals.” Even before the dispute over the photo, several G20 countries had raised concerns about Russia's invitation amid intensified attacks on Ukraine. Tensions have also grown after Trump waived new sanctions on Moscow and temporarily restricted logistical and intelligence support for Kyiv, further straining US-Ukraine relations

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 人民民主党（PDP）前全国宣传秘书奥利萨·梅图呼吁国民议会修改有关假冒产品的法律，对参与生产、销售假药及尼日利亚其他掺假商品的人规定更严厉的处罚。相关法律包括《2026年假冒医疗产品、假药及不安全加工食品（禁止与管制）法案》和《2026年食品、药品及相关产品（登记等）（废止）法案》。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: A former National Publicity Secretary of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Olisa Metuh, has urged the National Assembly to amend relevant laws on counterfeit products to prescribe stiffer penalties for those involved in the production and distribution of fake drugs and other adulterated goods in Nigeria. Mr Metuh, a member of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) and the Director of Mobilisation and Organisation of the Renewed Hope Ambassadors (RHA), recommended longer prison sentences and asset forfeiture for anyone convicted of producing or distributing counterfeit products. He made the call in a statement on Friday while reacting to the conviction of Innocent Okoye by the Federal High Court in Abia State for producing and distributing fake Extra Virgin Olive Oil. Mr Okoye was sentenced to five years’ imprisonment, with an option of a N5 million fine. Mr Metuh, a lawyer, described the sentence, particularly the option of a fine, as too lenient for an offence that could endanger the health of millions of Nigerians. He warned that counterfeiting would persist if tougher penalties were not introduced to deter offenders. “A five-year jail term or N5 million fine amounts to a mere slap on the wrist. Such punishment could make counterfeiting and product adulteration a manageable business expense for unscrupulous manufacturers and distributors. “The law must respond with consequences that fit the crime. The absence of direct physical confrontation between offenders and their victims does not make product counterfeiting any less dangerous than conventional violent crimes,” he said. He urged the National Assembly to urgently review existing laws governing drug counterfeiting, pharmaceutical adulteration and the falsification of consumer products, arguing that the penalties should reflect the potential harm such offences could cause to public health. Counterfeit and substandard products remain a public-health concern in Nigeria despite repeated raids, seizures, arrests and prosecutions by the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC). The problem extends beyond medicines to adulterated food, beverages, cosmetics, medical devices and other regulated products. Such products may contain harmful ingredients, incorrect quantities of active pharmaceutical ingredients or substances that have not undergone the required safety and quality checks. The consequences of using substandard and falsified medicines, according to NAFDAC, include treatment failure, prolonged hospitalisation, increased hospital admissions, antimicrobial resistance and, in severe cases, death. The persistence of the trade is illustrated by the repeated discovery of illegal manufacturing and distribution facilities, including in major pharmaceutical markets such as Onitsha, Aba and Lagos. A BusinessDay investigation published in August found that NAFDAC’s enforcement records showed that products worth more than N1.1 trillion had been seized or destroyed between 2023 and 2025, yet the agency continued to encounter counterfeit and substandard products in previously raided distribution centres. Between January and August. NAFDAC’s Directorate of Investigation and Enforcement arrested 52 suspects, raided 213 locations, seized 821 products and sealed 179 premises. The NAFDAC’s Director-General, Mojisola Adeyeye, recently said the agency had secured 64 convictions for counterfeiting, with sentences ranging from one to seven years’ imprisonment without the option of a fine. Two separate but related legislative bills are before the Senate, sponsored by Sadiq Umar (APC, Kwara North). They are: the Counterfeit Medical Products, Fake Drugs and Unwholesome Processed Foods (Prohibition and Control) Bill, 2026, and the Food, Drugs and Related Products (Registration, etc.) (Repeal) Bill, 2026. The amendment to the counterfeit medical products bill seeks to repeal and replace the existing Counterfeit and Fake Drugs and Unwholesome Processed Foods (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 2004, with a more comprehensive framework for addressing counterfeit medical products, fake drugs and unsafe processed foods. It prescribes a 15-year prison term for offenders upon conviction, alongside asset forfeiture and compensation for victims. It also seeks to strengthen NAFDAC’s enforcement powers. While the proposed Food, Drugs and Related Products Bill focuses directly on criminalising counterfeiting and prescribing punishments, it also modernises the regulatory framework governing food, drugs and other products under NAFDAC’s control
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.title_zh: 人民民主党前发言人主张对假药和掺假商品生产者施加更严厉处罚
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 人民民主党（PDP）前全国宣传秘书Olisa Metuh敦促尼日利亚国民议会修改有关假冒产品的法律，对参与生产、销售假药及其他掺假商品的人规定更严厉的处罚。Metuh先生是执政的进步大会党（APC）成员，也是“重燃希望大使”（RHA）动员与组织主任；他建议，对任何被判定生产或销售假冒产品的人，判处更长的刑期并没收其资产。他于星期五发表声明，回应阿比亚州联邦高等法院对Innocent Okoye的定罪；Okoye因生产并销售假冒特级初榨橄榄油被判刑。Okoye被判处5年监禁，也可选择缴纳N5 million罚款。身为律师的Metuh先生表示，这一判决，尤其是可以缴纳罚款的选择，对于一种可能危及数百万尼日利亚人健康的罪行来说过于宽缓。他警告，如果不引入更严厉的处罚以震慑违法者，制假活动就会持续存在。他说：“5年监禁或N5 million罚款不过是轻轻拍一下手。这样的惩罚可能让制假和产品掺假成为不法制造商和销售商可以轻松承担的经营成本。法律必须以与罪行相称的后果予以回应。违法者与受害者之间没有直接的身体冲突，并不会使产品制假比传统暴力犯罪更不危险。”他敦促国民议会紧急审查现行有关药品制假、药品掺假和伪造消费品的法律，并认为处罚力度应反映此类罪行可能对公共健康造成的危害。尽管国家食品药品监督管理总局（NAFDAC）多次开展突袭、查扣、逮捕和起诉，假冒及不合格产品在尼日利亚仍是公共卫生问题。这一问题不仅涉及药品，还涉及掺假食品、饮料、化妆品、医疗器械和其他受监管产品。这些产品可能含有有害成分、含量不符的活性药物成分，或含有未经必要安全与质量检测的物质。NAFDAC表示，使用不合格和伪造药品的后果包括治疗失败、住院时间延长、住院人数增加、抗微生物药物耐药性，严重情况下还会致死。非法生产设施和销售点不断被发现，反映出这一非法贸易依然存在，其中包括奥尼查、阿巴和拉各斯等主要药品市场。BusinessDay于8月发布的一项调查发现，NAFDAC的执法记录显示，2023年至2025年间，该机构查扣或销毁了价值超过N1.1 trillion的产品，但在此前遭突袭的销售中心，仍持续发现假冒和不合格产品。1月至8月间，NAFDAC调查与执法局逮捕了52名嫌疑人，突袭213个地点，查扣821件产品，并查封179处场所。NAFDAC总干事Mojisola Adeyeye近日表示，该机构已就制假行为取得64项定罪，刑期从1年至7年不等，且不得以缴纳罚款代替服刑。参议院目前审议着两项彼此独立但相互关联的法案，均由夸拉北区的Sadiq Umar（APC）提出，分别是《2026年假冒医疗产品、假药和不安全加工食品（禁止与管制）法案》和《2026年食品、药品及相关产品（登记等）（废止）法案》。对假冒医疗产品法案的修订拟废止并取代现行《2004年假冒与假药及不安全加工食品（杂项规定）法》，以建立更全面的框架，处理假冒医疗产品、假药和不安全加工食品问题。法案规定，违法者一经定罪将被判处15年监禁，并没收资产、赔偿受害者，同时寻求加强NAFDAC的执法权。拟议中的《食品、药品及相关产品法案》重点将制假行为入刑并规定处罚，同时还将更新NAFDAC监管食品、药品和其他受管制产品的监管框架。

https://dailytrust.com/asuu-fg-agreement.body: The Kaduna State University(KASU) branch of the Academic Staff Union of Universities(ASUU), has commended Governor Uba Sani for fully implementing the 2025 Federal Government-ASUU Agreement. In a press briefing on Friday, the union noted that the implementation of the agreement and the commitment to the welfare of academic staff, will enhance morale, improved productivity and strengthen industrial relations. The briefing which was delivered by Comrade Abubakar Abdullahi and Comrade Silas Amos Bakut, Chairman and Secretary respectively, also recalled other welfare initiatives that Governor Uba Sani had earlier extended to their members. According to the duo, the latest intervention represents a significant milestone in the development of the university and it is expected to contribute to the overall advancement of the institution. ‘’We consider this development a positive demonstration of the State Government’s recognition of the vital role of academic staff in advancing quality university education and sustainable development,’’ ASUU noted. The union commended Kaduna State Government and the Management of KASU for their commendable and exemplary handling of the earlier industrial action. ‘’For the avoidance of doubt, we wish to state categorically that, at no point during the strike action, were the union or its members subjected to intimidation, threats or any form of harassment. ‘’Remarkably, our salaries were paid while the strike was still ongoing, and engagements between the union, the Government and University Management remained cordial, constructive and focused on addressing the fundamental issues in dispute. ‘’This approach represents a significant departure from some of the unfortunate experiences of the past and demonstrates a renewed commitment to mutual respect, dialogue and the peaceful resolution of industrial disputes,’’ ASUU disclosed. ‘’Specifically, the Government has addressed the 60 percent withheld salary of 2017, paid outstanding Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES) allowances for the period 2016-2020 and settled five months of withheld salaries covering May to September 2022,’’ the union disclosed. ‘’Furthermore, the Governing Council and Management of Kaduna State University are working collaboratively with the union towards resolving outstanding death benefits and promotion arrears dating from 2021,’’ ASUU added. While commending the Governor and the varsity management for demonstrating the leadership, courage and the political will required to address these longstanding challenges, the union noted that the interventions have brought considerable relief to affected members. The ASUU executives also listed other initiatives that the Kaduna State Government, under Governor Uba Sani, have extended to them in the last three and half years, to enhance staff welfare. ‘’Beyond the land allocation, His Excellency graciously approved a subsidy of 4,000,000,00 for each beneficiary, amounting to approximately 400,000,000.00 for the project. ‘’This intervention has reduced the cost of a housing unit from 40,000,000.00 to 136,000,000.00, thereby making homeownership more accessible to the beneficiaries,’’ ASUU pointed out. The union expressed appreciation for the genuine commitment in prioritising dialogue over confrontation and seeking sustainable solutions to their concerns, exhibited by Government and KASU Management. ‘’We reiterate our commitment to constructive engagement with the State Government, the Governing Council and University Management towards resolving all outstanding welfare issues, strengthening industrial harmony and positioning Kaduna State University among the leading universities in Nigeria and globally, ‘’ they promised. ASUU also commended the invaluable contributions, leadership and commitment of the Commissioner of Education and Chairman of the Negotiation Committee, Emeritus Professor Abubakar Sani Sambo. The union also praised the ‘’Chairman of the Governing Council, Dr. Ibrahim Umar; the Chairman of the Sub-Committee, Professor Usman Abubakar; and all other members of the Negotiation Committee for their dedication and concerted efforts towards resolving the issues in dispute.’’ Join Daily Trust WhatsApp Community For Quick Access To News and Happenings Around You
https://dailytrust.com/asuu-fg-agreement.title_zh: ASUU与联邦政府达成协议：科吉州立大学全体教职工支持乌巴·萨尼推动协议落实
https://dailytrust.com/asuu-fg-agreement.body_zh: 卡杜纳州立大学（KASU）教职工工会全国高校学术工作人员工会（ASUU）分会赞扬州长乌巴·萨尼全面落实2025年联邦政府与ASUU的协议。工会于周五举行的新闻发布会上表示，落实该协议并承诺改善学术工作人员的福利，将提升士气、提高工作效率并加强劳资关系。新闻发布会由工会主席阿布巴卡尔·阿卜杜拉希和秘书西拉斯·阿莫斯·巴库特分别代表工会进行。会上还回顾了州长乌巴·萨尼此前为其成员提供的其他福利举措。两人表示，政府的最新干预措施是大学发展进程中的重要里程碑，预计将推动学校整体进步。ASUU指出：“我们认为，这一进展积极体现了州政府认可学术工作人员在推动优质大学教育和可持续发展方面发挥的关键作用。”工会赞扬卡杜纳州政府和KASU管理层妥善且堪称典范地处理了此前的劳资行动。工会称：“为避免任何疑问，我们郑重声明，在罢工行动期间，工会及其成员任何时候都未遭受恐吓、威胁或任何形式的骚扰。值得注意的是，罢工仍在进行期间，我们的工资就已获得支付；工会、政府与大学管理层之间的交涉始终保持友好、建设性，并专注于解决争议中的根本问题。这种做法与过去一些不幸经历相比有着显著不同，体现了各方重新承诺相互尊重、对话以及和平解决劳资争端。”ASUU透露：“具体而言，政府已补发2017年被扣留的60%工资，支付2016年至2020年期间尚未发放的学生工业工作经验计划（SIWES）津贴，并结清2022年5月至9月共5个月被扣留的工资。”工会补充道：“此外，卡杜纳州立大学理事会和管理层正与工会合作解决尚未落实的死亡福利以及自2021年以来积压的晋升待遇问题。”在赞扬州长和大学管理层展现出解决这些长期遗留问题所需的领导力、勇气和政治意愿的同时，工会指出，这些干预措施给受影响的成员带来了极大缓解。ASNU执行机构还列举了卡杜纳州政府在乌巴·萨尼州长领导下于过去三年半间为其成员提供的其他福利举措，以改善员工待遇。工会表示：“除土地分配外，阁下还慷慨批准为每位受益人提供4,000,000,00的补贴，该项目总额约为400,000,000.00。这项干预措施将每套住房的成本从40,000,000.00降至136,000,000.00，使受益人更容易实现拥有住房的愿望。”工会对政府和KASU管理层优先通过对话而非对抗、并 seeks seeking可持续解决方案解决其所关关切所表现出的真诚投入表示感谢。工会承诺：“我们重申，将与州政府、理事会和大学管理层保持建设性合作，解决所有尚未落实的福利问题，加强劳资和谐，并推动卡杜纳州立大学跻身尼日利亚乃至全球领先大学行列。”ASUU还赞扬了教育专员兼谈判委员会主席、荣休教授阿布巴卡尔·萨尼·桑博作出的宝贵贡献、领导力和投入。工会还表扬了理事会主席易卜拉欣·乌马尔博士、专门委员会主席乌斯曼·阿布巴卡尔教授以及谈判委员会其他全体成员，感谢他们为解决争议问题所作的奉献和共同努力。加入 Daily Trust WhatsApp 社群，即可快捷获取身边的新闻与动态

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: INCHEON — South Korea and the United States have complementary strengths and are capable of driving "great" progress in the nuclear sector amid a heated global race to develop next-generation reactors, a U.S. State Department official said. Christopher Klein, the deputy assistant secretary for nuclear nonproliferation and commercial competitiveness at the U.S. Department of State, made the remarks in an exclusive interview with Yonhap News Agency on Wednesday, saying the global landscape has transitioned into a "nuclear renaissance." "We are countries that both have a lot of experience and expertise, and when we work together ... we can achieve great things," Klein said during the interview on the margins of the International Ministerial Conference on Nuclear Power held in Incheon, west of Seoul. The three-day event, organized by the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), was held in South Korea for the first time this year. Klein's comment comes amid growing attention to Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) — a new class of nuclear power plants -- as countries seek reliable, carbon-free power to meet surging electricity demand driven by artificial intelligence (AI) and data centers. The technology is viewed as a more flexible and potentially less costly alternative to traditional large-scale nuclear power plants. It also comes as the U.S. and South Korea have drawn closer in the SMR sector, with local companies actively partnering with U.S. firms in the development and construction of such reactors. SK Group made financial investments in TerraPower LLC, a U.S. nuclear power company founded by Bill Gates, in 2022 to develop and commercialize SMRs in the U.S. and global markets. Doosan Enerbility, a local nuclear power plant builder, has recently won a supply contract from the U.S.-based SMR developer NuScale Power to supply a key reactor component. Such tightening private sector ties are being reinforced by institutional efforts. In July, South Korea, the U.S. and Japan signed a memorandum of cooperation (MOC) to establish a government-led framework to combine their respective strengths in the nuclear sector to jointly respond to surging energy demand and geopolitical competition. The three countries agreed to work together in deploying nuclear reactors, supply chain optimization, and knowledge transfer and training, according to a fact sheet on the MOC. The trilateral agreement is still in its early stages, in which the three countries are closely communicating to identify where to start deploying SMRs together, the U.S. official said. But Washington hopes to move "quickly" toward some actual projects "as soon as possible," he noted. "I think working together, the United States, the Republic of Korea and Japan, we wouldn't just survive. ... We would thrive, and I think we would be a formidable competitor around the world (in the nuclear sector)," the official said, referring to South Korea by its official name. "I look forward to some big announcements to come. There's a big market out there, and there's a competition, and you got to be in it to win it."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国国务院官员：韩国和美国能够在小型模块化反应堆方面取得“重大”进展
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 仁川——美国国务院官员表示，在全球竞相开发下一代反应堆的激烈竞争中，韩国和美国优势互补，有能力推动核能领域取得“重大”进展。美国国务院负责核不扩散与商业竞争力的副助理国务卿克里斯托弗·克莱恩周三接受韩联社独家采访时说，全球格局已经进入“核能复兴”时期。克莱恩是在首尔以西仁川举行的国际核电部长级会议期间接受采访的。他说：“我们两国都拥有丰富的经验和专业知识，而当我们携手合作时……就能取得重大成就。”这次为期三天的活动由国际原子能机构（IAEA）组织，今年首次在韩国举行。随着各国寻求可靠、无碳的电力，以满足人工智能（AI）和数据中心推动的用电需求激增，小型模块化反应堆（SMR）——一种新型核电站——受到越来越多的关注。这种技术被视为比传统大型核电站更灵活、且可能成本更低的替代方案。与此同时，美国和韩国在SMR领域的联系日益密切，韩国本土企业正积极与美国企业合作开发和建设此类反应堆。2022年，SK集团投资美国核电企业TerraPower LLC，以在美国和全球市场开发并商业化SMR；该公司由比尔·盖茨创立。韩国本土核电站制造商斗山能源近期获得了美国SMR开发商NuScale Power的供应合同，将供应一种关键反应堆部件。机构层面的努力也在加强这种私营部门联系。今年7月，韩国、美国和日本签署了一份合作谅解备忘录（MOC），拟建立政府主导的合作框架，整合三方在核能领域的优势，共同应对能源需求激增和地缘政治竞争。根据该谅解备忘录的概况文件，三国同意在部署核反应堆、优化供应链以及知识转移和培训方面开展合作。这名美国官员说，这项三方协议仍处于早期阶段，三国正密切沟通，确定从何处开始共同部署SMR。不过，他指出，华盛顿希望“尽快”推进相关工作，“尽早”落实具体项目。他说：“我认为，美国、大韩民国和日本如果携手合作，就不只是能够生存下去。……我们会蓬勃发展，而且我认为我们会成为全球核能领域里一支强大的竞争力量。”他以韩国的正式国名称呼该国。他表示：“我期待接下来能有一些重大消息公布。外面有一个巨大的市场，也存在竞争，而你必须参与其中，才能赢得竞争。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: K-pop group BOYNEXTDOOR will kick off its first-ever North American tour Friday (U.S. time) with a show in Dallas, the group's agency, Koz Entertainment, said. Following the Dallas concert, the sextet is scheduled to perform in Florida, Chicago, New York, Toronto, Vancouver, Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles and Mexico City through Nov. 24. "Every visit to the United States has given us meaningful memories and positive inspiration, so we are excited for this trip too," the group said in a release. "We will perform with passion and return with happy memories. We hope audiences look forward to our explosive energy and chemistry with them." The North American dates are part of BOYNEXTDOOR's first-ever world tour, titled "Knock on Vol. 2," which began in Seoul in July and continued across Japan. Following the North American leg, the group is set to perform in six other Asian regions into January 2027

https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/.body: With its all-stock acquisition of European Lithium now moving toward the issue of new shares, Critical Metals ( NASDAQ:CRML ) is sliding as critical minerals peers pull back after the previous session’s rally. Critical Metals stock is at $7.59, down 7% during the morning session. Meanwhile, USA Rare Earth ( NASDAQ:USAR ) stock is at $10.07, down 3%. United States Antimony ( NYSEAMERICAN:UAMY ) stock is at $3.22, down 3%. Critical Metals disclosed on October 27 that its schemes of arrangement to acquire 100% of European Lithium’s issued share capital and all of its listed options became effective after approval by the Supreme Court of Western Australia. Eligible European Lithium shareholders receive 0.045 new shares per European Lithium share under the share scheme. On October 28, Critical Metals confirmed the option scheme consideration at 0.0353158621 new Critical Metals shares per European Lithium option, or approximately 35.32 shares for every 1,000 options, subject to rounding. That ratio comes from a cashless exercise formula, which converts options into stock without option owners paying cash to exercise them. According to Critical Metals, the formula used a scheme volume-weighted average price (VWAP) of $7.25. The record date is October 29, followed by implementation and the issue of new shares on November 5, with trading on Nasdaq expected to begin November 6. Those dates are preliminary and subject to change, the company noted. Paying for an acquisition with newly issued stock raises the share count at Critical Metals, which spreads ownership of the company across more shares, but no total share count for the issuance appears in the releases, so the size of that dilution isn’t clear yet. For existing shareholders, the coming batch of stock is an burden to consider alongside the sector’s pullback. European Lithium’s interests tie into the Tanbreez rare earth project in Southern Greenland, which Critical Metals calls one of the world’s largest rare earth deposits. Critical Metals also holds the Wolfsberg lithium project in Austria, described by the company as the first fully permitted mine in Europe. Each asset remains pre-revenue, and the company’s own reports have raised substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. That risk profile stands against a strong run for Critical Metals stock, which climbed sharply over the past week and is up 14% year to date (YTD). Both USA Rare Earth and United States Antimony are down more than Critical Metals. Year to date, USA Rare Earth stock is down 15%, though the company is building a U.S.-based rare earth magnet supply chain. United States Antimony stock is down 36% YTD, even as the company already generates revenue from antimony and zeolite and supplies the U.S. defense supply chain under a sole-source Defense Logistics Agency contract. MP Materials ( NYSE:MP ) stock is at $40, down 2%. Shares of MP Materials are down 20% YTD. A pullback after the previous session’s group rally fits the declines across MP Materials, USA Rare Earth and United States Antimony. A key question for Critical Metals is whether former European Lithium shareholders sell their new stock once it can trade. A smooth debut after the record date and the early-November issue could ease the burden, while heavy selling could add pressure. Progress on Tanbreez development and funding may matter as much, since Critical Metals is still seeking project financing for both projects. Interest rates are another factor, with the Federal Reserve’s policy decision due October 28 and the upper bound of the federal funds target range at 4% heading in. Speculative pre-revenue small caps like Critical Metals tend to be sensitive to rate expectations, so a dovish tone could lift risk appetite while a hawkish one could weigh on the group. A conservative approach could make sense while the burden from the new Critical Metals shares resolves. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has commended Dunamis International Gospel Centre (DIGC) for building a pedestrian bridge along the busy Airport Road, Abuja. Mr Wike gave the commendation in Abuja on Friday during the inauguration of the pedestrian bridge built at the Church headquarters, the 100,000-capacity Glory Dome, Abuja. He described the project as an exemplary model of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). The minister revealed that while the church applied for approval to construct the facility in 2018, the application was brought to his attention only in February 2026, leading to swift approval within one month. He described the approval as evidence of President Bola Tinubu’s commitment to good governance, urging members of the Church to support government with proven capacity to respond to the needs of the people. He said, “Government cannot do everything alone; there is nowhere in the world where government carries every burden. That is why we emphasise comprehensive social responsibility.” To further encourage community-driven infrastructure, the minister announced that the FCT Administration (FCTA) would defray 50 per cent of the total cost the church incurred in constructing the bridge. He commended the Senior Pastor of Dunamis, Paul Enenche, and his wife, Becky Enenche, for demonstrating leadership and sacrificing church resources to save lives and enhance human welfare rather than focusing solely on soul-winning. The minister, however, decried the habitual refusal of many pedestrians to use constructed bridges, choosing instead to risk their lives crossing high-speed expressways. He warned against continuous public criticism of government actions on social media when enforcement measures were deployed to maintain public order and safety. Earlier, Mr Enenche, the senior pastor of the DIGC, said the decision to construct the pedestrian bridge was borne out of concern over the frequent fatal accidents recorded along the Airport Road axis. He urged public-spirited individuals and leaders to live for societal impact and keep eternity in view, emphasising that resources must be deployed for the collective good of humanity. On her part, the senator representing the FCT, Ireti Kingibe, commended the church for backing its faith with compassionate action. Mrs Kingibe described the ministry as “a beacon of light” and urged residents and leaders across the territory to unite to build a safer, more peaceful capital
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: Wike赞扬Dunamis Church为阿布贾建造人行天桥
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: Federal Capital Territory (FCT) 部长 Nyesom Wike 赞扬 Dunamis International Gospel Centre (DIGC) 在阿布贾繁忙的 Airport Road 沿线修建了一座人行天桥。周五，Wike 先生在阿布贾可容纳100,000人的教会总部 Glory Dome 举行的这座人行天桥竣工仪式上表达了上述赞扬。他称该项目是企业社会责任 (CSR) 的典范。部长透露，该教会于2018年申请批准建设这座设施，但直到2026年2月才提交他审议，随后在1个月内迅速获批。他称此次批准证明 President Bola Tinubu 致力于推行良政，并鼓励该教会成员支持政府，因为政府已经展现出回应民众需求的实际能力。他说：“政府无法独自完成所有事情；世界上没有任何地方由政府承担一切责任。因此，我们强调全面社会责任。”为进一步鼓励社区主导的基础设施建设，部长宣布，FCT Administration (FCTA) 将承担该教会修建这座天桥所产生总成本的50%。他还赞扬 Dunamis 高级牧师 Paul Enenche 及其妻子 Becky Enenche 展现出领导力，并奉献教会资源来挽救生命、改善人类福祉，而不是仅仅专注于使人灵魂得救。不过，部长谴责许多行人习惯性拒绝使用已经建成的天桥，反而选择冒险穿越高速公路，置自身生命于险境。他警告，当局为维护公共秩序与安全而采取执法措施时，不应在社交媒体上持续批评政府的行动。此前，DIGC 高级牧师 Enenche 先生表示，决定修建这座人行天桥，是因为担忧 Airport Road 沿线频繁发生致命事故。他敦促富有公益精神的人士和领袖以社会影响为人生追求，并始终着眼永恒，强调资源必须用于全人类的共同福祉。代表 FCT 的参议员 Ireti Kingibe 也赞扬该教会以富有同理心的行动践行信仰。Kingibe 女士称这一事工是“一盏明灯”，并敦促全境居民和领袖团结起来，共同建设一个更安全、更和平的首都

https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.summary: Central to this effort is expanding access to the dedicated $40 million Women in Oil and Gas Fund, ensuring that more women-owned businesses and professionals benefit from industry’s opportunities and play a stronger role across the sector’s value chain. In April 2021, the NCDMB established a $20 million fund dedicated to supporting women-owned and women-led businesses in the oil and gas sector.
https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.summary_zh: 这项努力的核心是扩大对专项4000万美元“石油与天然气女性基金”的准入，确保更多女性拥有的企业和专业人士能够受益于行业机会，并在整个行业价值链中发挥更重要的作用。2021年4月，尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会设立了一笔2000万美元的专项基金，用于支持石油和天然气行业由女性拥有及女性领导的企业。
https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.body: Central to this effort is expanding access to the dedicated $40 million Women in Oil and Gas Fund, ensuring that more women-owned businesses and professionals benefit from industry’s opportunities and play a stronger role across the sector’s value chain. In April 2021, the NCDMB established a $20 million fund dedicated to supporting women-owned and women-led businesses in the oil and gas sector. The Nigerian Export-Import Bank (NEXIM) complemented this effort by matching the fund with an additional $20 million. However, despite this significant commitment and favorable loan terms, the uptake of the scheme has remained below expectations to date. On Thursday, UN Women’s Country Representative to Nigeria and the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), Ms. Beatrice Eyong, led a delegation to the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board’s (NCDMB) Abuja liaison office. The team was received by the Board’s General Manager of Corporate Communications, Dr. Obinna Ezeobi, on behalf of the Executive Secretary, Engr. Felix Omatsola Ogbe. The meeting explored proposed capacity-building initiatives for NCDMB personnel, aimed at mainstreaming gender perspectives into the Board’s project planning, budgeting, and execution frameworks. Other key areas of discussion included vendor development schemes to better position women-led oil and gas businesses for industry opportunities, strategies to raise awareness of available financing options, and potential affirmative procurement measures designed to expand the participation of women-owned companies across the oil and gas value chain. The UN official commended NCDMB for its ongoing gender inclusion efforts, noting that the Board is already implementing several measures consistent with its mandate. She proposed conducting a study to identify the reasons women face challenges in accessing the financing facility, including potential barriers related to documentation, business registration, tax compliance, and limited awareness. She further highlighted key initiatives currently being undertaken by the UN Office, such as programs on women’s economic empowerment, leadership development, and the elimination of gender-based violence, among others. NCDMB’s General Manager of Corporate Communications, Dr. Obinna Ezeobi, welcomed the proposals and affirmed the Board’s readiness to partner with UN Women. He highlighted several innovative initiatives already implemented by the Board to create opportunities for women to participate, grow, and lead in Nigeria’s oil and gas industry. These include the establishment of a dedicated funding scheme with NEXIM Bank that enables women-owned or women-led firms to access financing at a highly competitive 5% interest rate, as well as the creation of a Diversity Sectoral Working Group within the Nigerian Content Consultative Forum (NCCF), designed to mainstream women’s issues into local content policy and decision-making processes. The Board also supports associations of women who work across the Energy Industry value chain, where they network, build confidence and links to progress their careers or businesses. Dr. Ezeobi noted that NCDMB has also invested significantly in capacity-building programs for women entrepreneurs and business leaders, covering critical areas such as business sustainability, corporate governance, and strategic management. The Board has further supported women’s participation in technical occupations while encouraging young girls to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). He acknowledged that women remain underrepresented in the oil and gas industry, citing limited access to technical education, finance, and commercial opportunities, as well as entrenched perceptions of the sector as predominantly male. Dr. Ezeobi reaffirmed NCDMB’s willingness to collaborate with UN Women to address these challenges and recommended strategies to accelerate the Board’s support for UN Women’s programmes, thereby advancing gender inclusion across the industry. https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.body_zh: 这项努力的核心，是扩大专门面向女性石油与天然气行业的4000万美元基金的可及性，确保更多女性拥有的企业和专业人士能够从行业机遇中受益，并在整个行业价值链中发挥更重要的作用。2021年4月，NCDMB设立了一项2000万美元的专项基金，用于支持石油与天然气行业中的女性所有企业和女性领导企业。尼日利亚进出口银行（NEXIM）通过追加2000万美元资金，与该基金形成配套，为这项努力提供支持。然而，尽管做出了这一重大承诺并提供了优惠贷款条件，该计划迄今的使用率仍低于预期。周四，联合国妇女署驻尼日利亚及西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）国别代表Beatrice Eyong女士率领代表团前往尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会（NCDMB）阿布贾联络办公室。该委员会企业传播总经理Obinna Ezeobi博士代表执行秘书Felix Omatsola Ogbe工程师接待了来访团队。会议探讨了为NCDMB人员制定能力建设方案的 proposed aiming to mainstream gender perspectives into the Board’s project planning, budgeting, and execution frameworks。其他重点讨论领域包括：通过供应商发展计划，进一步提升女性领导的石油与天然气企业把握行业机遇的能力；制定提高对可用融资选项认识度的策略；以及研究实施肯定性采购措施，以扩大女性所有企业在石油与天然气价值链中的参与。该联合国官员赞扬了NCDMB持续推动性别包容的努力，并指出，该委员会正在实施多项符合其职责要求的措施。她提议开展一项研究，查明女性在获取融资方面面临困难的原因，包括文件准备、企业注册、税务合规和认知有限等潜在障碍。她还强调，联合国办公室目前正在开展多项重点行动，包括促进女性经济赋权、培养领导力和消除基于性别的暴力等方案。NCDMB企业传播总经理Obinna Ezeobi博士对这些提议表示欢迎，并确认该委员会已准备与联合国妇女署合作。他介绍了委员会已经实施的若干创新举措，旨在为女性参与、发展并在尼日利亚石油与天然气行业发挥领导作用创造机会。这些举措包括与NEXIM银行设立专项融资计划，使女性所有或女性领导的企业能够以极具竞争力的5%利率获得融资；以及在尼日利亚本地内容咨询论坛（NCCF）内设立多元化部门工作组，将女性议题纳入本地内容政策和决策进程。委员会还支持在能源行业价值链各领域工作的女性协会，使女性能够拓展人际网络、建立信心和联系，进而推动职业或企业发展。Ezeobi博士指出，NCDMB还在女性创业者和商业领袖的能力建设项目中投入了大量资金，涵盖企业可持续性、公司治理和战略管理等关键领域。该委员会还支持女性参与技术职业，同时鼓励年轻女孩投身科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）领域。他承认，女性的代表性在石油与天然气行业仍然不足，原因包括获取技术教育、金融和商业机会的渠道有限，以及该行业主要由男性主导这一根深蒂固的观念。Ezeobi博士重申，NCDMB愿意与联合国妇女署合作应对这些挑战，并建议采取相关策略，加快该委员会对联合国妇女署项目的支持，从而推动整个行业的性别包容。掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候最新消息 →

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-medica.body: The Ghana Medical Trust Fund (GMTF) is seeking partnerships with American hospitals, investors and philanthropists to expand cancer treatment and other specialist healthcare services in Ghana. The Fund’s Administrator, Adjoa Obuobia Darko-Opoku, made the appeal at the Ghana-Tennessee Business and Investor Roundtable in Nashville, Tennessee. She said partnerships could help close gaps in diagnostics, treatment, specialist training, and hospital infrastructure while easing patients' financial burden. “For many families, a diagnosis is difficult enough. But the next question is often even more frightening: how are we going to afford the treatment, and where can we access this care?” she said. Ms Darko-Opoku said the Fund had enrolled more than 800 patients for treatment under its services package. It covers 13 common cancers, neurosurgical conditions, cardiovascular diseases and kidney diseases. Outlining the Fund’s work, she said it had reconstructed the cardiac catheterisation laboratory at Korle Bu Teaching Hospital after a fire disrupted services. According to her, the facility has supported more than 160 procedures since it was commissioned, including 110 involving children. She said oncology centres were under construction at Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital in Kumasi and Tamale Teaching Hospital. The Fund is also working with the KGL Group on a proposed $10 million diagnostic and imaging centre at Ridge Hospital. The project aims to improve access to MRI, CT scans, and mammography. Plans are also underway for an advanced comprehensive oncology centre at Korle Bu to ease pressure on existing facilities and reduce waiting times. Ms Darko-Opoku said the Fund was investing close to GH¢1 billion in medical equipment for major hospitals. These include dialysis machines, intensive care beds, oxygen concentrators and patient monitors. To address workforce shortages, the Fund is sponsoring the training of 100 specialist pharmacists and 100 specialist nurses. It is also supporting specialist medical training centres in six regions. She identified infrastructure, medical technology, specialist training, research and financial assistance for vulnerable patients as priority areas for US partnerships. The Fund is also exploring adding treatments such as kidney transplantation to its services package. Ms Darko-Opoku said government resources alone could not meet Ghana’s growing specialist healthcare needs. She urged American institutions and the Ghanaian diaspora to commit to specific projects with clear implementation plans and measurable outcomes. “We are open to partnerships that bring together investment, technical expertise and a shared commitment to results,” she said. Potential support could include diagnostic equipment, clinical exchanges, cancer care facilities, research funding and treatment assistance for patients who cannot afford care. “What we have achieved so far shows what is possible. With the right partnerships, we can do much more,” she said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-medica.title_zh: 加纳医疗信托基金争取美国合作伙伴，扩大癌症医疗服务
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-medica.body_zh: 加纳医疗信托基金（GMTF）正寻求与美国医院、投资者和慈善家建立合作关系，以扩大加纳的癌症治疗及其他专科医疗服务。该基金管理员阿乔阿·奥博比亚·达尔科-奥波库在田纳西州纳什维尔举行的“加纳—田纳西商业与投资者圆桌会议”上提出这一倡议。她说，合作有助于弥合诊断、治疗、专科培训和医院基础设施等方面的缺口，同时减轻患者的经济负担。她说：“对许多家庭而言，确诊本身已经足够艰难。但接下来的问题往往更加令人恐惧：我们如何负担治疗费用，又能在哪里获得这种医疗服务？”达尔科-奥波库女士表示，该基金已根据其服务套餐安排800多名患者接受治疗。服务范围涵盖13种常见癌症、神经外科疾病、心血管疾病和肾脏疾病。她在介绍该基金的工作时说，Korle Bu教学医院心导管实验室因火灾中断服务后，基金对其进行了重建。据她介绍，该设施投入运行以来已支持160多台手术，其中110台涉及儿童。她说，库马西Komfo Anokye教学医院和塔马利教学医院的肿瘤中心正在建设之中。该基金还正与KGL集团合作，拟在Ridge Hospital建设一座价值1000万美元的诊断和影像中心。该项目旨在改善患者接受MRI、CT扫描和乳腺摄影检查的机会。Korle Bu还在规划建设一座先进的综合肿瘤中心，以缓解现有设施的压力并缩短等待时间。达尔科-奥波库女士表示，该基金正投入近10亿加纳塞地，为大型医院采购医疗设备，包括透析机、重症监护床、制氧机和患者监护仪。为应对医疗人才短缺，该基金正资助100名专科药师和100名专科护士接受培训，并支持在6个地区建设专科医疗培训中心。她将基础设施、医疗技术、专科培训、研究以及为弱势患者提供财务援助列为与美国合作的重点领域。该基金还在研究将肾移植等治疗项目纳入其服务套餐。达尔科-奥波库女士表示，仅靠政府资源无法满足加纳不断增长的专科医疗需求。她敦促美国机构和加侨投身于具有明确实施计划和可衡量成果的具体项目。她说：“我们欢迎将投资、技术专长和共同追求成效的承诺结合起来的合作关系。”潜在支持可包括提供诊断设备、推动临床交流、建设癌症护理设施、资助研究，以及帮助无力承担治疗费用的患者。“我们迄今取得的成就表明了可能性。有了合适的合作关系，我们能够做得更多。”她说。
