https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-ghan.body: Telecel Ghana marked World Sustainability Day with a renewed commitment to practical climate action, showcasing how it integrates sustainability into its network operations, products, employee culture, and social impact initiatives. The organisation celebrated this year’s World Sustainability Day as a premium partner of the Ghana National Climate & ESG Policy Summit 2026, organised by Intelligence Nature International under the auspices of the Office of the Minister of State for Climate Change and Sustainability. The summit brought together policymakers, regulators, development institutions, and private-sector leaders to discuss Ghana’s green transition and businesses' role in accelerating climate action. Speaking during a private-sector panel discussion, Rita Agyeiwaa Rockson, Head of Sustainability, Foundation and External Communications at Telecel Ghana, called for sustainability to move from complex concepts and high-level commitments to practical actions organisations, entrepreneurs, and individuals can understand and adopt. “Sustainability cannot remain a conversation that only happens at the top, based on the assumption that everyone understands it. We need to simplify the language and connect it to the everyday decisions of organisations and individuals. When people understand how sustainability reduces costs, strengthens resilience and improves access to customers and investors, it becomes relevant to them,” Rita said. She encouraged organisations to start with achievable interventions, measure results, and use credible data to build toward broader climate ambitions. “There are practical actions that corporate organisations, small businesses and individuals can take to contribute to the larger sustainability goals we want to achieve. The important thing is to start, collect the data and communicate the impact being created,” she added. For Telecel Ghana, this approach is reflected in how the organisation integrates sustainability across its operations. To reduce the environmental footprint of its operations, Telecel Ghana is transitioning parts of its network infrastructure to renewable energy, with 15 exchanges currently powered by solar. The investment reduces its reliance on the national grid and supports more sustainable network operations. In August 2026, Telecel Ghana introduced its biodegradable Eco-SIM, manufactured with 90 per cent less plastic than standard SIM cards. The organisation has also planted more than 40,000 trees across the Achimota, Chipa and South Fomangso forest reserves, contributing to reforestation and ecosystem restoration. Its sustainability efforts also extend to digital and financial inclusion. Telecel Ghana’s services let customers complete essential transactions remotely, reducing the need to travel, costs, and associated emissions. Its digital inclusion initiatives equip entrepreneurs, including women-led businesses, with the skills and tools to improve efficiency, access new markets and strengthen their enterprises. According to Rita, inclusion must remain central to Ghana’s transition to a greener economy. “As we build the communities and economies of the future, we must pay attention to who is being included. Digital and financial inclusion are essential to ensuring that the benefits of sustainable development reach entrepreneurs, small businesses and underserved communities,” she said. Throughout the Month, Telecel Ghana also encouraged employees to make more environmentally responsible choices. Activities included No-Plastic Days, which promoted alternatives to single-use plastics, and a Green Market that connected employees with local entrepreneurs offering environmentally responsible and locally made products. The activities demonstrated how everyday choices can promote responsible consumption while creating opportunities for entrepreneurs advancing circular production. The organization’s participation in the summit extended the internal campaign into a broader national conversation on climate action, sustainable finance, ESG disclosure, carbon markets and green investment. “We recognise that sustainability is a journey and that there is still more work to be done. Our ambition is clear: connect people and organisations in ways that support a more inclusive society while progressively reducing our environmental impact. Achieving this requires collaboration across sectors, practical action and consistent measurement of progress,” Rita said. Telecel Ghana’s sustainability agenda rests on four pillars: Responsible Business, Inclusion for All, Environmental Responsibility, and Sustainable Society. These pillars guide how the organisation manages its operations, deploys technology, supports communities and contributes to Ghana’s sustainable development. Through investments in renewable energy, responsible products, environmental restoration, digital inclusion and employee engagement, Telecel Ghana is working to make sustainability an enduring part of its business and the communities it serves
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-ghan.title_zh: Telecel Ghana在全国ESG峰会上展示务实的气候行动
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-ghan.body_zh:
加纳Telecel以实际行动强化承诺纪念世界可持续发展日，并展示如何将可持续发展融入网络运营、产品、员工文化和社会影响项目。该公司以高级合作伙伴身份参加2026年加纳国家气候与ESG政策峰会，庆祝今年的世界可持续发展日。峰会由Intelligence Nature International组织，在气候变化与可持续发展国务部长办公室支持下举行。峰会汇聚政策制定者、监管机构、发展机构和私营部门领袖，讨论加纳的绿色转型以及企业在加快气候行动方面的作用。

Telecel加纳可持续发展、基金会与对外传播负责人Rita Agyeiwaa Rockson在私营部门专题讨论中呼吁，可持续发展不应只停留在复杂理念和高层承诺上，而应转化为组织、创业者和个人都能理解并采取的实际行动。

Rita表示：“可持续发展不能只是一场只在高层进行的对话，更不能建立在所有人都理解它的假设之上。我们需要简化相关表述，并将其与组织和个人的日常决策联系起来。当人们明白可持续发展如何降低成本、增强韧性以及改善接触客户和投资者的渠道时，它才会真正与他们产生关联。”

她鼓励各组织从可实现的干预措施入手，衡量结果，并利用可信数据推动更宏大的气候目标。Rita补充道：“企业组织、小型企业和个人都可以采取实际行动，为实现我们期望的更大可持续发展目标作出贡献。重要的是迈出第一步、收集数据，并传达由此产生的影响。”

对Telecel加纳而言，这一方针体现在该公司将可持续发展融入各项运营的方式中。为减少运营对环境造成的影响，Telecel加纳正将部分网络基础设施转换为可再生能源，目前已有15个交换局由太阳能供电。这项投资减少了公司对国家电网的依赖，并支持更加可持续的网络运营。

2026年8月，Telecel加纳推出可生物降解的Eco-SIM，其制造过程使用的塑料比标准SIM卡少90%。该组织还在Achimota、Chipa和South Fomangso森林保护地种植了4万多棵树，为再造林和生态系统恢复作出贡献。

其可持续发展工作还延伸至数字普惠和金融普惠。Telecel加纳的服务让客户能够远程完成必要交易，从而减少出行需求、成本及相关排放。其数字普惠项目为创业者，包括女性创办的企业，提供技能和工具，帮助他们提高效率、开拓新市场并增强企业实力。

Rita表示，包容必须继续成为加纳向更绿色经济转型的核心。“在建设未来的社区和经济时，我们必须关注谁正被纳入其中。数字普惠和金融普惠对于确保可持续发展的成果惠及创业者、小型企业和服务不足的社区至关重要。”

在整个活动月期间，Telecel加纳还鼓励员工作出更具环境责任的选择。相关活动包括提倡减少一次性塑料制品的‘无塑料日’，以及把员工与提供环保及本地制造产品的当地创业者连接起来的绿色市场。这些活动表明，日常选择既可以促进负责任消费，也能为推动循环生产的企业创造机会。

该公司参加峰会，将内部活动扩展至围绕气候行动、可持续金融、ESG披露、碳市场和绿色投资的更广泛全国讨论。Rita表示：“我们认识到，可持续发展是一段旅程，仍有更多工作要做。我们的目标十分明确：以支持更具包容性的社会的方式连接人们和组织，同时逐步减少我们的环境影响。实现这一目标需要跨部门协作、实际行动以及持续衡量进展。”

Telecel加纳的可持续发展议程建立在四大支柱之上：负责任业务、人人包容、环境责任和可持续社会。这些支柱指引该组织管理运营、部署技术支持社区并为加纳的可持续发展作出贡献。

通过投资可再生能源、负责任的产品、环境恢复、数字普惠和员工参与，Telecel加纳正努力让可持续发展成为其业务及其所服务社区的一项长期特征

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: “他们那边存在一些情况，因此我认为我们需要听听他们的说法。”当记者问及会议能否推迟至12月以后时，康这样表示。不过，美国国防部周二称，预计会议将于2027年初举行，理由是高级官员之间存在日程冲突。周三达成的协议确认了此次延期，从而结束了这场年度会议是否会于今年举行的不确定性。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul and U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth confirmed the postponement during their first face-to-face meeting Wednesday on the sidelines of a regional defense gathering in Cebu, Philippines. The two also agreed to hold a bilateral defense meeting in Washington in December, ahead of the rescheduled SCM, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening defense cooperation and maintaining a strong combined defense posture. The meeting, initially scheduled to take 15 minutes, lasted about 40 minutes. Conducted with simultaneous interpretation, the extended talks allowed for in-depth discussion of alliance issues. Before departing for the Philippines, Kang said the SCM schedule might need to be discussed with Washington, noting that the U.S. side had its own situation to consider. “There are circumstances on their side, so I think we need to hear what they have to say,” Kang told reporters when asked whether the meeting could be pushed beyond December. Asked whether he would personally raise the SCM schedule with Hegseth, Kang said, “I think we need to discuss it if necessary. I believe it is an important issue.” The SCM is traditionally held in the fall. However, the U.S. Department of Defense said Tuesday that the meeting was expected to be held in early 2027, citing scheduling conflicts among senior officials. The agreement reached on Wednesday confirmed the postponement, ending uncertainty over whether the annual meeting would take place this year. Kang and Hegseth also agreed that holding a successful 58th SCM would be important for the alliance. Before the agreement, a U.S. defense official had described the decision to postpone the meeting as having been mutually agreed upon, but Seoul maintained that no schedule had been finalized. Earlier Wednesday, Korea’s defense ministry had said, “We are consulting with the U.S. Department of Defense, taking into account mutually available dates, and no specific details have been finalized.” Despite the differing public statements, scheduling difficulties on the U.S. side are believed to be a major factor behind the delay. Washington faces competing priorities, including ongoing military operations and political developments at home, which could complicate efforts to arrange the annual meeting before the end of the year. “As the minister has repeatedly said, there are no major differences between Korea and the U.S.,” a military official noted. “Any differences at the military level can be resolved through close consultations.” Hegseth expressed hope that the two countries would strengthen defense cooperation while maintaining a robust combined defense posture. While the allies have faced questions over the pace of OPCON transfer, the latest talks indicated that both sides remain committed to moving the process forward through close consultations. The postponement comes as Seoul seeks to complete the full operational capability (FOC) verification of the future Combined Forces Command and agree with Washington on a target year for OPCON transfer. Kang told lawmakers Monday that the government was working with the United States to complete the verification process and determine a target year by the end of 2026. FOC verification is the second stage of a three-stage, conditions-based process to assess the readiness of a future combined command led by a Korean four-star general. The allies have also faced questions over whether the standards used to assess the conditions for OPCON transfer should change to reflect evolving security threats. The FOC verification is also understood to assess specific capabilities required for the future combined command to carry out its missions, rather than the overall military capabilities of the alliance, which continue to evolve in response to changing security threats

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 国防部长姜信哲与美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞思周三在菲律宾宿务举行的一场地区防务会议期间首次面对面会晤时，确认了会议延期。两人还同意于12月在华盛顿举行双边防务会议，时间早于重新安排的SCM，并重申加强防务合作、维持强大联合防务态势的承诺。这次会议原定持续15分钟，最终约谈了40分钟。会谈采用同声传译进行，双方得以深入讨论联盟问题。启程前往菲律宾前，姜信哲表示，可能需要与华盛顿讨论SCM的日程安排，并指出美方也有自身情况需要考虑。当记者问及会议是否会推迟至12月之后时，姜信哲对记者说：“他们那边存在一些情况，因此我认为我们需要听听他们的意见。”当被问及是否会亲自与赫格塞思讨论SCM日程时，姜信哲说：“我认为如有必要，我们需要就此进行讨论。我相信这是一个重要问题。”SCM传统上于秋季举行。然而，美国国防部周二表示，预计会议将于2027年初举行，理由是高级官员的日程安排存在冲突。周三达成的协议确认了延期，结束了今年是否举行年度会议的不确定性。姜信哲和赫格塞思还认为，成功举行第58届SCM对联盟至关重要。在达成协议前，一名美国国防官员曾将推迟会议的决定描述为双方共同商定的结果，但首尔方面坚持称尚未敲定日程。周三早些时候，韩国国防部表示：“我们正与美国国防部进行磋商，考虑双方可行的日期，具体安排尚未敲定。”尽管双方公开表态不一，但据认为，美方日程安排困难是此次推迟的主要原因。华盛顿面临多项优先事项，包括仍在进行的军事行动和国内政治局势，这可能使在年底前安排年度会议变得复杂。一名军方官员指出：“正如部长多次所说，韩国与美国之间没有重大分歧。”“军方的任何分歧都可以通过密切磋商解决。”赫格塞思表示，希望两国在维持强大联合防务态势的同时加强防务合作。尽管盟国在战时作战指挥权移交的进度问题上受到质疑，但最新会谈显示，双方仍致力于通过密切磋商推动该进程。正值首尔寻求完成未来联合司令部全面作战能力验证，并与华盛顿就战时作战指挥权移交的目标年份达成一致之际，会议宣布延期。姜信哲周一对议员表示，政府正与美国合作完成验证流程，并在2026年底前确定目标年份。全面作战能力验证是基于条件、分三个阶段进行的进程中的第二阶段，用于评估由一名韩国四星上将指挥的未来联合司令部的战备状态。盟国还面临一些问题，即用于评估战时作战指挥权移交条件的标准是否应作出改变，以反映不断演变的安全威胁。全面作战能力验证据理解还将评估未来联合司令部履行任务所需的具体能力，而非联盟整体军事能力；后者仍在随着安全威胁的变化而不断演进

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国大型烘焙企业Sangmidang Holdings副董事长Hur Jin-soo本周早些时候在巴黎会见了Gellert Global Group（GGG）董事长George Gellert以及美国驻法国大使Charles Kushner，以探讨在海外市场建立更广泛合作伙伴关系。访问巴黎期间，Hur还会见了欧洲食品配料供应商和烘焙制造商，探讨能够支持Samlip和Paris Baguette拓展欧洲市场的合作方案。Paris Baguette是Sangmidang旗下全球化烘焙咖啡馆连锁品牌。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hur Jin-soo, vice chairman of Korean bakery giant Sangmidang Holdings, met Gellert Global Group (GGG) Chairman George Gellert and U.S. Ambassador to France Charles Kushner in Paris earlier this week to explore broader partnerships in overseas markets. Sangmidang said Wednesday that Hur discussed business developments and potential cooperation with Gellert and other GGG executives. Samlip, Sangmidang’s mass-market bakery subsidiary, could work with GGG to expand through U.S. supermarket and food service distribution networks and potentially enter Canada and Mexico, the Korean company said. U.S.-based GGG imports and distributes food products to retailers, food service distributors, restaurants, hotels, cruise operators and food manufacturers across North America. It sources more than 4,000 products from 60 countries and generates more than $1.7 billion in sales per year. The discussion first took place on Oct. 18 when Hur attended a reception for GGG’s partner firms at the U.S. ambassador’s residence in Paris. Hosted by Kushner, the event brought together about 130 representatives from 80 companies. Sangmidang said it was the only Korean company invited. The following day, Gellert and Kushner visited Samlip’s booth at SIAL Paris 2026, a major international food products exhibition across Europe. During his visit to Paris, Hur also met with European food ingredient suppliers and bakery manufacturers to explore partnerships that could support the European expansion of Samlip and Paris Baguette, Sangmidang’s global bakery café franchise. The company described the meetings as groundwork for broader cooperation. “The invitation to the U.S. ambassador’s residence in France was a meaningful occasion to further strengthen trust with global partners and build networks for expansion in North America and Europe,” a Sangmidang Holdings official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Sangmidang通过全球合作伙伴关系寻求拓展北美和欧洲市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国烘焙业巨头Sangmidang Holdings副董事长Hur Jin-soo本周早些时候在巴黎会见了Gellert Global Group（GGG）董事长George Gellert和美国驻法国大使Charles Kushner，以探讨在海外市场建立更广泛合作伙伴关系。Sangmidang周三表示，Hur与Gellert及GGG其他高管讨论了业务发展和潜在合作事宜。Sangmidang旗下面向大众市场的烘焙子公司Samlip可与GGG合作，通过美国超市和餐饮服务分销网络扩大业务，并有望进入加拿大和墨西哥市场。韩国公司表示，总部位于美国的GGG向北美各地的零售商、餐饮服务分销商、餐厅、酒店、邮轮运营商和食品制造商进口并分销食品产品。公司从60个国家采购4,000多种产品，每年销售额超过$1.7 billion。双方于10月18日首次举行讨论，当时Hur出席了在巴黎美国大使官邸为GGG合作伙伴举行的招待会。招待会由Kushner主持，约有来自80家公司的130名代表参加。Sangmidang表示，它是唯一获邀出席的韩国公司。次日，Gellert和Kushner参观了Samlip在欧洲举办的大型国际食品产品展览会SIAL Paris 2026上的展位。Hur赴巴黎期间还会见了欧洲食品配料供应商和烘焙制造商，以探讨能够支持Samlip及Sangmidang旗下全球烘焙咖啡连锁品牌Paris Baguette拓展欧洲业务的合作项目。该公司称，这些会面为更广泛的合作奠定了基础。Sangmidang Holdings一名官员表示：“受邀前往法国美国大使官邸是一个加深与全球合作伙伴信任，并为拓展北美和欧洲业务建立合作网络的重要机会。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The House of Representatives Committee on Federal Polytechnics and Higher Technical Education has given the management of Kaduna Polytechnic 72 hours to submit records of its internally generated revenue (IGR), pension deductions, National Housing Fund (NHF) contributions and other financial transactions. The directive followed concerns raised by the committee over the institution’s declining revenue despite an increase in its student population, as well as the need to verify the remittance of statutory deductions and payment of benefits to families of deceased staff. The committee’s Chairman, Fuad Laguda (APC, Lagos), issued the directive on Tuesday during an oversight visit to the institution, asking the management to submit the outstanding documents to the National Assembly within three working days. The requested documents include the institution’s staff nominal roll, full-time and part-time student population, evidence of remittances for pension deductions, records of NHF contributions, and details of death benefits paid to the families of deceased employees between 2023 and 2025. The lawmakers also demanded information on the institution’s investments, corporations, procurement and maintenance activities, renovation works in the security division and the School of Health Technology, as well as a list of its external solicitors. Figures presented by the institution showed that its IGR fell from N1.478 billion in 2023 to N1.398 billion in 2024 and N1.332 billion in 2025. The figures prompted the committee to question the accuracy of the revenue records, particularly given the reported growth in student enrolment. Mr Laguda said the figures appeared lower than expected and asked the management to provide a comprehensive account of the institution’s revenue and expenditure. “Taking a rough calculation of what we are doing here, it looks as if what you have given us is under-declared. The figure is too low. In other words, it seems what you are giving us here is not accurate,” he said. The committee also sought clarification on approximately N1.3 billion in pension deductions, demanding documentary evidence that the money had been remitted to the appropriate authorities. Mr Laguda said the committee needed the records to establish whether the institution had met its statutory obligations. The lawmakers also questioned the handling of death benefits for former employees, noting that more than 30 staff members reportedly died between 2023 and 2025. Mr Laguda said the committee had not received evidence showing that the benefits had reached the deceased employees’ next of kin. “In terms of death benefits, over 30 staff died during these years (2023-2025), yet there is no evidence of the payments of the benefits to their next of kin. We would like to have a comprehensive breakdown of this,” he said. The committee then requested a detailed account of the benefits and how they were paid. During the inspection, the lawmakers also examined the institution’s facilities, including an upgraded studio for its Departments of Media and Mass Communication. Mr Laguda said the committee was not fully satisfied with the condition of some facilities, adding that it needed more documentation before it could reach a conclusion on the issues raised. He said the institution needed to improve the condition of its buildings and ensure that its available resources were properly utilised. “We’ve asked them to make further submissions to us at the National Assembly within 72 hours. That is three working days,” he said. Responding to the lawmakers’ concerns, the Rector of Kaduna Polytechnic, Suleiman Umar, said the institution had remitted all pension deductions and was up to date with its obligations. Mr Umar, who was represented by the Deputy Rector (Academic), Aliyu Usman, said the institution had no outstanding issues regarding pension remittances. “As for pension, we do not have any issues at all. All our pension deductions are promptly remitted. In fact, even though the October salary has not been paid, the pension has been raised,” he said. He also explained that the institution did not directly pay death benefits to the families of deceased employees, saying the payments were handled by the relevant insurance companies. On security expenditure, he said the institution outsourced its security services to private security organisations. Mr Umar further maintained that the institution had no outstanding issues concerning NHF deductions and that the relevant records were available for submission to the committee. He assured the lawmakers that the management would provide all requested documents within the stipulated 72-hour deadline. The committee is expected to review the submissions before determining whether the institution complied with its financial and statutory obligations
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 众议员要求卡杜纳理工学院在72小时内解释收入下降及养老金扣款问题
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 众议院联邦理工学院与高等技术教育委员会已要求Kaduna Polytechnic管理层在72小时内提交其内部创收（IGR）、养老金扣款、国家住房基金（NHF）缴款及其他财务交易的记录。该指令源于委员会提出的担忧，尽管学生人数有所增加，该校收入却持续下降，同时还需核实法定扣款项是否上缴，以及是否向已故员工的家属支付福利。委员会主席Fuad Laguda（APC，拉各斯）周二在对该校进行监督访问时发出指令，要求管理层在3个工作日内将尚未提交的文件交给国民议会。要求提交的文件包括该校员工名册、全日制和非全日制学生人数、养老金扣款上缴凭证、NHF缴款记录，以及2023年至2025年向已故员工家属支付死亡福利的明细。议员还要求提供该校投资、企业、采购和维护活动、安保部门及Health Technology学院装修工程，以及外部律师事务所名单的相关信息。该校提交的数据显示，其IGR从2023年的N1.478 billion降至2024年的N1.398 billion，并在2025年进一步降至N1.332 billion。鉴于据报学生注册人数有所增长，这些数字促使委员会质疑收入记录的准确性。Laguda先生表示，相关数字低于预期，并要求管理层对该校收入和支出作出全面说明。他说：“根据我们目前工作的大致估算，你们交给我们的数据似乎存在少报。数字太低了。换句话说，你们在这里提交给我们的资料似乎并不准确。”委员会还要求澄清约N1.3 billion的养老金扣款，并要求提供文件证据，证明相关款项已上缴至主管机关。Laguda先生表示，委员会需要这些记录，以确定该校是否履行了法定义务。议员还质疑前员工死亡福利的处理情况，并指出据报2023年至2025年间有30多名员工去世。Laguda先生说，委员会尚未收到任何证据，显示相关福利已支付给已故员工的近亲属。他说：“在死亡福利方面，这些年间（2023-2025年）有30多名员工去世，但没有证据表明相关福利已支付给他们的近亲属。我们希望获得一份全面、详细的明细。”随后，委员会要求就相关福利及其支付方式作出详细说明。在检查过程中，议员还查看了该校的设施，包括为Media and Mass Communication系升级的演播室。Laguda先生说，委员会对部分设施的状况并不完全满意，并表示在就所提出的问题作出结论之前，需要获得更多文件。他说，该校需要改善建筑物状况，并确保现有资源得到妥善利用。他说：“我们已要求他们在72小时内，也就是3个工作日内，向我们在国民议会的团队作进一步提交。”针对议员的关切，Kaduna Polytechnic校长Suleiman Umar表示，该校已上缴全部养老金扣款，并已履行所有义务。由副校长（学术事务）Aliyu Usman代表出席的Umar先生说，该校养老金上缴不存在任何未完成的问题。他说：“养老金方面，我们完全没有问题。所有养老金扣款都已及时上缴。事实上，尽管10月份的工资尚未支付，但养老金已经发放。”他还解释说，该校并不直接向已故员工家属支付死亡福利，相关款项由有关保险公司处理。在安保支出方面，他说，该校已将安保服务外包给私营安保机构。Umar先生进一步强调，该校NHF扣款不存在任何未完成的问题，相关记录也可提交给委员会。他向议员保证，管理层将在规定的72小时期限内提交所有要求的文件。预计委员会将审核相关提交材料，再确定该校是否遵守了财务和法定义务

https://www.thehindu.com/business/econom.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription India and Mexico on Wednesday signed the Terms of Reference (ToR) to start negotiations on a trade deal between the two countries, the government announced following the signing in Mexico. The signing of the ToR follows an understanding reached between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum during their meeting on the sidelines of the G7 Summit in Canada in June 2025. During the signing, the Indian side was represented by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal, who held discussions with Mexico’s Undersecretary of Foreign Trade Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez Romano, who participated on behalf of Secretary of Economy Marcelo Ebrard Casaubon. “The Terms of Reference cover key negotiating areas, including market access for goods, rules of origin, customs procedures and trade facilitation, dispute settlement, sanitary and phytosanitary measures, technical barriers to trade and trade remedies,” the release said. “With its strong linkages to global value chains, Mexico is an important market for Indian exporters and investors,” it added. “Sectors with significant potential for cooperation include automotive, chemicals, electronics, pharmaceuticals, agri-food, energy, critical minerals, medical devices and advanced manufacturing, among others.” Mr. Agrawal and Mr. Romano also discussed the possibility of organising a Mexican business mission to India during the first quarter of 2027. “The proposed mission would facilitate business-to-business meetings, help identify commercial opportunities and strengthen commercial ties between the productive sectors of the two countries,” the government said. https://www.thehindu.com/business/econom.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受独家报道、社论、观点等更多内容。印度和墨西哥于周三签署了启动两国贸易协定谈判的职权范围（ToR），这是继在墨西哥举行签署仪式后政府公布的。此次签署ToR，延续了印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪与墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆在2025年6月加拿大举行的G7峰会期间会晤时达成的共识。签署仪式上，印度commerce部秘书拉杰什·阿格拉瓦尔代表印方出席，并与代表经济部长马塞洛·埃布拉德·卡萨 ubon出席的墨西哥外交贸易副部长路易斯·罗森多·古铁雷斯·罗马诺进行了讨论。声明称：“职权范围涵盖关键谈判领域，包括货物市场准入、原产地规则、海关程序和贸易便利化、争端解决、卫生与植物卫生措施、技术性贸易壁垒以及贸易救济。”声明补充道：“墨西哥与全球价值链联系紧密，是印度出口商和投资者的重要市场。”合作潜力显著的领域包括汽车、化工、电子产品、制药、农产品食品、能源、关键矿产、医疗器械和先进制造业等。阿格拉瓦尔先生和罗马诺先生还讨论了于2027年第一季度组织墨西哥商务代表团赴印度的可能性。印度政府表示：“拟议中的代表团将促进企业对接，帮助发掘商业机会，并加强两国生产部门之间的商业联系。”评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论指南。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与文章互动。如果没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录账户后可在Vuukle上查看以前的评论。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nnpc.body: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) has pledged to resume oil exploration activities in Borno State, while assuring the state government of steps to address delays in upgrading the Maiduguri Emergency Power Plant. The commitments were made on Wednesday when Borno State Governor, Professor Babagana Umara Zulum, received the NNPCL management team, led by the board chairman, Engr. Ahmadu Musa Kida, in Maiduguri. The meeting focused on energy development, the resumption of oil exploration in the state and the delayed completion of the emergency power plant upgrade. Zulum stressed the strategic importance of resuming exploration in the Borno Basin, noting that the state had considerable commercial potential and shared borders with three countries. He expressed optimism that renewed exploration efforts by the national oil company would help unlock the state’s hydrocarbon resources and stimulate economic development. The governor, however, expressed concern over the slow pace of work on the Maiduguri Emergency Power Plant, describing the facility as critical to improving electricity supply in the state. He said the materials required for the plant’s upgrade had been on site for about two years, yet the project remained incomplete. Zulum urged the NNPCL management to intervene and remove the bottlenecks delaying the project, stressing that its completion was important to the socio-economic well-being of residents of Maiduguri and neighbouring communities. Responding, Kida assured the governor of the company’s readiness to fast-track the resumption of exploration activities in the Borno Basin and address the challenges delaying the power plant upgrade. He also commended Zulum for his continued support and efforts to create a conducive environment for investment in the state. The meeting was attended by the Deputy Governor, Umar Usman Kadafur; Secretary to the State Government, Bukar Tijani; Acting Chief of Staff, Dr. Babagana Mallumbe; and other senior government officials. Members of the NNPCL delegation included the Executive Vice President, Upstream, Mr. Udy Ntia, and the Executive Vice President, Gas, Power and New Energy, Mr. Olalekon Ogunleye. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nnpc.title_zh: NNPCL将在博尔诺州恢复石油勘探
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nnpc.body_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPCL）承诺恢复在博尔诺州开展石油勘探活动，同时向州政府保证将采取措施，解决迈杜古里应急发电厂升级工程延期的问题。Wednesday，博尔诺州州长巴巴加纳·乌马拉·祖卢姆教授在迈杜古里接见了由董事会主席艾哈迈杜·穆萨·基达工程师率领的NNPCL管理团队，双方作出了上述承诺。此次会晤重点讨论了能源开发、恢复在该州开展石油勘探以及应急发电厂升级工程延期完工等问题。祖卢姆强调恢复博尔诺盆地勘探工作的战略意义，指出该州具有可观的商业潜力，并与三个国家接壤。他乐观地表示，这家国家石油公司重启勘探工作，将有助于开发该州的碳氢化合物资源并促进经济发展。不过，州长对迈杜古里应急发电厂工程进展缓慢表示担忧，称该设施对改善全州供电至关重要。他说，升级该电厂所需的材料约两年前就已运抵现场，但项目仍未完工。祖卢姆敦促NNPCL管理层介入，消除阻碍项目进度的瓶颈，并强调项目完工对迈杜古里及周边社区居民的社会福祉和经济发展至关重要。基达回应称，公司已准备加快恢复博尔诺盆地勘探活动，并解决延误发电厂升级工程的各项挑战。他还赞扬祖卢姆 continued 支持，以及为营造有利于该州投资环境所作出的努力。出席会晤的还有副州长乌马尔·乌斯曼·卡达富尔、州政府秘书布卡尔·蒂亚尼、代理幕僚长巴巴加纳·马伦贝博士及其他政府高级官员。NNPCL代表团成员包括上游业务执行副总裁乌迪·恩提亚先生，以及天然气、电力与新能源执行副总裁奥拉莱孔·奥贡莱耶先生。本文所述观点不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的意见

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: “There is no way to prevent Hanwha from buying shares, but given that it is a defense company, I believe government approval or oversight will come into play once its stake reaches a certain level,” Kim said during a National Assembly audit. However, other government authorities have struck a different tone, raising questions about whether the government has a unified stance on Hanwha’s efforts to expand its stake in KAI.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: “没有办法阻止韩华购买股份，但鉴于韩华是一家国防公司，我相信，一旦其持股达到一定水平，政府审批或监督就会介入。”金某在韩国国会审计过程中表示。然而，其他政府主管部门采取了不同口径，引发了外界对政府是否在韩华扩大所持KAI股份一事上立场一致的质疑。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Although Eximbank and KAI have expressed reservations about a change in ownership, KAI’s slower growth compared to its defense industry peers, despite a boom in arms exports, is fueling calls for privatization. Eximbank is KAI’s largest shareholder, with a 26.41 percent stake. According to Rep. Ahn Sang-hoon of the main opposition People Power Party and other sources, Eximbank recently selected AT Kearney as the preferred bidder for the consulting project and is proceeding with the subsequent steps. The project will examine ways to strengthen Korea’s aerospace industry and foster global anchor companies. Reports that the project was initiated at the government’s request have also sparked controversy. On Oct. 20, KAI CEO Kim Jong-chool said the company’s ownership structure would not change without employees’ consent. “There is no way to prevent Hanwha from buying shares, but given that it is a defense company, I believe government approval or oversight will come into play once its stake reaches a certain level,” Kim said during a National Assembly audit. “Hanwha’s involvement in management would be difficult in practical terms.” Kim’s remarks came as KAI union members stepped up their opposition to a potential ownership change, staging repeated protests in front of Cheong Wa Dae in Seoul that day. During the same parliamentary audit, Eximbank Chairman Hwang Ki-yeon said the state-run lender had “no plans” to sell its KAI shares at present. However, he left open the possibility of future changes, saying it was difficult to make definitive statements about the future. However, other government authorities have struck a different tone, raising questions about whether the government has a unified stance on Hanwha’s efforts to expand its stake in KAI. In August, Hanwha increased its stake in KAI to 15.89 percent, after the FTC approved the acquisition. Under Korea’s Fair Trade Act, companies must file a business combination report when acquiring 15 percent or more of the shares issued by a listed company. Asked about the approval of Hanwha’s additional share acquisition, FTC Chairman Ju Biung-ghi offered a favorable assessment of the move. “It is beneficial to the national economy for multiple major defense companies to build global competitiveness and compete on an equal footing with foreign companies,” Ju told reporters during a press conference last month. While Ju did not explicitly endorse a takeover, his remarks suggested a more favorable view of Hanwha’s expanding presence in KAI than those expressed by the heads of Eximbank and the aerospace company. Hanwha’s potential acquisition of KAI has drawn opposition from stakeholders concerned that combining the two companies could create an unprecedented defense industry giant in Korea. However, the prospect of building a larger defense contractor capable of competing with global industry leaders is also seen as a major potential benefit of the deal. Moon Keun-sik, a professor at Hanyang University’s Graduate School of Public Policy and a former submarine captain, said market forces should ultimately determine Hanwha’s potential acquisition of KAI. He argued that Korea needs to foster globally competitive defense companies capable of standing alongside major international players such as Lockheed Martin. “Hanwha’s purchase of KAI shares is simply a matter of market logic,” Moon said. “Ultimately, I believe the government may also support Hanwha’s acquisition of a larger stake in KAI for the long-term growth of Korea’s defense industry in global markets.” Moon said the absence of an explicit government endorsement should not necessarily be interpreted as opposition to the deal. Labor-related concerns, including resistance from KAI’s union, could make it difficult for company management or relevant authorities to publicly signal support for a change in ownership, he added. The debate centers on whether consolidating Korea’s defense and aerospace capabilities under a larger corporate group would strengthen the country’s global competitiveness or undermine competition by concentrating too much market power in a single player. “It is time for Korea to build a major defense company capable of competing globally. Blocking share acquisitions and other market-driven transactions runs counter to the direction of the times,” Moon said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 随着韩华寻求扩大持股，KAI私有化之争升温
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 尽管出口信贷银行和KAI对所有权变更表示保留意见，但在武器出口繁荣的背景下，KAI的增长速度仍慢于其国防工业同行，这促使 privat化呼声日益高涨。出口信贷银行是KAI的最大股东，持股比例为26.41%。据主要反对党国民力量党议员安相勋及其他消息人士称，出口信贷银行近日选定AT Kearney为该咨询项目的优选投标人，并正推进后续步骤。该项目将研究加强韩国航空航天工业、培育全球锚定企业的方法。有关该项目应政府要求启动的报道也引发了争议。10月20日，KAI首席执行官金钟哲表示，未经员工同意，公司所有权结构不会发生改变。金在国会审计期间说：“我们无法阻止韩华购买股份，但考虑到韩华是一家国防企业，我相信一旦其持股比例达到一定水平，政府审批或监督就会介入。”他说：“就实际情况而言，让韩华参与公司管理将很困难。”金发表上述言论之际，KAI工会成员加大了对潜在所有权变更的反对力度，当天在首尔青瓦台前多次举行抗议活动。在同一次国会审计中，出口信贷银行行长黄基妍表示，这家国有贷款机构目前“没有出售所持KAI股份的计划”。不过，她也为未来发生变化保留了可能性，称很难对未来作出明确表态。然而，其他政府机构采取了不同口径，引发了外界对政府是否在韩华扩大所持KAI股份问题上持统一立场的疑问。8月，在公平交易委员会批准收购后，韩华将其所持KAI股份比例提高至15.89%。根据韩国《公平交易法》，企业收购上市公司已发行股份达到15%或以上时，必须提交企业结合报告。在被问及批准韩华增持一事时，公平交易委员会主席周炳基对这一举措作出了积极评价。周在上月举行的新闻发布会上对记者说：“多家主要国防企业打造全球竞争力，并与外国企业站在同一竞争起点上，这对国民经济有益。”尽管周没有明确支持收购，但他的表态显示，相较于出口信贷银行和这家航空航天公司负责人，韩华扩大在KAI持股的影响显然得到了更为积极看待。韩华可能收购KAI的做法遭到部分利益相关方反对，他们担心两家公司合并后可能在韩国催生一家前所未有的国防工业巨头。然而，打造一家能够与全球行业 leaders 竞争的更大规模国防承包商，也被视为这项交易的一项主要潜在收益。韩国汉阳大学公共政策研究生院教授、前潜艇艇长文根锡表示，最终应由市场力量决定韩华是否收购KAI。他认为，韩国需要培育具有全球竞争力的国防企业，使其能够与洛克希德·马丁等主要国际企业并肩发展。文说：“韩华购买KAI股份只是市场逻辑的问题。”他说：“最终，我相信从韩国国防工业在全球市场实现长期增长的角度出发，政府也可能支持韩华收购KAI更大比例的股份。”文表示，政府没有明确表态支持，并不一定应被解读为反对这笔交易。他补充说，劳工方面的顾虑，包括KAI工会的抵制，可能使公司管理层或相关当局难以公开表示支持所有权变更。争论的焦点在于，将韩国的国防和航空航天能力整合到一个更大的企业集团，究竟会增强该国的全球竞争力，还是会因为过度集中市场力量于单一参与者而削弱竞争。文说：“现在是韩国打造一家具备全球竞争能力的 major 国防企业的时候了。阻止股份收购和其他由市场驱动的交易，违背了时代潮流。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: EMAT seeks to reduce reliance on Chinese rare earth magnets with Pohang facility
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Evolution Metals & Technologies (EMAT), a Nasdaq-listed rare earth magnet producer, is making a big bet on Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province, by building a facility capable of producing 10,000 tons of sintered rare earth magnets annually for export to the U.S. and to other global customers seeking to reduce their reliance on China's dominant rare earth supply chain.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Evolution Metals & Technologies（EMAT）是一家在纳斯达克上市的稀土磁体生产商，正大力押注韩国庆尚北道浦项市，计划建设一座每年可生产1万吨烧结稀土磁体、用于出口至美国及其他全球客户的设施，以满足这些客户减少对中国主导的稀土供应链依赖的需求。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Evolution Metals & Technologies (EMAT), a Nasdaq-listed rare earth magnet producer, is making a big bet on Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province, by building a facility capable of producing 10,000 tons of sintered rare earth magnets annually for export to the U.S. and to other global customers seeking to reduce their reliance on China's dominant rare earth supply chain. The company plans to invest approximately 300 billion won ($224 million) in Pohang, including 223.8 billion won earmarked for building initial production capacity on a 118,000-square-meter site at the Blue Valley Industrial Complex in the city by 2027. EMAT and the Pohang city government signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on the investment project on Tuesday, with the city pledging administrative support for EMAT's plans. During an interview with The Korea Times, EMAT CEO Frank Moon stressed the need to distinguish between upstream and downstream operations. Citing China's dominance in the supply chain, he said geopolitical issues weigh heavily on the industry, and customers’ growing demand for alternatives to China is positioning Korea as a key global hub for supplies. “China produces more than 90 percent of the world's rare earth magnets, while most of the remaining output comes from Japan and is consumed domestically,” Moon said during the interview a day before the MOU signing ceremony. “Yet even China is assumed to rely on imports for about 60 percent of its raw materials. … The rare earth magnet industry should not be about a single company doing everything from mining to magnet production. Just as POSCO sources iron ore from mining companies such as Rio Tinto to produce steel, upstream and downstream operations should be treated as separate businesses.” EMAT comprises four midsize rare earth companies in Korea — KCM Industry, which specializes in metals for magnet production; KMMI, which produces sintered magnets; NS World, which manufactures bonded magnets; and Handa Lab, which specializes in automation and artificial intelligence technologies. Evolution Metals acquired the four companies and subsequently merged with a U.S. special purpose acquisition company to make its Nasdaq debut on Jan. 6. Although each of the four companies has been in business for more than a decade, Moon considers Jan. 6 the founding date of EMAT as an integrated company. Rare earth magnets are essential components in motors and other equipment for electric vehicles (EVs), drones and actuators for humanoid robots. Rare earth magnets can be broadly divided into two types. Sintered magnets offer stronger magnetic performance and are used in applications requiring high power, while bonded magnets have relatively weaker magnetic properties but offer greater flexibility in shape and design. Moon said global annual production of sintered rare earth magnets stands at nearly 360,000 tons, with only about 14,000 tons produced outside China, mostly by Japanese companies. China's dominance is largely attributable to its ability to supply magnets at low prices, prompting manufacturers elsewhere to shift toward higher-value components, but Moon said this does not necessarily mean that magnet producers in other countries cannot be competitive. “Even if the price of magnets used in a car triples, the impact on the vehicle's total production cost would be less than 1 percent,” Moon said. “Keeping costs low is important, but when it comes to strategically critical materials, having alternative sources of supply is essential to reducing geopolitical risks.” Starting Jan. 1, the U.S. Department of Defense will expand procurement restrictions on certain magnets and strategic metals sourced from China, Russia, Iran and North Korea. Until the end of this year, the restrictions cover materials melted or produced in those countries. From 2027, however, they will extend to materials mined, refined or separated there, effectively covering the entire supply chain for certain rare earth magnets. China is also tightening its grip on the rare earth supply chain by imposing export controls on technologies and equipment used to produce rare earth magnets, making it increasingly difficult for manufacturers outside China to expand their production capacity. A one-year suspension of some of Beijing’s export controls on rare earths and related manufacturing equipment and technologies is set to expire in November, meaning it will become much harder for manufacturers outside China to import Chinese-made equipment. The situation has created both opportunities and challenges for Moon. He described the process of securing machinery for EMAT's Pohang plant from China as a “nerve-wracking experience,” as any delays could have pushed back the entire project and cost the company an opportunity to capitalize on growing demand for non-Chinese magnets. Fortunately, EMAT secured the necessary export licenses for its main production equipment, which is scheduled to arrive at its Pohang facility by Thursday. “Currently, about 30 percent of the raw materials we need are sourced from outside China, mostly from Australia,” Moon said. “We cannot completely eliminate our dependence on China overnight. But I believe Chinese and non-Chinese supply chains will increasingly diverge because China is expected to struggle to meet its own domestic demand amid the growth of the EV market. We expect to increase the share of non-Chinese raw materials to 60 percent of our total input by the second half of next year.” With plans to use materials that meet U.S. defense procurement requirements, EMAT is targeting the American defense industry as a key market for its magnets. Moon said the company's board members have close ties to the U.S. defense sector, which could help EMAT establish relationships with potential customers. While Moon serves as CEO, EMAT's board is chaired by David Wilcox, a former Deutsche Bank executive. Other board members include Christopher Miller, who served as acting U.S. defense secretary during U.S. President Donald Trump's first term; Robin Bernstein, a former U.S. ambassador to the Dominican Republic; and retired Gen. Tom Bussiere, former commander of the U.S. Air Force Global Strike Command. EMAT is targeting $400 million in annual revenue from its Pohang facility. Moon said the company is receiving inquiries from potential customers, particularly in the EV, drone and unmanned aerial vehicle industries. Once the facility is completed and reaches its planned capacity, Pohang is expected to account for about 90 percent of EMAT's total revenue. The company also plans to invest 127 billion won in Sejong to establish research facilities and production operations for bonded magnets. In the U.S., EMAT is also planning to build facilities for electronic scrap processing, battery recycling and hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical refining
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 欧洲磁性材料协会寻求通过在浦项建设生产基地，减少对中国稀土磁体的依赖
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Evolution Metals & Technologies（EMAT）是一家在纳斯达克上市的稀土磁体生产商，目前正豪赌韩国庆尚北道浦项，通过建设一座每年可生产10,000吨烧结稀土磁体、用于出口至美国及其他全球客户的工厂，押注市场对减少对中国主导的稀土供应链依赖的需求增长。公司计划在浦项投资约3,000亿韩元（2.24亿美元），其中2,238亿韩元用于到2027年在浦项市蓝谷工业园区一块118,000平方米的土地上建设首批产能。EMAT与浦项市政府周二就投资项目签署谅解备忘录（MOU），浦项市承诺为EMAT的计划提供行政支持。EMAT首席执行官Frank Moon在接受《韩国时报》采访时强调，有必要区分上游和下游业务。他以中国在供应链中的主导地位为例称，地缘政治问题对该行业影响重大，而客户对中国替代品日益增长的需求，正使韩国成为全球供应枢纽。Moon在MOU签署仪式前一天接受采访时表示：“中国生产全球90%以上的稀土磁体，其余产量大部分来自日本，并在国内消化。”“然而，据认为，即使中国也有约60%的原材料依赖进口……稀土磁体行业不应由一家企业包办从采矿到磁体生产的全部环节。正如POSCO从力拓等矿业公司采购铁矿石来炼钢一样，上游和下游业务应被视为独立企业。”EMAT由韩国四家中型稀土企业组成——专注于磁体生产金属材料的KCM Industry、生产烧结磁体的KMMI、制造粘结磁体的NS World，以及专注自动化和人工智能技术的Handa Lab。Evolution Metals收购了这四家公司，随后与美国一家特殊目的收购公司合并，于1月6日首次在纳斯达克上市。尽管这四家公司各自经营已超过十年，Moon仍认为1月6日是EMAT作为一家综合公司的创立日期。稀土磁体是电动汽车（EV）、无人机以及人形机器人执行器等电机和其他设备的关键部件。稀土磁体大致可分为两类。烧结磁体的磁性能更强，用于需要高功率的应用；粘结磁体的磁性相对较弱，但在形状和设计上具有更大的灵活性。Moon表示，全球烧结稀土磁体的年产量接近360,000吨，其中仅约14,000吨在中国以外生产，而且主要由日本企业完成。中国的主导地位很大程度上得益于其能够低价供应磁体，促使其他地方的制造商转向附加值更高的零部件，但Moon表示，这并不一定意味着其他国家的磁体生产商无法具备竞争力。Moon说：“即使汽车所用磁体的价格翻三倍，对整车生产成本的影响也不到1%。”“保持低成本很重要，但在涉及战略关键材料时，拥有替代供应来源对于降低地缘政治风险至关重要。”从1月1日起，美国国防部将扩大对某些从中国、俄罗斯、伊朗和朝鲜采购的磁体及战略金属的采购限制。今年年底前，限制范围涵盖在这些国家熔炼或生产的材料。然而从2027年起，限制将延伸至在这些国家开采、精炼或分离的材料，实际上将覆盖某些稀土磁体的整条供应链。中国也在通过限制出口生产稀土磁体所需的技术和设备来进一步掌控稀土供应链，使中国以外的制造商越来越难以扩大产能。北京针对稀土及相关制造设备和技术实施的部分出口管制暂停期将在11月到期，这意味着中国以外的制造商进口中国制造设备的难度将大幅上升。这一局面为Moon带来了机遇和挑战。他形容为EMAT浦项工厂从中国获取机械设备的经历是“令人神经紧张”，因为任何延误都可能推迟整个项目，并使公司错失把握非中国磁体需求增长的机会。幸运的是，EMAT已为主要生产设备取得必要的出口许可证，设备预计于周四抵达浦项工厂。Moon表示：“目前，我们所需的原材料中约30%来自中国以外，主要是澳大利亚。”“我们无法在一夜之间彻底消除对中国的依赖。但我认为，随着EV市场增长，中国预计难以满足自身国内需求，中外供应链之间的分化将日益加剧。我们预计到明年下半年，会将非中国原材料在总投入中的占比提高至60%。”EMAT计划使用符合美国国防采购要求的材料，并瞄准美国国防工业作为其磁体的关键市场。Moon表示，公司董事会成员与美国国防部门关系密切，这可能有助于EMAT与潜在客户建立联系。Moon担任首席执行官，EMAT董事会由前德意志银行高管David Wilcox主持。其他董事会成员包括曾在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普第一任期担任美国国防部代部长的Christopher Miller、前美国驻多米尼加共和国大使Robin Bernstein，以及已退役的汤姆·布西尔将军，他曾任美国空军全球打击司令部司令。EMAT的目标是让浦项工厂实现4亿美元年收入。Moon表示，公司正收到潜在客户的咨询，尤其是来自EV、无人机和无人驾驶航空器行业的咨询。工厂建成并达到计划产能后，浦项预计将贡献EMAT约90%的总收入。公司还计划在世宗投资1,270亿韩元，建设粘结磁体的研究设施和生产基地。在美国，EMAT还计划建设电子废料处理、电池回收以及湿法冶金和火法冶金精炼设施

https://leadership.ng/cbn-says-banks-mus.title: CBN Says Banks Must Manage Risks From 3rd Party Tech Providers
https://leadership.ng/cbn-says-banks-mus.summary: According to him, while cloud computing offers scalability, efficiency, flexibility and opportunities for innovation, its growing adoption raises concerns about cybersecurity, operational resilience, data protection and dependence on third-party providers. He also identified concentration risks as an issue requiring attention in implementing the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative, alongside infrastructure readiness and effective oversight of technology providers.
https://leadership.ng/cbn-says-banks-mus.summary_zh: 据他表示，云计算虽然具有可扩展性、高效率、灵活性并带来创新机会，但其日益广泛的应用也引发了人们对网络安全、运营韧性、数据保护以及依赖第三方供应商等问题的担忧。他还指出，在实施国家主权云倡议时，除了基础设施准备度和加强对技术供应商的有效监管外，集中度风险也需要关注。
https://leadership.ng/cbn-says-banks-mus.body: The Deputy Governor, Financial System Stability, CBN, Lamido Yuguda, stated this at the CBN-National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) Executive Regulatory Dialogue on the implementation of the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative (NSCI) and data localisation. According to him, while cloud computing offers scalability, efficiency, flexibility and opportunities for innovation, its growing adoption raises concerns about cybersecurity, operational resilience, data protection and dependence on third-party providers. “Cloud computing has become an important enabler of this transformation, offering scalability, efficiency, flexibility, and opportunities for innovation. However, increased reliance on cloud and digital infrastructure also brings important considerations around cybersecurity, operational resilience, data protection, third-party dependencies, and regulatory oversight” he said. He also identified concentration risks as an issue requiring attention in implementing the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative, alongside infrastructure readiness and effective oversight of technology providers. On data localisation, he said regulated institutions were expected to ensure that critical payment transaction data was stored and managed within Nigeria in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and the January 1, 2027 implementation timeline. He cautioned, however, that keeping data within the country would not automatically guarantee security. “Localisation alone does not guarantee security,” he said, stressing the need for robust cybersecurity, business continuity, disaster recovery and risk-management arrangements. The deputy governor said the CBN would continue working with NITDA and other relevant stakeholders to align financial-sector requirements with national digital infrastructure standards. He said the initiative should strengthen Nigeria’s digital resilience and domestic technological capacity without restricting innovation or isolating the country from global technological developments. “The objective of the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative should not be to constrain innovation or isolate Nigeria from global technological developments. Rather, it should provide the security, resilience, and regulatory certainty necessary to support investment, innovation, and sustainable growth,” he said. He called for a balanced and collaborative approach that would strengthen digital sovereignty while preserving global competitiveness and supporting financial stability. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/cbn-says-banks-mus.title_zh: 尼日利亚中央银行：银行必须管理第三方技术提供商带来的风险
https://leadership.ng/cbn-says-banks-mus.body_zh: 尼日利亚中央银行金融系统稳定事务副行长拉米多·尤古达在尼日利亚中央银行与尼日利亚国家信息技术发展局举行的执行监管对话会上，就落实国家主权云倡议和数据本地化作出上述表示。对话会重点讨论了国家主权云倡议及数据本地化的实施情况。据他介绍，虽然云计算具有可扩展性、高效性、灵活性和创新机会等优势，但其日益广泛的应用也引发了对网络安全、运营韧性、数据保护以及依赖第三方服务提供商的担忧。他说：“云计算已成为推动这一转型的重要助力，能够提供可扩展性、高效性、灵活性和创新机会。然而，对云和数字基础设施的日益依赖，也带来了网络安全、运营韧性、数据保护、第三方依赖和监管监督等方面的重要考量。”他还指出，在实施国家主权云倡议时，除了基础设施准备情况和加强对技术服务提供商的监管之外，集中度风险也是需要关注的问题。在数据本地化方面，他表示，受监管机构应按照适用的监管要求以及2027年1月1日的实施时间表，确保关键支付交易数据在尼日利亚境内存储和管理。不过，他警告说，将数据保存在国内并不会自动保证安全。他说：“仅靠本地化并不能保证安全。”他强调，必须建立完善的网络安全、业务连续性、灾难恢复和风险管理机制。副行长表示，尼日利亚中央银行将继续与尼日利亚国家信息技术发展局及其他相关利益攸关方合作，使金融行业要求与国家数字基础设施标准相衔接。他说，这项倡议应在不限制创新、也不使尼日利亚与全球技术发展隔绝的情况下，增强尼日利亚的数字韧性和本土技术能力。他说：“国家主权云倡议的目标不应是限制创新或使尼日利亚与全球技术发展隔绝。相反，它应提供支持投资、创新和可持续增长所需的安全保障、韧性和监管确定性。”他呼吁采取平衡且协作的方式，在维护全球竞争力的同时增强数字主权并支持金融稳定。掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp，随时获取全天候更新 →

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/28/g.title: Give Us Our Severance Package, Protesting WRPC Support Staff Tell NNPCL
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/28/g.summary: The support staff of Warri Refining and Petrochemical Company (WRPC) have accused the Refinery Coordinator, Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited, (NNPC) Limited, Mr. Bayo Adenrele, of working against President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and trying to instigate violence against the administration.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/28/g.summary_zh: 瓦里炼油与石化公司（WRPC）的支持人员指控尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）炼油协调员巴约·阿德雷莱与总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布对着干，并企图煽动针对本届政府的暴力。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/28/g.body: The support staff of Warri Refining and Petrochemical Company (WRPC) have accused the Refinery Coordinator, Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited, (NNPC) Limited, Mr. Bayo Adenrele, of working against President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and trying to instigate violence against the administration. The aggrieved workers claimed that Adenrele has stripped off royalties from host communities of WRPC, vowing that they can no longer tolerate the rubbishing of host communities. Chairman of the support staff of WRPC, Dafe Ighomitedo, who spoke to newsmen at the entrance of WRPC Tuesday, during the continued protest of the support staff, said NNPCL had been telling the workers lies, upon lies since 2015. Ighomitedo, stated: “This is the fourth week we have been here protesting for us to get our severance package, having the old contract expired 30th September. Unfortunately, it has been lies upon lies. We have been here since 2015 and this protest has been going on since 2015, but it always ends with deceit. “The two palaces hosting this company (WRPC) went to Abuja, where they made promises to give the workers proper welfare. They laid off people and give us peanuts, we that remained, we’re still hopeful that someday, something good will happen, but no way. They told the masses that they are taking care of us, saying they are paying us N90,000 to N150,000. No pension, no medical, no transport, we don’t even have access to the plant clinic, when we are sick, it is so demeaning. We can no longer take it. We have been here since 5th October, till now they have not responded. “The Refinery Coordinator (RC) for the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL), Bayo Adenrele, feels we are nobody and we have lost confidence in him. He has no integrity when it comes to the Support Staff of WRPC. “He is working against this present government of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu. He is doing this to instigate violence against the president. We have been peaceful for so long. The community has been rubbished for too long and we can no longer take it. Bayo Adenrele has stripped the community of all royalties. This time around, it won’t be business as usual.” Ighomitedo demanded to have a meeting with the Executive Vice-President, Downstream at NNPC Limited, Dr. Mumuni Dagazau, insisting that he should come down to Warri to address the protesting workers. “We want to see the Executive Vice-President, Downstream at NNPC Limited, Dr. Mumuni Dagazau. He should come and address us, because the RC is rubbishing his office and staining the image of the Group Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL), Bashir Bayo Ojulari. RC is telling people that we are outsourced. We have our letters and document. We were employed directly. Our case is peculiar. The Acting MD right now was once a Support Staff that was later converted, but now nobody wants to convert us,” he said. One of the support staff, Akivie Kingsley, who spoke in the same vein, stated: “It has been promises and failed promises, what this people are owing us, is what I can’t even speak out. We are entitled to every welfare, but their promises have gotten to the point that we can no longer take it. “If we are going on leave, no leave allowance. We have people that are already dead; we have two corpses in the mortuary as we speak; we have marriages that are crashing because of lack of finance. Children are off school, because we cannot pay their school fees and the RC expects engineers like us, with vast experience, to keep working in this kind of environment, with N90,000 salary, it won’t work. We are done with this slave contract.” Another support staff of WRPC, who is a Lab Technician, Benjamin Iwuno, lamented that he had put in over 13yrs in WRPC, stressing that all his service years has been taken for granted, being paid peanuts and no health benefit. “How do you explain to the government that you have over 300 personnel working with you and none of them is pensionable? They can’t have access to basic healthcare. Some of my colleagues have died on duty, no compensation. “Can the N90,000 take somebody with family home? The management is telling us that we don’t mean anything to them. How is it possible that my boss will write my job as his appraisal and I get nothing in return? It is painful. I want my rightful benefit working in oil and gas company,” Iwuno said. For Harriet Charles, the story was not different, she wept while narrating her experience with the WRPC for the past 14 years. “I have been here for the past 14years, I wasn’t like this, if you get to my house now, I don’t have TV, because N90,000 cannot get me TV. My children are in school but cannot pay their school fees. I go begging sometimes, because the money they are paying me is so meagre, people think I earn plenty money because I work in a refinery, where is the money? “I have to buy soup from people selling soup to manage with my children. I have lost close friends working in the same department with me. I need my severance package, so I can be able to take care of my children. My house rent is due. We need this money, we are dying,” she added. The aggrieved workers carried banners with inscriptions such as ‘EVP Downstream, Dr. Mumuni Dangazaun, must act now’; ‘The RC, Engr. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/28/g.title_zh: 抗议的WRPC支持人员要求NNPCL发放我们的离职补偿金
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/28/g.body_zh:
瓦里炼油和石化公司（WRPC）的支持人员指控炼厂协调员、尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）Limited的Bayọ Adénrélé先生与博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统对着干，并企图煽动针对本届政府的暴力行动。满腹怨气的工人称，Adénrélé切断了WRPC所在社区的矿区使用费。他们发誓无法再容忍对所在社区的欺凌。

WRPC支持人员主席Dafe Ighomitedo周二在WRPC大门口接受记者采访时表示，支持人员仍在持续抗议。他说，自2015年以来，NNPCL一直对工人谎话连篇。Ighomitedo说：“我们已连续第四周在这里抗议，要求获得遣散费补偿方案，因为旧合同已于9月30日到期。遗憾的是，得到的仍是谎话连篇。我们从2015年起就在这里，这场抗议也从2015年持续至今，但每次都以欺骗收场。

“承办这家公司的两个酋长国曾前往阿布贾，在那里承诺给予工人完善的福利待遇。他们裁掉一些人，给我们留下的只是微不足道的钱。我们留下来的人仍然抱有希望，总有一天会发生些好事，但根本没有这回事。他们告诉民众正在照顾我们，说会给我们支付N90,000至N150,000。没有养老金，没有医疗保障，没有交通补贴，我们甚至无法使用工厂诊所，生病时的处境非常屈辱。我们无法再忍受。我们从10月5日起一直在这里，直到现在他们仍未作出回应。

“尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPCL）炼厂协调员（RC）Bayọ Adénrélé不把我们当回事，我们已经对他失去信心。他在处理WRPC支持人员问题时毫无操守。

“他在与博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统领导的本届政府对着干。他这样做是为了煽动针对总统的暴力。我们一直保持和平太久了。社区遭到欺凌太久，我们无法再忍受。Bayọ Adénrélé已经切断了社区的所有矿区使用费。这一回，不会再一切照旧。”

Ighomitedo要求与尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）Limited下游业务执行副总裁Mumuni Dagazau博士会面，并坚持要求他前往瓦里，向正在抗议的工人讲话。

他说：“我们要求见尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）Limited下游业务执行副总裁Mumuni Dagazau博士。他应该前来和我们讲话，因为RC正在诋毁他的办公室，污损尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPCL）集团首席执行官Bashir Bayo Ojulari的形象。RC告诉别人我们是外包人员。我们持有相关函件和文件。我们是直接受雇的，情况很特殊。现任代理董事总经理以前曾是支持人员，后来才转为正式员工，但现在没人愿意转换我们的身份。”

另一名支持人员Akivie Kingsley也表达了同样的不满。他说：“他们一直承诺，承诺却没有兑现；这些人欠我们的东西，我甚至无法说出口。我们理应享受所有福利，但他们的承诺已经让我们无法再忍受。

“如果我们请假，就没有休假补贴。我们当中已经有人去世；此刻停尸房里还放着两具遗体；一些婚姻也因缺钱而破裂。孩子们停学了，因为我们付不起学费，而RC却要求像我们这样经验丰富的工程师在这种环境下继续工作，每月只拿N90,000工资，这根本行不通。我们已经受够了这份奴役合同。”

WRPC另一名支持人员、实验室技术员Benjamin Iwuno感叹，自己在WRPC工作了13年多，但这些年的付出全被当作理所当然，只拿到微薄工资，也没有医疗福利。

Iwuno说：“你要如何向政府解释，有300多名员工为你工作，却没有一个人能领取养老金？他们无法获得基本医疗保障。我的一些同事在执勤期间去世，也没有得到赔偿。

“N90,000能养家吗？管理层告诉我们，我们对他们毫无意义。我的上司怎么会把我的工作成果写成他的业绩评价，而我却什么也得不到？这令人痛苦。我想要在油气公司工作应得的正当福利。”

Harriet Charles的遭遇同样令人心酸。她在讲述过去14年在WRPC的经历时泪流满面。她说：“我在这里工作了14年，以前并不是这样。现在你到我家看看，我没有电视，因为N90,000买不起电视。我的孩子在上学，却付不起学费。我有时不得不乞讨，因为他们给我的钱太少了。别人以为我在炼厂工作就能赚很多钱，可钱在哪里？

“我得向卖汤的人买汤，才能维持自己和孩子的生活。我失去了与我同在一个部门工作的好友。我需要遣散费补偿方案，这样我才能照顾孩子。我的房租到期了。我们需要这笔钱，我们快活不下去了。”

抗议工人举着写有下列字样的横幅：“下游业务执行副总裁Mumuni Dangazaun博士必须立即行动”；“RC工程师Bayọ Adénrélé毫无操守”；“WRPC支持人员从来都不是外包人员，而是由WRPC直接雇用”；“下游业务执行副总裁不到场，就不谈判”。

It’s hard not to feel that this November 2026 US midterm elections is a déjà vu of cheating in Philippine elections. “Dinaya!” is usually the first word a losing candidate shouts in the Philippines: “I got cheated!” President Donald Trump seems to have taken this script to heart, casting a shadow over the forecasted “Blue Wave” that could flip Congress to Democratic control even before the first ballot is counted. Even if Trump’s unfounded claims of voter fraud are overwhelmed by a huge Democratic turnout, many fear that Republicans in Congress, out of loyalty to Trump, may try to block Democrats from assuming the majority. Echoing the “doomsday scenario” espoused by US Attorney General Todd Blanche — delaying the count or refusing to certify results if they favor Democrats — Trump has directed the Justice Department to block certification of the coming Senate election in Alaska if Republican incumbent Dan S. Sullivan loses by a narrow margin. The New York Times reported that the justice department cited flimsy concerns about confusion with another candidate whose name is similar to Sullivan’s. Their efforts to project a narrative of widespread noncitizen voting is also relentless, even using as bogeymen the 11 individuals the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) who were arrested in California on October 16 for allegedly illegally registering to vote. Election experts have raised questions as to whether the charges could be trusted to be accurate, citing similar accusations being disproved elsewhere in the country. Remember when Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo called “Hello, Garci!” to pad her votes during the 2004 presidential election against the late Fernando Poe Jr.? Trump seems to have taken a page from that “Dagdag-Bawas” playbook by questioning voter registrations, challenging mail-in ballots and raising the possibility of hacking voting machines. With early voting underway, shaving off Democrat votes is in play, with software glitches delaying nearly 600,000 voter registrations in Texas. In Nashville, Tennessee, Dolly Parton’s sister, singer Stella Parton, claimed she had to correct her ballot multiple times, saying a voting machine repeatedly selected Republican gubernatorial candidate Marsha Blackburn when she tried to vote for Democrat Jerri Green. While a seasoned “ trapo ” in the Philippines rolls a ₱1,000 note in a folded T-shirt to buy votes, Trump is dangling $5,000 to voters and billions in federal aid to farmers affected by tariffs if Republicans keep control of Congress. While hired armed goons in the Philippines steal ballot boxes, Trump has threatened to send heavily-armed ICE agents and National Guard troops to polling places, raising fears of intimidation among immigrant and minority voters. Though we are hopefully far from the impunity of an “Ampatuan massacre,” the shocking, pre-dawn DHS raid on Representative Ilhan Omar’s home three weeks before election day smacks of the same tactic in eliminating his political enemies. Amid this chaos, Filipino candidates running across statewide and local races find themselves navigating an American political system increasingly resembling tactics they thought they had left behind. This year’s crop includes California Attorney General Rob Bonta, seeking reelection; Assemblymember Jessica Caloza, fighting to retain her 52nd District seat; and Cerritos City Councilmember Mark Pulido, campaigning for the 67th Assembly District in the California state legislature. In Daly City, Councilmember Rod Daus-Magbual is running for reelection, joined by Tony Bayudan in what is often celebrated as the “Pinoy Capital” of the United States, where Filipinos make up a full third of the population. In Southern California, Artesia Councilmember Melissa Ramoso is defending her seat while Los Angeles City Controller Kenneth Mejia seeks a second term. In Nevada, Assemblymember Erica Mosca is seeking reelection. In New York, Assemblymember Steven Raga is running for State Senate in Queens, while Georgia State Representative Marvin Lim is running unopposed. Across the Pacific, Hawaii — the first state to elect a Filipino governor in US history with the landmark 1994 election of Benjamin Cayetano — has its own growing crop of FilAm candidates. State Senator Joy A. San Buenaventura is seeking reelection in Puna, joined by State House candidates including Tess Abalos, Travis Bumanglag, Danny Degracia, Diamond Garcia, Greggor Ilagan, Darius K. Kila, Rose Martinez and Julie Reyes Oda. At the county level, Tyler Dos Santos-Tam is seeking another term on the Honolulu City Council, while Kauanoe Batangan and Addison Bulosan are running for county council seats on Maui and Kauai. It’s time for us to walk precincts, man phone banks and donate to our kababayan running for office. So, don’t forget to vote. If voting in person, carefully review your selections before submitting your ballot to make sure the machine properly records your choice. If voting by mail, don’t wait until November 3 to mail your ballots to prevent the understaffed US Postal Service from throwing them away if they don’t get picked up on Election Day. In one of the most consequential elections in modern history, our mission this November is not only in supporting our kababayan to win — it is a front-line battle to make sure our votes are counted, and defend them if need be. – Rappler.com Oscar Quiambao is a former reporter for The Philippine Daily Inquirer who now lives in San Francisco . Rappler+？登录即可收听开创性新闻报道。有人担忧，共和党可能效仿菲律宾选举中阻碍民主党获胜的策略，包括推迟计票和恐吓选民。菲律宾裔参选人正在美国的政治环境中艰难前行，而这个环境处处反映着他们原本试图逃离的腐败做法；这凸显了投票的重要性，也提醒人们必须确保所有选票都得到计票。本文的。阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告任何错误。很难不觉得，2026年11月美国中期选举就像菲律宾选举舞弊事件的预演。败选候选人在菲律宾通常会首先喊出“Dinaya！”：“我被算计了！”唐纳德·特朗普总统似乎把这套说法牢记在心，给预计可能让民主党在首张选票尚未统计前便赢得国会控制权的“蓝色浪潮”蒙上阴影。即使特朗普毫无根据的选舞弊指控被民主党庞大的投票人数冲淡，许多人仍担心，国会中的共和党人可能出于对特朗普的忠诚，试图阻止民主党取得多数席位。美国司法部长托德·布兰奇鼓吹所谓“末日情景”，即如果计票结果有利于民主党，就推迟计票或拒绝认证结果；特朗普也照此行事，指示司法部阻止认证即将举行的阿拉斯加州参议院选举，条件是共和党现任参议员丹·S·沙利文若以微弱差距落败。《纽约时报》报道称、司法部以一些牵强的理由为依据，声称选票可能与另一名姓名和沙利文相近的候选人混淆。共和党人还不断渲染所谓非公民大范围投票的叙事，甚至把国土安全部于10月16日在加利福尼亚州逮捕的11名涉嫌非法登记投票者当作替罪羊。选举专家质疑这些指控是否准确，并指出，全国其他地方也曾出现过类似指控，后来都被证明不实。还记得格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约在2004年与已故费尔南多·波 Jr. 竞选总统时，通过喊出“你好，Garci！”来给自己的选票增添优势吗？特朗普似乎从那套“Dagdag-Bawas”手法中借鉴了经验，开始质疑选民登记、挑战邮寄选票，并提出投票机器可能遭黑客攻击的可能性。提前投票已经开始，削弱民主党票数的做法也开始显现，得克萨斯州软件故障导致近600,000名选民的登记被延迟。田纳西州纳什维尔的乡村歌手多莉·帕顿的妹妹斯特拉·帕顿称，她不得不多次修改选票，因为每当他试图投给民主党州长候选人杰里·格林时，投票机器都会反复选择共和党州长候选人玛莎·布莱克恩。在菲律宾，经验丰富的“trapo”会把一张₱1,000纸币包在折起的T恤衫里用来买票；与此同时，特朗普则以向选民提供$5,000，以及向受关税影响的农民提供数十亿美元联邦援助为诱饵，条件是共和党继续控制国会。在菲律宾，雇佣的武装打手会盗走投票箱；特朗普则威胁派遣装备精良的 ICE 探员和国民警卫队前往投票站，引发移民和少数族裔选民的恐惮。虽然我们 Hopefully 距离“Ampatuan massacre”那种逍遥法外还很远，但在选举日前三周，国土安全部突袭众议员伊尔汉·奥马尔的住所、且行动发生在凌晨，仍令人震惊，也颇似当年用来消灭政治对手的同一套手段。在这片混乱中，参加全州和地方各级选举的菲律宾裔参选人发现，他们不得不在一个越来越像他们原以为已经摆脱的美国政治体系中摸索前进。今年参选的人包括争取连任的加利福尼亚州总检察长罗布·邦塔；为保住第52选区席位而努力的州议员杰西卡·卡洛萨；以及竞选加利福尼亚州议会第67选区的塞里托斯市议员马克·普利多。在戴利城，市议员罗德·道斯-马格布瓦尔争取连任托尼·巴尤丹也参选；这座城市常被誉为美国的“Pinoy Capital”，菲律宾裔占当地人口整整三分之一。在南加利福尼亚州，阿特西亚市议员梅利萨·拉莫索捍卫席位，洛杉矶市主计长肯尼思·梅希亚则寻求连任。在内华达州，州议员埃里卡·莫斯卡争取连任。在纽约州，州议员史蒂文·拉加竞选皇后区州参议员席位；佐治亚州州议员马文·林则在没有对手的情况下参选。在太平洋另一侧，夏威夷州——1994年本杰明·卡耶塔诺赢得标志性选举，成为美国历史上首位菲律宾裔州长——也拥有一批不断壮大的 FilAm 参选人。州参议员乔伊·A·圣布埃纳文图拉在普纳区争取连任；与她一同竞选的还有州众议院候选人特丝·阿巴洛斯、特拉维斯·布芒拉格、丹尼·德格拉西亚、戴蒙德·加西亚、格雷戈尔·伊拉甘、达里乌斯·K·基拉、罗斯·马丁内斯和朱莉·雷耶斯·奥达。在县一级，泰勒·多斯桑托斯-塔姆争取在檀香山市议会再任一届，考阿诺埃·巴塔甘和阿迪森·布洛桑则竞选毛伊岛和考艾岛的县议会席位。是时候让我们走进各个选区、接听电话银行，并为我们竞选公职的 kababayan 捐款了。所以，别忘了投票。如果现场投票，在提交选票前仔细核对自己的选择，确保机器正确记录你的决定。如果邮寄投票，不要等到11月3日才寄出选票，以免人手不足的美国邮政在选举日未能收取时将其丢弃。在现代历史上后果最重大的选举之一中，我们今年11月的使命不仅是支持 kababayan 获胜，也是一场前线战斗，要确保我们的选票得到统计，并在必要时捍卫这些选票。——Rappler.com https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.summary: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance.
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.summary_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥格雷地区4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中包括14名中国人和1名尼日利亚人。该委员会在官方X账号发布的一则帖文中透露，拉各斯第2分局执法人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和 surveillance 实施了逮捕。
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance. Items recovered during the operation included bags of lithium rocks, 18 mobile devices, four computer laptops, two decoders, a television remote control and a trailer truck. The EFCC said the recovered items had been taken as part of its investigation into the activities of the facilities, adding that the suspects would be charged to court upon the conclusion of investigations. However, the agency did not disclose the specific offences the suspects were alleged to have committed or the ownership of the processing plants. Lithium has become a highly sought-after mineral globally because of its critical role in manufacturing rechargeable batteries used in electric vehicles, smartphones, laptops and renewable energy storage systems. Growing demand for electric vehicles and clean energy technologies has intensified the race to secure lithium supplies, making the mineral increasingly valuable and creating incentives for illegal mining and processing. Nigeria is emerging as a new source of lithium in Africa as the world’s largest producers, like Australia and Chile, are unable to fulfil the growing demand worldwide. However, illegal activities thrive in Nigeria’s extractive sector, denying the government due revenues of up to $9 billion, according to the Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (NEITI). The country’s lithium deposits have attracted growing interest from local and foreign operators, while concerns over unregulated extraction, revenue losses, environmental degradation, and the potential circumvention of mining regulations have heightened calls for stricter enforcement. https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.title_zh: 非法锂矿开采：经济和金融犯罪委员会在奥贡州拘捕14名中国人和1名尼日利亚人
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥盖雷地区的4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中14名为中国人、1名为尼日利亚人。该委员会在其官方X账号发布的一则消息中披露，拉各斯第2区分局行动人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和监视行动实施了逮捕。行动中缴获的物品包括装在袋中的锂矿石、18部移动设备、4台笔记本电脑、2个解码器、1个电视遥控器和1辆拖挂卡车。EFCC表示，缴获的物品已作为调查这些工厂经营活动的一部分被查扣，并称调查结束后将把嫌疑人移交法院起诉。然而，该机构没有披露嫌疑人被指控实施的具体罪行，也没有披露这些加工厂的归属。锂已成为全球备受追捧的矿产，因为它在制造用于电动汽车、智能手机、笔记本电脑和可再生能源储存系统的可充电电池方面发挥着关键作用。电动汽车和清洁能源技术需求不断增长，加剧了各国争夺锂供应的竞争，使这种矿产的价值日益提高，也刺激了非法采矿和加工活动。随着澳大利亚和智利等全球最大生产国无法满足全球不断增长的需求，尼日利亚正成为非洲新的锂来源。然而，尼日利亚采掘业的非法活动十分猖獗，使政府损失最高达90亿美元的收入，据尼日利亚采掘业透明度倡议（NEITI）称。该国的锂矿藏吸引了越来越多的本地和外国运营商关注，同时，对不受监管的开采、收入流失、环境破坏以及规避采矿法规的担忧，也强化了要求加强执法的呼声。Adedapo Adesanya是一名记者、多才多艺的学者，也是艺术各个领域的行家。不写作时，他不是埋首阅读自己收藏夹中的众多书籍或文章之一，就是拿着一瓶啤酒或葡萄酒聆听好音乐。他支持世界上最伟大的俱乐部——Manchester United F.C.

https://leadership.ng/niger-republic-tig.summary_zh: 它表示，这一临时措施旨在改善运营的顺利进行，同时保证交付和汽油的可用性，此前全国出现短缺。除了宵禁之外，在所有至少有一个加油站的地区，还禁止在加油站外用油桶销售燃料。当局呼吁尼日尔人表现出“理解和公民意识”，称这些措施旨在改善供应。
https://leadership.ng/niger-republic-tig.body: The new policy says marketers would not sell fuel between nine at night and six in the morning to enable suppliers, including the Nigerien Petroleum Company (Sonidep), to restock them. It said this temporary measure aimed to improve the smooth running of operations while guaranteeing deliveries and the availability of petrol, following a countrywide shortage. But the measure is impacting taxis drivers, like Moussa Idé Boubacar, who said he has not been able to make his payments for two days. “Normally, we generate revenue of around 20,000 a day, of which 8,000 is for payments and 12,000 is for fuel. With this shortage, we’ve had some management issues,” he said. As the fuel shortage spread, motorists have been facing increasingly long queues at stations. Residents in the capital, Niamey, and elsewhere said this was disrupting daily life, making it difficult to get to work and carry out their daily activities. The taxi union, Synctaxi, has called for the new curfew to be relaxed for operators who are struggling to make ends meet. “To obtain fuel, you need authorisation. The petrol station must be open around the clock,” said it secretary-general, Ganda Sanda. “We are appealing to the governorate and the governor as well to reconsider because it does not suit us,” he said. Sanda added that the union wanted to draw the authorities’ attention to the fact that the transport sector “makes a significant contribution to the country’s development”. https://leadership.ng/niger-republic-tig.body_zh: 新政策规定，营销商不得在晚上9点至次日凌晨6点之间出售燃料，以便包括尼日尔国家石油公司（Sonidep）在内的供应商补充库存。政策称，这项临时措施旨在改善运营的顺畅进行，同时保障供应和汽油供应；此前，尼日尔全国范围内出现了燃料短缺。但这项措施影响了出租车司机，例如穆萨·伊代·布巴卡尔，他表示自己已有两天无法支付费用。他说：“通常，我们每天产生约20,000的收入，其中8,000用于付款，12,000用于加油。由于燃料短缺，我们在经营管理方面遇到了一些问题。”随着燃料短缺加剧，驾车者面对加油站前越来越长的队伍。首都尼亚美及其他地区的居民表示，这扰乱日常生活，使人们难以上班和开展日常活动。出租车工会Synctaxi呼吁放松这项宵禁规定，让难以维持生计的经营者能够继续运营。工会秘书长甘达·桑达说：“要获得燃料，必须获得许可。加油站必须昼夜营业。”他说：“我们同时呼吁州政府和总督重新考虑，因为这项规定不适合我们。”桑达补充说，工会希望提请当局注意，运输业“对国家发展作出了重大贡献”。除宵禁外，所有至少拥有一座加油站的地区还禁止在加油站外使用塑料桶销售燃料。当局呼吁尼日尔人表现出“理解力和公民意识”，并称这些措施旨在改善供应。掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、突发独家消息和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，在WhatsApp上获取全天候更新→

I didn't agree with her in the other clip that is going around but I do agree with this one.

The US played it too fast and loose with their ability to impose sanctions. Spit in allies faces by selling them weapons and weapons systems that only work when the US gives them permission to use them. Breaks treaties on a whim when it feels like. Abuses control of the swift system. Spent the last 65 years meddling in Latin American elections.

It's only natural that people are looking for ways to circumvent all that. I said a while back the goal for a BRICS currency almost certainly wouldnt be to challenge the dollars dominance. As long as the Euro been out it hasn't even come close. The goal is to be able to pay each other next time the US tries to sanction one of them into bending the knee.

I see the increased prominence of coordination agreements like NB8, Mercosur, The Alliance of Sahel States etc to be the precursor to a multipolar world, polarized by region

🔘 The Moroccan Sahara at a Geostrategic Turning Point: The US–Russia Confrontation, MINURSO's Future and Morocco's Sovereignty Doctrine

GEOPOLITICS | DIPLOMACY | INTERNATIONAL SECURITY | NORTH AFRICA

The developments surrounding the UN Security Council's deliberations on the Moroccan Sahara on 30 October 2026 represent a significant turning point in the diplomatic and geopolitical trajectory of the territorial dispute. The reported Russian veto against the American draft resolution, the failure of Moscow's alternative proposal, and the non-renewal of MINURSO's mandate have exposed profound divisions over the future international framework for addressing the issue.

Washington's initiative reflected an attempt to move beyond the traditional management of the dispute towards a more clearly defined political settlement based on Morocco's Autonomy Initiative. Strategically, the American approach sought to consolidate the growing international recognition of the autonomy proposal as a credible and realistic framework for negotiations.

Russia's opposition demonstrated the persistence of great-power competition within the Security Council. While Moscow exercised its veto power to prevent the adoption of the American proposal, it failed to secure sufficient support for its alternative. This diplomatic confrontation revealed the limits of Russia's capacity to shape the Council's collective position, despite its institutional power to block resolutions.

The Royal Cabinet's statement of 30 October introduced a particularly significant dimension. By interpreting the non-renewal of MINURSO's mandate as the beginning of a new political phase, Morocco signalled its determination to move beyond decades of repetitive UN conflict-management mechanisms.

From the perspective of Moroccan strategic doctrine, this development reinforces a sovereignty-centred approach grounded in territorial integrity, diplomatic continuity, regional stability and the consolidation of international partnerships.

The strategic significance also extends to Morocco's Atlantic and African ambitions. The Kingdom's southern provinces increasingly constitute a central component of its geoeconomic strategy, connecting Atlantic maritime infrastructure, African economic integration, energy corridors and regional connectivity.

Strategic Assessment

Three geopolitical implications deserve particular attention.

First, the American position strengthens Morocco's diplomatic leverage, even though the failure to adopt the draft prevents its proposed provisions from acquiring the authority of a new Security Council resolution.

Second, Russia's veto creates a new diplomatic challenge for Rabat, requiring a careful reassessment of relations with Moscow without necessarily undermining broader bilateral cooperation.

Third, the potential termination of MINURSO's operational mandate raises important questions concerning ceasefire monitoring, regional security and the future institutional role of the United Nations.

The non-renewal of a peacekeeping mandate does not, by itself, terminate the UN's involvement or resolve every legal dimension of the dispute.

Ultimately, the events of 30 October indicate a possible transition from prolonged international conflict management towards a more politically contested settlement process.

For Morocco, the strategic priority remains the consolidation of sovereignty, the strengthening of international support for its Autonomy Initiative, and the preservation of stability across the Sahara–Sahel and Atlantic geopolitical spaces.

The central strategic question is no longer limited to MINURSO's future, but concerns the balance of international influence that will determine the next phase of the Moroccan Sahara issue.

GEOSTRATEGIC INSIGHT

https://x.com/igeostrategic/status/21163.snippet_zh:
🔘 摩洛哥撒哈拉正处于地缘战略转折点：美俄对抗、MINURSO的未来与摩洛哥主权 doctrine

地缘政治 | 外交 | 国际安全 | 北非

围绕联合国安全理事会于2026年10月30日审议摩洛哥撒哈拉问题所发生的进展，构成了这一领土争端外交与地缘政治走向的重要转折点。据报道，俄罗斯否决了美国提出的决议草案，莫斯科的替代方案未获通过，MINURSO的授权也未获续期，这些事件暴露出各方围绕处理该问题的未来国际框架存在深刻分歧。

华盛顿的倡议试图推动处理该争端的方式超越传统争端管理，转向以摩洛哥自治倡议为基础、界定更加明确的政治解决框架。从战略层面看，美国的立场旨在巩固国际社会日益增加的认可，使自治方案成为谈判中可信且现实的框架。

俄罗斯的反对表明，大国竞争在安全理事会内部依然持续。莫斯科动用否决权阻止美国提案获得通过，却未能为自己的替代方案争取到足够支持。这场外交对抗揭示出，尽管俄罗斯凭借在安理会的制度性权力能够阻止决议通过，但其塑造安理会集体立场的依然存在限度。

王室内阁10月30日的声明引入了一个尤其重要的维度。摩洛哥将MINURSO授权未获续期解读为一个新政治阶段的开始，表明决心摆脱数十年来反复采用的联合国冲突管理机制。

从摩洛哥战略 doctrine的角度看，这一进展强化了以主权为中心的方针，该方针建立在领土完整、外交延续性、地区稳定以及巩固国际伙伴关系的基础上。

这一事件的战略意义还延伸至摩洛哥的大西洋和非洲抱负。王国南部省份日益成为其地缘经济战略的核心组成部分，将大西洋海上基础设施、非洲经济一体化、能源走廊和区域互联互通连接起来。

战略评估

这一局势有三项地缘政治影响值得特别关注。

第一，美国的立场增强了摩洛哥的外交杠杆，尽管草案未获通过，无法使其拟议条款获得新安理会决议的权威效力。

第二，俄罗斯行使否决权为拉巴特带来新的外交挑战，需要审慎重新评估与莫斯科的关系，同时不必因此削弱更广泛的双边合作。

第三，MINURSO行动授权可能终止，引发了有关停火监督、地区安全以及联合国未来制度角色的重要问题。

维持和平授权本身并不会终止联合国的参与，也无法解决该争端的每一个法律层面问题。

归根结底，10月30日的事件表明，国际社会可能正从长期冲突管理，转向政治争议更大的解决进程。

对摩洛哥而言，战略重点仍是巩固主权、加强国际社会对其自治倡议的支持，以及维护撒哈拉—萨赫勒和大西洋地缘政治空间的稳定。

核心战略问题如今已不再局限于MINURSO的未来，而是关乎决定摩洛哥撒哈拉问题下一阶段的国际影响力平衡。

地缘战略洞察

Russia Africa Summit: 22 Presidents

The Russia Africa Summit 2026 closed in Moscow with 48 countries and 22 heads of state, up from 17 in 2023. 

Putin promised no "neo-colonial exploitation" and declared the era of a few states deciding "the fate of entire continents" over.

What he wanted: Africa's 54 UN votes, military reach through the Africa Corps, minerals, and a trade system beyond sanctions. Grain is Russia's main tool of influence: 13 million tonnes of farm products in the first nine months of 2026. 

The political return appeared in February 2026, when six African states voted against a UN peace resolution on Ukraine and 17 abstained.

What Africa wanted: weapons, cheap grain, power plants, a bigger UN voice, and the freedom to deal with everyone. Mali's leader, General Assimi Goïta, asked for "partnerships based on sovereignty, equality and non-interference."

Trade figures show that Russia is a much smaller partner. 

Trade with Africa in 2025: Europe 385,000 million dollars, China 348,000 million dollars, the United States about 85,000 million dollars, Russia 27,000 million dollars. 

The United States total is less than half its trade with Vietnam alone. Russia's real weight is the Africa Corps, about 2,000 men in the Sahel.

No leader mentioned the African recruits: 3,066 Africans lured into Russia's army with job offers, 502 confirmed dead. Two days before the summit, a UN commission called it trafficking.

In the Sahel, the Africa Corps saved Niger's junta from a mutiny but cannot lift the jihadist fuel blockade on Bamako, the capital of Mali. Egypt, an ally of the United States, is building a 25,000 million dollar nuclear plant with Russia.

The answer of the United States government is "commercial diplomacy" and minerals deals. This is the right approach, but the Russian government brought together 22 presidents, and the United States has not.

Trade beats mercenaries. The United States must be present in Africa, or other countries will take its place.

https://x.com/chomcho/status/21163295513.snippet_zh:
俄非峰会：22位总统与会

2026年俄非峰会在莫斯科闭幕，共有48个国家和22位国家元首出席，高于2023年的17个国家。

普京承诺不会进行“新殖民剥削”，并宣布由少数国家决定“整个大陆命运”的时代已经结束。

他的目标是：争取非洲在联合国的54张选票，通过非洲军团扩大军事影响力，获取矿产资源，并建立不受制裁约束的贸易体系。粮食是俄罗斯施加影响的主要工具：2026年前九个月向非洲出口了1,300万吨农产品。

政治上的回归迹象出现在2026年2月。当时，6个非洲国家在联合国有关乌克兰的和平决议上投了反对票，另有17国弃权。

非洲的诉求是：武器、廉价粮食、电厂、在联合国拥有更大发言权，以及与任何国家开展合作的自由。马里领导人阿西米·戈伊塔将军呼吁建立“基于主权、平等和不干涉的伙伴关系”。

贸易数据表明，俄罗斯的贸易伙伴规模要小得多。

https://x.com/timuzira/status/2116202467.title: Unilateral sanctions don't work.
https://x.com/timuzira/status/2116202467.snippet:
Unilateral sanctions don't work. History proves that one-sided economic pressure fails to force a strategic retreat when a state views its security as a vital priority.

Look at what happened in the Sahel—years of U.S. sanctions targeting Mali's defense officials completely failed to change their strategy, ultimately forcing Washington to quietly lift them to salvage regional operations. Applying this pressure unevenly reveals a glaring double standard: penalizing Rwanda’s defense structures - which will not work - while giving the DRC preferential treatment, despite Kinshasa harboring extremist negative forces like the FDLR on its soil.

True stability requires balanced diplomacy and addressing all security threats, not blunt isolation.

看看萨赫勒地区发生的情况——美国针对马里国防官员实施制裁多年，却完全未能改变其战略，最终迫使华盛顿悄悄解除制裁，以挽救地区行动。这种施加压力的做法并不均衡，暴露出明显的双重标准：一方面惩罚卢旺达国防机构——这不会奏效；另一方面却优待刚果民主共和国，尽管金沙萨境内窝藏武装组织民主力量与卢旺达解放运动等极端负面势力。

真正的稳定需要均衡的外交和应对所有安全威胁，而不是生硬的孤立。
